DREAM SHIFT
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 1 minute
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to shift from a normal dream to the Dream Plane. 
General Usage: The practitioner enters into a relaxed state, falls asleep, and enters a lucid dream state. 
He then projects himself onto the Dream Plane with a successful skill roll. The skill user’s very first shift to the Dream Plane will either 
be to a random location or one set for new dreamers, depending on the setting. Thereafter, the practitioner can choose a familiar place 
to shift to each time he uses this skill. There is no limit to how long shifted beings can stay on the Dream Plane, but the clock is always 
running in San Dimas.
Special Usage: The practitioner can also draw with him 1 ally per Class Title within 3’ per Will Force rating. This can include animal 
companions that are capable of dreaming (mammals and birds). A skill roll at +20% must be made for each ally. When the practitioner 
leaves the Dream Plane, any allies brought to the plane with him leave as well, waking up in their bodies as normal. 
Notes: Anyone who is dream shifted through this skill is still physically present where they fell asleep. An image of the being’s body is 
projected onto the Dream Plane that includes whatever the being was wearing and holding when he fell asleep. The physical body left 
behind will retain a link to the dream body and to the being’s mind, spirit, and soul now on the Dream PlaneA shifted being can be 
awakened and brought back to his body through strong sensations such as cold water, overpowering smells, violent movement, pain, etc. 
The shifted being may resist waking up through a Will Force save if desired. When shifting back to one’s body, it takes 1d10 seconds to 
return from the Dream Plane and become conscious. No more than one attempt to return someone to their body can be made per 10 
seconds. A successful Meditate skill roll offers +20% to Dream Shift the practitioner, and a successful Read Dream skill roll offers +20% to 
Dream Shift when bringing an ally.

===== PAGE 124 =====
118
Special Notes: If the physical body dies back on the being’s 
original plane of origin, the being’s mind, spirit, and soul lose 
their connection to that physical form and the being becomes a 
dream ghost (as a New Ghost in Epitaph of the Fallen but with a 
dream form). If the projected dream body is killed on the Dream 
Plane, the being must make a Will Force save or suffer either 
a heart attack or stroke (50% chance for each) and the being’s 
consciousness is immediately returned to his body. Regardless 
of how the being died, whether from a heart attack/stroke or the 
being’s physical body was killed, the dead being must roll his 
Endure chance ot leave a dream shadow on the Dream Plane. 
Beings whose projected bodies die on the Dream Plane cannot 
return to the Dream Plane for 3 full days. 
Critical Failure: No further attempt to dream shift the targeted 
being can be made for one full day/night. 
Critical Success: Any damage or affliction being suffered in the 
shifted being’s physical body is not included on the projected 
dream body. 
Repeat Failure: Treat three failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title 4 and Read Dream or Meditate. 
DREAM SUMMON
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 10 minutes
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to summon a being to or 
from the Dream Plane while the practitioner is on any plane of 
existence.
General Usage: From either the Dream Plane or another plane 
of existence, the practitioner may summon any being currently 
on the Dream Plane by concentrating on imagining that targeted 
being for 10 minutes. After making a successful Dream Summon 
skill roll and Intelligence save, the targeted being is summoned and 
appears within a few feet of the practitioner (a Magic Resistance 
can be used to avoid the summoning if desired). If the summoned 
being has been called from the Dream Plane onto another plane 
of existence, that being’s physical body (if it has one) is not 
summoned, just a manifested, illusionary dream image that will 
remain for 1 hour per Class Title of the practitioner. 
Special Usage: Alternatively, the practitioner may be currently on 
the Dream Plane and summon someone sleeping outside the plane 
by imagining them for 10 minutes and then making a successful 
Dream Summon skill roll and Intelligence save. The target is 
afforded a Magic Resistance (if desired) to avoid being shifted to 
the Dream Plane (as the skill Dream Shift). The summoned being’s 
projected body appears within a few feet of the practitioner, while 
the target’s mind, spirit and soul are linked back to his original 
body. If the practitioner knows the targeted being’s true name, he 
can summon the target while the target is awake (unless a Magic 
Resistance is made, if desired). In this case, the target’s physical 
body immediately falls asleep at his current location. The targeted 
being remains shifted onto the Dream Plane until the practitioner 
leaves the Dream Plane or the target’s physical body is woken.
Critical Failure: No further attempt this day/night may be made to 
summon the specific being. 
Critical Success: The summoned creature is aware they are 
dreaming.  
Repeat Failure: Treat three failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title 8, Dream Shift and Dream Call or Dream 
Create.
ENERGETIC DISSOLUTION
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 20
Start Bonus: 1d6%		
	
Time: 10 Seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Causes the immediate dissolution of subatomic 
bonds in the area of effect. 
General Usage:  The practitioner chooses a spherical area within 
10’ per Class Title and with a diameter no larger than 5’ per 
Class Title and concentrates for 10 seconds. A successful skill 
roll indicates that the strong interaction holding atoms together 
is suppressed in all matter in the area of effect, causing the 
subatomic particles to no longer be bound together, disintegrating 
all matter unfortunate enough to be so affected. As this requires 
tremendous energy to accomplish, 5 Aura are temporarily drained 
from the practitioner to power this effect; lost Aura returns at 
the practitioner’s Aura Regeneration Rate. A Magic Resistance 
is allowed for each targeted being or magic item to avoid the 
disintegration effect. A Wish or Miracle may be used to restore a 
being destroyed by this skill.
Special Usage: The practitioner may choose to permanently 
expend (burn away) the 5 Aura used to power this effect, causing 
all beings and objects within the area affected to be immediately 
and permanently destroyed; no resistance is allowed against this 
effect. Nothing short of an Unlimited Wish can restore anyone or 
anything destroyed in this manner. Aura consumed to power this 
special usage must come from the practitioner herself, not from 
another source such as an Aura container.
Critical Failure: The practitioner must wait 1 hour before 
attempting Energetic Dissolution again.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 10, Kinetics Knowledge, Kinetics Lore, and 
Kinetics Mastery

ENIGMA
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 10 seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill allows the user to craft illusions. 
General Usage: The user concentrates on an illusion they would like to manifest, and a skill roll is made. Success indicates that the illusion 
springs into being, if the user is able to infuse sufficient Aura into the illusion. These effects require no concentration to maintain, but 
they do count toward the user’s external effects. Affected beings are allowed an Illusion Resistance to negate the effects. All effects last 
for 1 hour per Aura used to create them. Combining illusion types requires expenditure of at least the sum of the Aura required for each 
type. Additional skill uses can add to the illusion if the proper amount of Aura is spent and the skill roll is made. Failure indicates that the 
original illusion is broken as well as the new effect(s). 
Illusion Type
Aura Required
Description
Taste
2
This effect enables the user to give illusionary tastes to anything being eaten or tasted in the area affected, or to a 
specific object. The area affected is a 1’ radius sphere per Aura point used to create the effect, or 1 object per Aura. 
Smell
3
Allows the user to create any illusion of smell in a 1’ radius sphere per Aura point used to create the effect, or on 1 
object per Aura.
Sound
4
This effect enables the caster to create an illusion of any sound emanating within the area affected, or from a specific 
object. The area affected is a 1’ radius sphere per Aura point used to create the effect, or 1 object per Aura.
Sight
5
This effect enables the user to create any illusion involving vision in the area affected. If the user wishes to make 
the illusion move, he must concentrate to direct the illusion during creation; the illusion moves on its own for the 
remainder of the duration. If the user wishes to alter the set movement, he may do so with an additional skill roll of 
Enigma, which will alter the current illusion instead of creating a new one. The area affected is a 1’ radius sphere per 
Aura point used to create the effect, or 1 object per Aura.
Feeling
8
This effect allows the user to create any illusions of touch in the area affected.  The area affected is a 1’ radius sphere 
per Aura point used to create the effect, or 1 object per Aura.
Sensing
10
This effect allows the user to create sensations and emotions in the area affected, such as the feelings of fear, dread, 
doom, unease, calm, peace, hatred, love, pain, bliss, etc. The emotions can be made to be felt within the area affected 
or can be made to appear to come from an individual. Thus, one person can be made to feel that hatred is coming 
from another being, and this may or may not cause strife. Also, this effect can give the illusion of internal pain 
which, combined with illusion of feeling and other illusions, can be devastating. To see the possible damage that can 
be done by this effect, see “Aspects of Magic” at the beginning of the Magic section in the Player’s Guide. The area 
affected is a 1’ radius sphere per Aura point used to create the effect, or 1 object/being per Aura.
Special Notes: This skill requires Aura to be expended to create its effect.
Critical Failure: The user suffers a level of mental fatigue and cannot use this skill for 10 minutes. 
Critical Success: The duration can be made permanent but will always count as an external effect until dispelled.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title 3 and Illusion Knowledge.

be dispelled. 
•	 Any beings who lose sight of the practitioner for more than 1 minute are afforded a new Control Resistance for each minute they are 
out of sight, though they will try to get back in sight of the practitioner until control is broken. 
•	 There is no limit to the number of beings controlled in this manner as long as they can see the practitioner.
•	 All skill effects last for 1 hour per Class Title or creature level.
Critical Failure: No further attempt to enthrall the same targets may be made until this skill chance is increased. The skill may, however,

ENTROPY
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 18
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: 10 Seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Causes a decrease in kinetic energy around the

General Usage: The practitioner concentrates for 10 seconds

entropic energy measuring up to a 5’ radius per Class Title of the 
practitioner has surrounded the practitioner and will affect all 
objects and beings within that field thusly:
Projectiles:
• Projectiles lose 50’ of forward motion for every 1’ travelled while 
in the sphere.
• Projectiles that strike a target while still moving forward will do 1 
point of damage per die, total.
Beings:
• Movement is at 1/4 normal while in the sphere; the practitioner is 
unaffected.
• Weapon speeds are all +1 second per Practitioner Title 
(maximum +10 seconds) and are unable to be modified by 
Strength or Agility.
• Weapons that strike a target will do 1 less die of damage per 
Practitioner Title and do not receive a Strength bonus.
• Invoking and Spellcasting times are doubled if a somatic 
component is required.
• Combat, Disciplined, and Stealth/Intrusive skill usage times 
are increased by 2 seconds per Practitioner Title (maximum +10 
seconds).
• Physical Attribute saves suffer a penalty of -10% per Practitioner 
Title (maximum -50% seconds).
Magic:
• Magical energy does 1 less damager per die per Practitioner Title 
(maximum -3 per die).
Note: Beings and magic items are afforded a Magic Resistance to 
avoid the effects of this skill. The practitioner must concentrate to 
maintain the entropic field. The field dissipates immediately when 
concentration is broken.
Critical Failure: The practitioner must wait 1 hour before 
attempting Entropy again.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 9, Kinetics Knowledge, and Kinetics Lore.
EQUALIZE
Attributes: Piety	
	
	
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 10 Seconds
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to equalize physical harm 
between any two beings. 
General Usage: The skill user concentrates for 10 seconds on any 
two beings within 3’ per Will Force rating of the practitioner (the 
practitioner himself can be one of the targets). After a successful 
skill roll, both targets are afforded a Magic Resistance, if desired. 
If either makes a Magic Resistance, nothing happens; otherwise, 
all current physical and magical damage is equalized between 
the two beings within each body area they have in common. 
Nothing happens with body areas the two targets do not have in 
common, such as between a centaur’s hind leg or avian’s wing 
trying to be equalized with a human. Damage between the two 
comparable body areas that is uneven causes the uneven portion to 
be removed. So, if the damaged target has a 13-point wound in the 
head, each target will have a 6-point wound if the skill succeeds. 
Special Notes: The new wounds created are identical to the 
lessened wounds. For instance, if one target is burned, burns at half 
the damage would appear on the second target as they are fading 
on the original target. Poison, disease, control, hold effects, mental 
effects, etc. are not affected by this skill.
Critical Success: Each wound is reduced by an additional point.
Critical Failure: No additional attempts may be made to equalize 
damage between these two targets for 1 hour and the practitioner 
now has mental fatigue. 
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 6, Divine Knowledge, Life Sense.

EXEMPLAR MOUNTED ARCHER
Attributes: Agility, Will Force	
Rating: 20
Start Bonus: 1d6%		
	
Time: Special
Type: Combat, Disciplined	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill represents an advancement of a mounted 
archer’s capabilities above and beyond what a mere mortal is 
normally able to achieve.
General Usage: 
For any missile weapon previously specialized with Missile Lore: 
Add one die to damage. Furthermore, any fumble result is ignored, 
instead resulting in a simple miss. If the Grandmaster optional rule 
is in effect, any result of one on an attack roll may be re-rolled; the 
second result stands.
For any mount ridden by the skill practitioner: Gain the following 
effects:
•	 The mount now rolls any resistances using the skill 
practitioner’s resistances if they’re higher. At the GM’s 
discretion, certain resistance-like skills such as Fearless or 
Steadfast may be rolled on behalf of the mount as well.
•	 Any beneficial magical or divine magical effects active on the 
skill practitioner are now shared with the mount as well (no 
new effects are actually created – the mount simply gets to 
enjoy benefits). At the GM’s discretion, certain resistance-like 
skills such as Fearless or Steadfast may be rolled on behalf of 
the mount as well.
•	 Physical attacks directed at the mount may be completely 
negated with a successful Exemplar Mounted Archer roll. Each 
successive attack beyond the first suffers a cumulative -10% to 
the roll, however.
•	 Both mount and rider gains a bonus to Defensive Adjustment 
equal to -1 per 5% in the Exemplar Mounted Archer skill. This 
bonus is only applicable when the skill practitioner is riding the 
mount, of course.
•	 Penalties related to firing while riding a mount no longer apply.
Additional effects (only applicable while mounted and if the skill 
practitioner meets the listed requirements):
•	 Has a Surprise Attack skill of (101%+): A successful roll 
doubles the amount of surprise seconds.
•	 Has a Perfect Shot skill of (101%+): A check for knockdown 
occurs at 25 points of damage rather than 50 points; knock 
back unaffected.
•	 Has a Stun skill of (101%+, arrows with blunt arrowheads, 
successful head shot) Stuns may now be performed with 
ranged weapons. As noted, the arrowhead must be rounded 
and otherwise blunted and the skill practitioner must score a 
head shot, in addition to the normal requirements of the Stun 
skill.
•	 Has a Brace (120%+): Skill practitioner loses their personal 
defensive adjustment as normal but gains the mount’s defensive 
adjustment. This is cumulative with the defensive adjustment 
listed earlier in the previous section.
Critical Success: The penalty to avoid the next attack is not 
increased.
Critical Failure: No further attempts to negate damage may be 
made this combat.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 15, Horsemanship, and Missile Lore.

Attributes: Intelligence, Will Force

Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: N/A
Type: Disciplined, Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: The ability to magically center one’s mind, resulting

•	 +5% to Perception

Notes: May not be used non-acquired.

GRAVIKINESIS
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 18
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: Varies
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill represents the ability to magically 
manipulate gravity.  
General Usage: The user concentrates on the desired effect and 
mentally wills it to happen. Unlike casting spells, the amount of 
Aura needed to create an effect is constant. The Aura is drained 
from the practitioner’s Aura Pool and returns at her Aura 
Regeneration Rate. Note: Class Title in these usages always refers 
to the Class Title of the practitioner, even when the verbiage 
seems to indicate otherwise. Unless otherwise specified, effects are 
instantaneous in duration and have a range of 10’ per Class Title.
Lighten (10 Aura; +40% modifier, 5 seconds): Causes all items 
carried by 1 being to be reduced in weight up to 25%, i.e. a 100-lb. 
weight can be made to weigh no less than 75 lb. Cumulative uses 
have no effect. This effect persists for 1 hour per Class Title.
Alter (12 Aura; +30% modifier, 10 seconds): Causes the gravity 
in an area no larger than 10 ft³ per Practitioner Title to be either 
increased or decreased by up to 10% per Class Title of the 
practitioner, lasting for 10 minutes per Class Title.
Gravitic Trap (18 Aura; no modifier, 10 minutes): Creates an area 
no larger than 5 ft³ per Class Title of a set trap that, when touched 
by another Aura field, will be triggered, causing an immediate 
change in gravity in the area of effect. Up to 1 gravity may be 
changed per Practitioner Title with x3 being the maximum 
allowed. For example, 1st Practitioner Title could remove gravity, 
2nd Practitioner Title could reverse it or make it twice as strong, 
etc. Any falling damage in or out of the area of effect applies. The 
trap can only be triggered once. The Gravitic Trap will last for 1 
hour per Class Title once set. Alternately 1/10th of a Will Force can 
be spent to make the trap permanent, resetting every 10 seconds 
once triggered. 

===== PAGE 129 =====
123
Infuse (18 Aura; no modifier, 5 seconds): Allows the practitioner to 
infuse an object or surface with gravity, giving the object or surface 
its own gravitational pull. The practitioner can choose any strength 
of gravity between 0% and 100% of the earthly gravity and may 
alter it again with further skill rolls. Beings may not be affected by 
this usage. This effect persists for 1 day per Class Title.
Intensify (18 Aura; no modifier, 10 seconds): Causes 1 being to be 
affected by up to 1 additional gravity per Practitioner Title; i.e. if 
this skill is used at 3rd Practitioner Title, the affected being would 
suffer gravity up to 4 times stronger than normal (1 normal gravity 
plus 3 more). The amount is set by the practitioner at the time 
of usage. The target may make a Magic Resistance to ignore this 
effect. This effect lasts for 1 minute per Class Title.
Gravitic Pathway (20 Aura; -10% modifier, 1 minute): Allows the 
practitioner to create a pathway upon solid surfaces where gravity 
will pull them to the surface, allowing a being to walk normally 
upon that surface as if it were solid ground. This pathway is fixed 
5’ wide and no more than 10’ long per Practitioner Title (it may be 
extended as needed, with additional skill rolls). The practitioner 
may simply begin walking upon the targeted surface, shaping it to 
their will. The pathway will prevent other sources of gravity from 
affecting the being standing upon it and will last for 10 minutes per 
Practitioner Title.
Flux (20 Aura; -10% modifier, 5 seconds): Causes all beings within 
10’ per Practitioner Title to make a Magic Resistance or be thrown 
into the air a distance of 10’ per Class Title of the practitioner. 
Affected beings will suffer falling damage (see Master’s Manual) 
when they fall back to strike the ground. If used indoors, this 
effect causes beings who strike a ceiling to take falling damage as 
if they fell from a height equal to the distance between the floor 
and ceiling, and then to take falling damage a second time upon 
returning to the ground.
Spatial Compression (20 Aura; -10% modifier, 1 minute): The 
practitioner compresses a portion of his current plane to occupy a 
smaller space than it would normally occupy. Passing into or out of 
this space feels normal, albeit disorienting. Upon ending, the space 
inside will reassert itself, becoming its usual density. Any objects or 
beings inside are forced out of the area if they could not otherwise 
occupy that space normally. This effect persists for 1 day per Class 
Title.
Specialization Ability, Portal (20 Aura; -10% modifier, 1 minute): 
The practitioner collapses space-time between two points on the 
same plane to create a temporary dimensional gate between them. 
Momentum and orientation are preserved when passing through 
the portal. Ends of the portal may not be inside objects and may 
exist in open space or upon a surface. The portal will remain open 
for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.
Mastery Ability, Singularity (25 Aura; -35% modifier, 10 seconds): 
Creates a gravitational singularity at a location specified by the 
practitioner  The Singularity immediately begins to consume all 
matter within a spherical area with a diameter no larger than 10’ 
per Class Title. The Singularity may be created at any point visible 
to the practitioner that is within 20’ per Class Title. The Singularity 
pulls unsecured objects and beings toward it at the rate of 5’ per 
second, plus 1’ per second per every full 100 lb. of weight of the 
object or person. Beings attempting to withstand the pull by 
holding onto an anchoring object are allowed a half Strength save 
to resist. Once the Singularity has consumed 500 lb. of matter per 
Class Title, it dissipates. If the Singularity is produced in an area 
with different gravity than a 1 g world, calculate weight as though 
objects and beings were affected at 1 g. Yes, we know it should be 
mass instead of weight; we are using weight to simplify for game 
terms. If you want to waste time calculating mass instead, go right 
ahead, Captain Sliderule.
Critical Success: 1/2 Aura requirements.
Critical Failure: The skill user is unable to use Gravikinesis for 1 
minute and must make a Will Force save or suffer mental fatigue.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 7, Kinetics Knowledge, and Kinetics Lore.
GULLIBILITY
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 14
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 10 seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill lowers the Illusion Resistance of the target 
being or beings.
General Usage: The user concentrates on an individual or group 
within sight and makes a skill roll. Success indicates that the target 
or targets suffer from a penalty to their Illusion Resistance of -5% 
per Practitioner Title for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.  Target 
beings are allowed an Illusion Resistance to negate this effect, if 
requested, but this resistance roll is modified as though the penalty 
were already in effect.  
Notes: This skill can affect a maximum of 1 being per Class Title of 
the practitioner.
Critical Failure: The target being(s) become aware that the 
practitioner was attempting to affect their mind(s).
Critical Success: The target’s Illusion Resistance is lowered by an 
additional 10% (flat, not per Practitioner Title).
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title 2 and Illusion Knowledge.
HARMONY
Attributes: Piety, Will Force	 	
Rating: 14
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 5 Seconds
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This causes dissonant sounds (including music, 
speech, and mechanical noise) within earshot of the skill user to 
sound like harmonious and pleasing music. 
General Usage: The skill user concentrates on the targeted source 
of sound (up to 1 per Practitioner Title) for 5 seconds and makes a 
skill roll. Success indicates a sudden change in the source’s sound, 
creating beautifully harmonious music. If the skill user targets 
himself, anything he says or sings within 2 seconds of successfully 
using this skill will be affected. This effect lasts for 1 minute per 
Practitioner Title, after which a new skill roll must be made to 
continue affecting the targeted source of sound (the user may reroll 
at any point before the duration is up to continue the harmony 
without interruption).

===== PAGE 130 =====
124
Special Uses: This skill may be used to “adjust” a musician’s 
performance, making the music in tune instead of off-pitch, or 
the skill user may cancel out the effects of a song, ballad, hymn, 
or psalm being sung by any Evil-aligned user. For instance, a 
Wood Elf Harmonist may use this skill to cancel out the effects 
of a Dark Elf Minstrel’s “Song of Control”. If the targeted source 
of sound is a living being, anything they attempt to say will come 
out as beautiful singing instead, and so this skill can be used to 
disrupt spellcasting, invoking, rituals, or skills requiring speech 
(such as Deception). Anyone wishing to resist the effect of the skill 
Harmony is allowed a Control Resistance.
Special Notes: If this skill is being used to counter the effects of the 
Discord skill, the two skill users must roll against each other’s Will 
Force. The targeted sound will be controlled by whoever’s roll wins 
by the most.
Critical Failure: The skill user must wait 1 hour before attempting 
to affect this sound again and now has mental fatigue.
Critical Success: Any resulting harmony cannot be canceled by the 
skill Discord.
Repeat Failure: Treat as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 4 and Intone.
HYMN LORE
Attributes: Wisdom, Piety	
	
Rating: 18
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: Varies
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: The ability to write and learn divine hymns of the 
skill user’s particular deity, the effects of which are generated with 
the skill Intone.
General Usage: Hymns require 5 minutes per rating point to 
memorize and require a number of memorization points equal 
to the hymn rating. If the user finds a divine hymn of her deity, 
she must roll a successful Hymn Lore skill roll to learn it after 
2-7 hours of study ((1d6+1) x1 hour).  If the skill user wants to 
compose a hymn, 2-7 days of meditation and concentration are 
required, during which the hymnist allows his deity to create music 
through him, before a Hymn Lore skill roll may be attempted. If 
successful, the hymnist has composed the hymn, and whenever she 
sings the hymn and makes an Intone skill roll, the effects of that 
hymn take place. The effects begin shortly after the hymnist begins 
the hymn and lasts for a limited time (listeners may be greatly 
moved at the moment they hear the divine words to the hymn, 
but such feelings are temporary and begin to fade rather quickly). 
See below for specific times to start the divine effects of a hymn. 
No divine hymn may last less than 30 seconds or more than 10 
minutes.  
Notes: Hymns must be sung, either with or without instrumental 
accompaniment, for the words themselves are integral to the divine 
effects. Any deeds committed while affected by a hymn that would 
go against a target’s alignment do not result in alignment checks, 
since they deeds are being committed while under the influence 
of magic. However, some hymns result in the target remembering 
what they did while they were affected and feel extremely guilty or 
angry, which may lead to other consequential actions.
Requirements: Title 4 and Intone. (Note: acts as Divine Knowledge 
for requirements for other skills.)
Unrestricted Hymns:
Affinity (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Raises the Affinity of the 
hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity by 2% per 
Practitioner Title. Additional Affinity gained in this manner fade at 
a rate of 1% per hour, beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends.
Alacrity (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Raises the Agility rating by 1 
per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of the 
hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity. Additional 
Agility points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 
minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.
Annulment (Rating 18/+0%): 10 seconds. Permanently dispels one 
previous invocation or hymn in effect, or temporarily dispels all 
the divine powers of one item within 2’ per Practitioner Title of 
the hymnist (not including curses). When attempting to dispel 
invocations or hymn effects, a contest is rolled between the Piety 
Control of the singer dispelling and the being who created the 
divine effect. This is done by converting both Piety Controls to a 
percentage by multiplying them by 5%. Each rolls percentage dice 
(or the GM rolls if no other player is involved), and the player who 
makes his roll by the most wins. If the hymnist attempting the 
dispel wins, then the invocation or hymn is dispelled; otherwise 
there is no effect. When dispelling powers in divine magic items, 
the contest is versus the Base Piety Level of the item. Since this is 
temporary, powers return at a rate of 1 Piety per day. Invocations 
with an instantaneous duration cannot be dispelled. Invocations 
with a permanent duration are at a +75% versus the Hymn of 
Annulment.
Apparition (Rating 19/-5%): 10 minutes.  Causes the hymnist and 
all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to become insubstantial, 
leaving their bodies behind and traveling as spirits. During 
transcendence, the listeners leave their bodies behind and become 
completely intangible. They can travel as far and as fast as they are 
capable of imagining in any direction. The personalities and minds 
of the spirit travelers remain with the spirits, and their bodies 
become empty shells during this time.  While in this state, the 
hymnist’s body continues to physically sing the hymn (through the 
deity’s or deity’s servant’s control), and his spirit can command his 
body to cease singing at any time, during which all spirits return 
and the effects of the hymn end. The spirit travelers are not capable 
of casting spells or interacting physically with the world while in 
spirit form. The spirit travelers can only be detected by those who 
have Life Sensing, Telepathy, or Thought Projection and who notice 
the mental presence of the spirit travelers (determined by a Will 
Force save). Once the hymn ends, all spirits are wrenched back into 
their bodies. If a spirit travelers’ body is killed, she becomes a New 
Ghost (see Epitaph of the Fallen). 
Aptitude (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Raises Intelligence by 1 per 
2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of the 
hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity. Additional 
Intelligence points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 
minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.
Armor (Rating 19/-5%): 10 seconds. Creates a barrier of divine 
force that surrounds the bodies of the hymnist and all listeners 
who follow the hymnist’s deity, on top of any armor or clothing. 
This divine armor provides 1 point of armor protection for each 
Practitioner Title and lasts for 5 minutes per Practitioner Title. 
This effect counts as Spiritual Armor for stacking rules. 
Assurance (Rating 19/-5%): 1 minute. Provides a sign given by 
the hymnist’s deity to be used to determine if the choice under 
question is advisable or not. The GM determines if any appropriate 
sign is possible and then causes something representing the 

===== PAGE 131 =====
125
answer (either yes or no) to happen. It is then up to the listeners to 
interpret the sign. No more than one sign about a particular choice 
in question will be granted within a 24-hour period. There is no 
guarantee of any assurance at all, and not all situations will warrant 
an answer (the GM has complete discretion).
Aversion (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Lowers the Affinity of 
all listeners who do not follow the hymnist’s deity by 2% per 
Practitioner Title. Affinity rating points lost in this manner return 
at a rate of 1% per hour, beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends.
Cleansing (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds. Cleanses one object or area 
within sight no larger than 1 square foot per Practitioner Title of all 
disease, dust, grime, scum and bacteria. When used against slime 
or earth-based beings, 1d4 magical damage per Practitioner Title 
is applied to a single random location. If the slime or earth-based 
creature is supernatural, then there is a 1% chance per Practitioner 
Title of banishing the creature to its home plane.
Communion (Rating 21/-15%%): 20 seconds. Grants the hymnist 
and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity an additional +2% 
per Practitioner Title to Commune Chance and an additional +5% 
per Practitioner Title to the skills Divination and Omen for 10 
minutes per Practitioner Title.
Conversion (Rating 28/-50%): 10 minutes. Causes all listeners who 
do not follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance 
at -2% per Practitioner Title or instantly and utterly renounce 
their own faith and convert to the particular deity of the hymnist. 
This affect is permanent and can only be reversed with a new 
Renunciation or Conversion hymn sung by a follower of the 
listener’s previous deity, or a successful Convert skill roll.
Defection (Rating 18/+0%): 20 seconds. Causes the hymnist and all 
listeners who either reside currently, or have resided in the past, 
in the particular land or nation named in the hymn, to be filled 
with an overwhelming sense of animosity and humiliation for that 
particular homeland for 1 hour, gaining +5% to Control Resistance, 
+1 to hit, and -1 defense adjustment (all per 2 Practitioner Titles) 
while harming anyone or anything that originates from or speaks 
for that particular homeland. A Control Resistance is necessary for 
any listeners who do not wish these effects.
Desecration (Rating 24/-30%): 10 minutes. Causes winds of erosion 
to gust violently against one structure or altar dedicated to the 
worship of a deity other than the hymnist’s. For the duration of the 
hymn, the structure miraculously is eroded and degraded until it 
remains just a pile of splinters and rubble.  he Will Force rating of 
the hymnist is permanently reduced by one.
Destruction (Rating 28/-50%): 1 minute. Causes one object or 
structure no larger than 5 ft3 per Practitioner Title to shatter, melt, 
burn, or otherwise be permanently destroyed, in whichever fashion 
deemed appropriate by the hymnist’s deity. The deity must approve 
of the object being destroyed; if the hymn targets something which 
the deity does not wish to destroy, nothing will happen. The target 
object must be within visual range, including through scrying. 
Once destroyed, the object cannot be magically repaired. Magical 
and divine magical items receive a Magic Resistance, but this hymn 
has no effect on artifacts or living beings.
Determination (Rating 23/-25%): 10 seconds. Permanently restores 
one Will Force point lost within 1 day per Practitioner Title of 
the hymnist, for either the hymnist or 1 listener who follows the 
hymnist’s deity, as long as they make a Piety save upon hearing the 
music of the hymn. This hymn cannot be used to restore Will Force 
which was voluntarily given up. 
Discernment (Rating 20/-10%): 5 seconds. Allows the hymnist and 
all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to identify the divine 
magical powers, abilities, and usages of one particular divine item 
by seeing a glow of light around the being or item appropriate to 
the deity from which the divine magic came and visual indicators 
of the powers and effects.
Discipline (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Grants a +5% bonus per 
2 Practitioner Titles to all Discipline skills for the hymnist and all 
listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity for 1 hour.
Disintegration (Rating 31/-65%): 1 minute. Causes one being, 
object, or area no larger than 50 ft3 per Practitioner Title to 
disintegrate into nothing but dust. The deity must approve of the 
target being destroyed; if the hymn targets something which the 
deity does not wish to destroy, nothing will happen. The target 
object must be within visual range, including through scrying, 
even if it lies on another plane. Magical and divine magical items 
and structures/building materials, as well as living beings, receive a 
Magic Resistance.
Divinity (Rating 19/-5%): 15 seconds. Grants a +5% bonus per 2 
Practitioner Titles to all divine magical skills for the hymnist and 
all listeners who follow the deity of the hymnist for 1 hour.
Doctrine (Rating 19/-5%): 30 seconds. Grants the skill Theology 
specifically in regard to the hymnist’s deity at a chance of 5% per 
Practitioner Title to the hymnist and all listeners who follow the 
deity of the hymnist. Any listeners who already have the skill gain 
a second skill chance rather than adding this chance to their first 
skill. This bonus lasts for 1 minute.
Doubt (Rating 23/-25%): 8 minutes. Causes all listeners who do not 
follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per 
Practitioner Title or doubt the entire doctrine of their own faith, 
resulting in a temporary loss of 2 Piety per Practitioner Title and a 
-5% per Practitioner Title to all saves/resistances against the hymn 
Renunciation or the skill Convert.  This doubt lasts for 2d4 weeks, 
after which the listener loses all doubt and instantly regains the lost 
Piety points.
Endangerment (Rating 16/+10%): 10 seconds. Decreases divine 
protection for all listeners who do not follow the hymnist’s deity, 
inflicting +1 defense adjustment per Practitioner Title and -2% to 
all resistances per Practitioner Title.
Endurance (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Raises the Endurance of 
the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity by 2 
points per Practitioner Title. Additional Endurance points gained 
in this manner fade at a rate of 2 per hour, beginning 1 hour after 
the hymn ends. Damage effects that would kill or maim someone 
with reduced Endurance go into effect immediately when lost 
Endurance would cause the effect, including new vitality saves, etc. 
Enlightenment (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Raises the Knowledge 
rating by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial 
maximum) of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the 
hymnist’s deity. Additional Knowledge points gained in this 
manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes 
after the hymn ends.
Erudition (Rating 19/-5%): 15 seconds. Grants a +5% bonus per 2 
Practitioner Titles to all Informational skills for the hymnist and all 
listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity for 1 hour.
Fear (Rating 23/-25%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners who do not

follow the hymnist’s deity to gain a sudden overwhelming fear of

Faith (Rating 18/+0%): 10 seconds. Instills great faith within the

Foulness (Rating 18/+0%): 20 seconds. Causes the hymnist and

ally per Practitioner Title named in the hymn, contemplating that

possible. All affected listeners must make a Will Force save to 
abstain from any hostile action. These urges fade 5 minutes per

Hesitation (Rating 25/-35%): 10 seconds. Permanently reduces 
the Will Force rating by 1 for 1 listener who does not follow the 
hymnist’s deity, as long as they fail a Piety save upon hearing 
the music of the hymn. This effect can only be used once by a 
practitioner against any specific target (although the target may be 
affected by multiple practitioners). 
Hindrance (Rating 19/-5%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
do not follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance 
at -2% per Practitioner Title or be immobile for 10 seconds per 
Practitioner Title.
History (Rating 21/-15%): 1 minute. Allows the hymnist and 1 
listener per Practitioner Title who follows the hymnist’s deity to 
read the history of an item or living being within physicalcontact 
by gaining a mental feeling or picture of all positive and negative 
things that happened around the item or being for the past 1 week 
per Practitioner Title. Items and beings protected with Non-
Detection are immune to the effects of this hymn, as are artifacts, 
and unwilling targets are allowed a Magic Resistance.
Imbuement (Rating 24/-30%): 10 minutes. Imbues a musical

the same deity. One hymn can be imbued per 2 Practitioner Titles. 
Each hymn imbued causes a permanent loss of ½ a Will Force 
point and requires an additional Hymn Lore skill roll at -20% while 
the instrument is being imbued. Activation time for the hymn is 
1d4+1 seconds, which is set at the time of imbuement. The power 
is always activated at the Class Title of the player using the skill 
Hymn Lore. Although the skill Hymn Lore requires hymns to be 
sung in order to have effect, the Hymn of Imbuement allows an 
instrument to create the effects of any hymn without the hymnist 
having to sing the words.
Injury (Rating 18/+0%): 5 seconds. Inflicts 1d4+1 smashing 
damage per Practitioner Title to one body area named in the 
hymn on each listener who does not follow the hymnist’s deity. For 
instance, the hymnist could mention “head” and inflict damage to 
each target’s head. Targets are afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid

Insight (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Raises the Wisdom rating by 1

hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity. Additional 
Wisdom points gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10

Invitation (Rating 16/+10%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% 
per Practitioner Title or feel compelled to visit the nearest temple 
or worshiping place of that deity, if there is one within 5 miles 
per Practitioner Title. The affected listeners will use any means 
necessary to make their way to the temple for the next 30 minutes 
per Will Force of the listener. If there is no temple within range, the 
listeners feel compelled to cease all current activities and construct 
an altar of worship within the next 1 minute per Will Force. Once 
the listeners reach a temple or constructs an altar, they must spend 
at least 1 minute per Piety worshiping their deity. For the following 
week, every time the listeners come within sight of a temple or altar 
of that deity, they must make a Will Force save or visit the temple 
and worship for another 1 minute per Piety. Those who cannot 
complete their goal within the allotted time must make a Will 
Force save or gain an Insanity of obsession over visiting temples 
of that particular deity (any time they hear of a temple in the area 
or see one, they must go to it and worship, and they must make 
another Will Force save to leave).
Invocation (Rating 19/-5%): 30 seconds. Grants the hymnist and all

Piety Control and halves the prayer time required for invocations. 
This effect lasts for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.
Joy (Rating 17/+5%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners (regardless of

resulting in -1 to Intelligence and Wisdom, +1 to Appearance and

Lethargy (Rating 20/-10%): 5 seconds. Slows weapon speed by 1

the hymnist’s deity for 6d10 seconds.

by all listeners within 10’ per Practitioner Title. The listeners who

Since this is only a representation of the deity and not the actual

Martyrdom (Rating 23/-25%): 10 seconds. Causes 1 willing listener

resistances against hostile attacks. If death occurs within 1 hour per

well as +1 Will Force and +1 Piety per 2 Practitioner Titles. All 
hostile witnesses are -5% Morale per Practitioner Title and must 
make a Will Force save at -5% per 2 Practitioner Titles to attempt 
any hostile action toward anyone who follows the deity of the 
hymnist. These effects last for 1 day per Will Force of the martyr.
Meditation (Rating 18/+0%): 20 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance (if desired) 
at -2% per Practitioner Title or settle into a calm state of mind, 
focusing thoughts and removing anxiety, providing the following 
effects:
•	 A new Control Resistance towards any current controlling 
factors; a +10% Control Resistance for 1 hour
•	 +1 to hit and damage for 1 hour
•	 Current fatigue effects are reduced by half. Fatigue effects for 
the next hour happen twice as slowly (1 minute of fatigue is 
applied per 2 actual minutes).
•	 Any temporary lost attribute points are restored at a rate of 2 
per hour. While each listener is completely at rest, temporarily 
lost attribute points return at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes.
•	 Each listener counts as having one Will Force rating point 
higher when defending against a hostile spell or effect 
which depends on Will Force, such as mental combat, Hold, 
Possession, etc.
Misfortune (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Lowers the Fortune 
of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist’s deity by 2% per 
Practitioner Title. Fortune lost in this manner return at a rate of 1% 
per hour, beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends.
Mourning (Rating 17/+5%): Causes all listeners to make a 
Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title (if desired) or 
uncontrollably weep in grief over the hymn’s subject of loss, 
resulting in a -1 to Intelligence, Wisdom, Appearance, and Charm, 
and a -20% to all Concentration and Morale checks. Each listener 
weeps for 1d4 minutes after the hymn ends.
Nationalism (Rating 18/+0%): 20 seconds. Causes all listeners 
who either reside currently, or have resided in the past, in the 
particular land or nation named in the hymn to be filled with a 
bursting sense of nationalistic pride for 1 hour, gaining +5% to 
Control Resistance, +1 to hit, and -1 defense adjustment (all per 
2 Practitioner Titles) while defending that particular homeland’s 
people or their freedom from invading forces.
Obliviousness (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Lowers the Perception 
of all hostile listeners by 2% per Practitioner Title. Perception lost 
in this manner return at a rate of 1% per hour, beginning 1 hour 
after the hymn ends.
Perception (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Raises the Perception 
of all friendly listeners by 2% per Practitioner Title.  Additional 
Perception gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1% per hour, 
beginning 1 hour after the hymn ends.
Piety (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Raises the Piety rating by 1 
per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of all 
listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity. Additional Piety points 
gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 
30 minutes after the hymn ends.
Praise (Rating 20/-10%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity and 1 listener per Practitioner Title who 
follows another deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per 
Practitioner Title (if desired) or feel an overwhelming sense of awe 
and praise toward the hymnist’s deity, causing all divine effects 
both targeting and originating from the listener to increase by 10% 
per Practitioner Title (including range and duration). For example, 
after hearing the Hymn of Praise sung by a 2nd Practitioner Title 
Harmonist, a listener who invokes Heal rolls 1d4+1 points of 
healing per 2 Piety Control and then adds a bonus of 20% of the 
amount rolled (rounded up, with a minimum of 1). For example, 
if 3d4+3 were rolled and 10 healing was the result, 2 additional 
healing points would be added.
Prophecy (Rating 21/-15%): 1 minute. Allows the hymnist to look 
into the future of the being, place, or event named in the hymn and 
see the most probable outcome. This event is viewed as a mental 
picture with sound. There is no guarantee that the event will 
actually happen, only that it is the most likely future depending 
on current events. The prophesied event will usually be no more 
than 1 day per Practitioner Title into the future, but the Game 
Master may allow for a longer time based on great events to come. 
This hymn may be attempted only once per day. Note: A GM’s 
particular setting may involve a predestined course of events, either 
set by a deity or fate itself. In this case, the prophecy viewed by the 
hymnist will be the absolute future and cannot be altered in any 
way.
Propitiation (Rating 18/-10%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners 
who follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at 
-2% per Practitioner Title (if desired) or perform any necessary 
actions to placate that deity’s revealed anger over a previous action 
committed by the listener. Once the deity’s anger has been revealed 
(either directly or indirectly), a sign is given, either physically or 
mentally, showing each listener what must be done in order to 
placate that deity. Each listener will continue all attempts to follow 
through until the deed is completed and the deity reveals to each 
listener his individual propitiation. This hymn also affects ghosts 
and undead who worshiped that deity while living, even if they 
have the immunity Control (Lesser), as long as they have magical 
hearing.
Protection (Rating 16/+10%): 30 seconds. Provides divine 
protection for the hymnist and all listeners who follow the 
hymnist’s deity, granting -1 defense adjustment per 2 Practitioner 
Titles and +5% to all resistances per 2 Practitioner Titles.
Purity (Rating 15/+15%): 10 seconds. Removes all salt, suspended 
materials, bacteria, viruses, and toxins from all food and water 
within 5’ per Practitioner Title.
Refuge (Rating 18/+0%): 5 seconds. Creates a semi-transparent 
shimmering sphere in a color of the hymnist’s deity’s choosing 
which prohibits magical and divine magical weapons, items, skills, 

===== PAGE 134 =====
128
spells, and invocations from passing through in either direction by 
instantly dispelling them. Supernatural beings with only an essence 
(5 or less in permanent attributes) are returned to their plane of 
origin or are destroyed (in the case of lesser undead) when they 
touch the sphere. This effect is treated as the invocation Sphere of 
Protection.
Renunciation (Rating 26/-40%): 10 minutes. Causes all listeners 
who do not follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance 
at -2% per Practitioner Title or instantly and utterly renounce their 
own faith, with a 1% chance per Practitioner Title of converting to 
the particular deity of the hymnist. This affect is permanent and 
can only be reversed with a new Renunciation hymn sung by a 
follower of the listener’s previous deity or a successful Convert skill 
roll. If no new faith is adopted, the listener is now considered either 
Agnostic or Atheist and loses the ability to perform any divine 
magical skills.
Requiem (Rating 22/-20%): 10 minutes. Causes the soul of one 
being for whom the requiem is written to be immune to all 
transformations to undead and creates an immediate summoning 
of a portal through which that soul may enter the plane of its 
deity in the afterlife, if it had not already. The target must have 
worshiped the hymnist’s deity and been dead less than 1 day per 
Will Force of the target soul.  
Restoration (Rating 24/-30%): 10 minutes. Causes winds of divine 
magic to blow firmly amidst the ruins of one structure or altar 
dedicated to the worship of the hymnist’s deity. As the hymn 
is sung, a shimmering surrounds the rubble and splinters and 
divinely reconstitutes the temple or altar to its former glory, filling 
in areas even if material is missing. The Will Force rating for the 
hymnist is permanently reduced by one. No furnishings save an 
alter or focus of worship are fixed or replaced (a door counts as 
part of the temple and is restored, but a door lock counts as a 
fixture and is not).
Revelation (Rating 22/-20%): 15 seconds. Allows the hymnist and 
all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to detect supernatural 
beings, evil, good, life force, and divine magic within 5’ per 
Practitioner Title of the hymnist. The power of these forces and 
direction are felt by each listener. Once each source is detected, 
each listener can sense their movement and location for as long 
as they remain within range. Each listener can detect only the 
beings initially detected, and any new beings that enter the vicinity 
(within range) are not detected.
Ritualism (Rating 16/+10%): 10 seconds. Grants the hymnist 
and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity a +5% bonus per 
Practitioner Title to each listener’s next single application of any 
skill that requires a ritual to perform, such as Ritual Lore, Sacred 
Grove, Empathy Magic, etc.
Revitalization (Rating 17/+5%): 5 seconds. Instantly removes all 
fatigue from the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s 
deity.
Shielding (Rating 17/+5%): 5 seconds. Creates a divine magical 
shield controllable by the hymnist that can be placed between two 
objects or beings. The shield acts as a barrier and stops attacks 
between the two if the hymnist makes a Piety save.  However, all 
magical and divine magical weapons and effects pass through the 
shield. The Hymn of Shielding cannot block more than one blow 
per second unless two or more blows are simultaneously aimed for 
the same area. In such cases, only a single Piety save is required to 
block the blows. The shield only stops 100 points of damage; any 
amount over 100 will damage the area below the shield. The shield 
can be used to protect any object or being within a 2’ diameter and 
lasts for 10 seconds per Practitioner Title.
Stealth (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Grants a +5% bonus per 2 
Practitioner Titles to all Stealth Intrusive skills for all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity for 1 hour.
Strength (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Raises the Strength rating by 
1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to supersede racial maximum) of all 
listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity. Additional Strength points 
gained in this manner fade at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 
30 minutes after the hymn ends.
Suffocation (Rating 21/-15%): 5 seconds. Causes all hostile listeners 
to make a Magic Resistance or choke, losing 1d6 overall Endurance 
per 10 seconds. At the onset of asphyxiation, a Will Force save 
must be made to remain calm or damage is doubled. When 
Endurance has been reduced to 0, the target appears very pale and 
must make a Vitality save every 5 seconds to remain conscious 
(-5% to the save for every point below 0). Once Endurance reaches 
the target’s negative Vitality rating, the lungs have collapsed and 
the heart stops beating. One minute later, if Endurance is not raised 
above the negative Vitality rating, the target dies. A Chirugeon roll 
will resuscitate the suffocated target and raise overall Endurance 
to 1 point above negative Vitality. Should the target survive the 
ordeal, restoration of Endurance is based on his healing rate, with 
minutes instead of days and a period of 10 minute intervals instead 
of weeks.
Supplication (Rating 20/-10%): 30 seconds. Grants all listening 
invokers who follow the hymnist’s deity the ability to instantly gain 
one invocation no higher in Piety Control than 3 per Practitioner 
Title without having to spend the necessary prayer time, since the 
hymnist supplicates on behalf of the invokers.
Sustenance (Rating 18/+0%): 1 minute. Causes all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity to lose all need for food and water and 
instead rely solely on divine, spiritual sustenance for 1 day per 
Practitioner Title, during which the listener feels neither hunger 
nor thirst and takes no damage or negative effects from lack of 
food and water. Those unwilling are afforded a Control Resistance 
at -2% per Practitioner Title.
Timidity (Rating 22/-20%): 5 seconds. Lowers the Will Force 
rating of all hostile listeners by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles, unless a 
Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made. Will Force 
lost in this manner return at a rate of 1 per hour after the hymn 
ends.
Transformation (Rating 22/-20%): 15 seconds. Temporarily 
transforms the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s 
deity into 1 type of object approved by the deity, no larger 
than 5 ft3 per Practitioner Title. A Magic Resistance avoids this 
transformation if desired. While transformed, each listener appears 
as the object but retains each individual life force. One sense 
(hearing, sight, touch, smell, or taste) per 2 Practitioner Titles may 
be retained while transformed. This transformation begins as soon 
as the hymn ends, takes 1d4 seconds to complete, and lasts for 1 
minute per Practitioner Title. If the deity does not approve of the 
listeners transforming into the type of object stated in the hymn, 
that deity may choose to either transform them into something 
else instead or do nothing. Also, each effected being can spend 1 
Will Force permanently to stay transformed indefinitely. Dispel 

===== PAGE 135 =====
129
Divinity, Restore Form, Wish, or Miracle then would be required 
to restore a being to normal form. 
Warfare (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Grants a +5% bonus per 2 
Practitioner Titles to all Combat skills for all listeners who follow 
the hymnist’s deity for 1 hour.
Velocity (Rating 20/-10%): 5 seconds. Quickens weapon speed by 1 
second per 3 Practitioner Titles, not to go below minimum weapon 
speed, for the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s 
deity for 6d10 seconds.
Vision (Rating 18/+0%): 10 seconds. Grants either Enhanced 
Night Vision, Infravision, Ultravision, or Exceptional Eyesight 
(whichever is named in the hymn) to all listeners who follow the 
hymnist’s deity for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.
Zeal (Rating 20/-10%): 15 seconds. Causes 1 listener per 
Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance at -2% per 
Practitioner Title or feel enthusiastic devotion and tireless 
diligence toward one specific being, location, object, or idea stated 
in the hymn, negating all indifferent feelings and canceling any 
preconceived plans to act accordingly. All affected listeners must 
make a modified Will Force save to avoid performing any action 
that would prove their new zeal toward the stated target. This 
feeling of zeal lasts for 30 minutes per Practitioner Title.
Restricted Hymns (Good):
Absolution (Rating 20/-10%): 10 seconds. Causes the sins of 
the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to 
be absolved by that deity, permanently removing all negative 
alignment checks. Furthermore, any undead within 5’ per 
Practitioner Title who worshiped the hymnist’s deity while living 
have a 10% chance per Practitioner Title of being destroyed and 
moving on to the plane of that deity.
Altruism (Rating 18/+0%): 10 seconds. Causes 1 listener per 
Practitioner Title who does not follow the hymnist’s deity to make 
a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel a sense 
of total selflessness and genuine concern for the welfare of others 
(regardless of their alignment), resulting in a Will Force save at 
-5% per Practitioner Title to perform any action that would in any 
way be considered selfish or greedy (at the GM’s discretion). For 
example, this hymn would affect the listener’s attempt at the skills 
Cheat and Steal, or a claim to a newly found magical item or object 
of value. Furthermore, the listener must make a Will Force save at 
-5% per Practitioner Title or either help those in need or defend 
them, either in conversation or in combat. This feeling of altruism 
lasts for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.
Amenity (Rating 16/+10%): 20 seconds. Increases the Appearance 
and Charm of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the 
hymnist’s deity by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles while speaking about 
that deity or performing a skill in that deity’s name, such as Bless, 
Convert, Exorcism, Hymn Lore, etc. This effect lasts for 10 minutes 
per Practitioner Title.
Apology (Rating 16/+10%): 20 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% 
per Practitioner Title or feel the sudden urge to apologize to 1d4 
people against whom the listener caused a grievance within the 
past 1 day per Practitioner Title. The affected listener will perform 
any necessary actions (without going against his alignment) to 
communicate with that person, no matter the cost, and will not rest 
until the apology has been made, no matter how long it takes.
Beauty (Rating 18/+0%): 20 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity and 1 listener per Practitioner Title 
who follows another deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% 
per Practitioner Title or scrutinize 1 enemy per Practitioner 
Title named in the hymn, viewing that enemy’s inner beauty and 
recognizing any redeeming qualities. All affected listeners feel 
obligated to act mercifully, attempting to avoid violence by any 
means possible. All hostile actions must be superseded with a Will 
Force save. These urges fade 5 minutes per Practitioner Title after 
the hymn ends.
Benediction (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Bestows a blessing 
upon the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity, 
granting +1 to hit and +5% to all resistance rolls per 3 Practitioner 
Titles, lasting 1 hour.
Call Celestial (Rating 23/-40%): 10 minutes. Summons or dismisses 
a Good-aligned supernatural servant by name (the hymnist must 
know the true name of the servant to summon or dismiss), either 
of which cannot be resisted by the servant. When summoning, 
control is automatically granted to the hymnist if the deity wishes 
it, unless the supernatural servant is immune to control. When 
dismissing, the servant must remain within earshot of the hymnist 
during the entire 10 minutes of the hymn.
Comfort (Rating 16/+10%): 10 seconds. Removes all physical 
and emotional pain, hunger, and thirst from the hymnist and all 
listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity for 1d4 minutes.
Confession (Rating 19/-5%): 15 seconds. Causes 1 listener per 
Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance at -2% per 
Practitioner Title or feel obligated to confess the truth about 
anything about which he had previously lied during any point in 
his life. While under affect, the listener must answer all questions 
truthfully but will not mention any other lies until brought up by 
someone else. The listener will confess only to the hymnist, and 
this obligation ends after 1 minute per Practitioner Title.
Courage (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Instills in all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity a sense of courage, gaining the following 
positive effects for 1 hour per Practitioner Title:
•	 +1 damage per die to melee and missile weapons in combat
•	 +2 to hit with melee and missile weapons in combat
•	 -2 initiative in combat
•	 +5% to Control Resistance per 3 Practitioner Titles of the 
hymnist
•	 Affected beings can go Berserk if they so desire at 5% chance 
per 3 Practitioner Titles of the hymnist
•	 +10% to morale checks
Creation (Rating Varies, See Below): 10 minutes. Allows the 
hymnist to create divine magical goods. The hymnist imagines 
what he wants to create and then makes his Hymn Lore skill roll. If 
successful, he begins creating an illusion in the air of the item to be 
created, adding to it with note and chord, word and refrain. When 
the hymn is complete, the item becomes real and is considered to 
be +1 divine magical per 3 Practitioner Titles with a base 2 Piety 
Control per Class Title of the hymnist.
