Fellowship (Rating 19/-5%): 20 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity to feel a close bonding with each other, 
gaining a total of +2% per Practitioner Title when collectively 
attempting to Commune with their deity. The affected listeners also 
gain +30% to morale and +5% per Practitioner Title to all skills 
performed on each other (such as Cure Poison, Bless, Mind Dance, 
etc.). These effects last for 1 hour.
Forgiveness (Rating 21/-15%): 15 seconds. Causes all listeners 
who follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at 
-2% per Practitioner Title or forgive all personal debts or grudges 
previously held. This ends all desires for revenge or animosity, 
resulting in a -20% per Practitioner Title to Will Force rolls in 
collecting debts or taking hostile actions against anyone the listener 
has forgiven. Note: If the listener is a Revenant who worshiped 
the hymnist’s deity while living, he no longer is affected by the 
disability Compulsion: Task and falls lifeless to the ground, no 
longer an undead creature, but just a mundane corpse.
Glorification (Rating 17/+5%): 5 seconds. Glorifies the hymnist’s 
deity, resulting in a gain of 1 point of Fortune per Practitioner Title 
(as per the invocation) for the hymnist and all listeners who follow 
the hymnist’s deity, +5% per 2 Practitioner Titles to all divine 
magical skills, and +5% Control Resistance per 2 Practitioner Titles 
against any ill effects originating from a being who does not follow 
that deity. These effects last for 1 hour. In addition, the glorified 
deity may choose to intervene or additionally aid its followers in 
some way (at the GM’s discretion).
Health (Rating 19/-5%): 10 seconds. Grants a +2% per Practitioner 
Title bonus to Poison and Disease Resistances for 1 hour to all 
listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity and instantly heals 1d4+1 
per Practitioner Title to the most wounded area of each affected 
listener.
Humility (Rating 17/+5%): 5 seconds. Causes the hymnist and 
all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control 
Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or lose all sense of pride 
and instead be filled with humility and meekness, resulting in 
+1 Charm and +1 Piety per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to exceed 
racial maximum), as well as the need to make a Will Force save 
at -5% per Practitioner Title to perform any action that would 
be considered prideful or boastful (at the GM’s discretion). This 
would include showing off a skill to others or taking undeserved 
credit. These effects last for 1 hour.
Justice (Rating 20/-10%): 10 seconds. Causes all non-magical and 
non-divine locks and bindings (including rope, cuffs, etc.) to open 
within 1’ per Practitioner Title of the hymnist and all listeners 
who follow the hymnist’s deity who are currently being held or 
imprisoned unjustly (such as for committing a crime they did not 
commit or preaching on behalf of their deity).
Illumination (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds. Creates a divine magical 
bright sphere of light with a radius of 3’ per Will Force of the 
hymnist no further than 5’ away per Will Force point. The sphere 
can either be centered on a moveable object or being or  be fixed in 
one place. The illumination radius for normal sight is 5’ per Piety 
rating of the hymnist. The light is a soft, slowly intensifying light 
which lasts 15 minutes per Practitioner Title. Only one globe per 
Practitioner Title may be active.
Inhibition (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per 
Practitioner Title or avoid all actions, beings, and places considered 
immoral or evil in any way for 1 hour.
Judgment (Rating 32/-70%): 10 seconds. Causes all non-living souls 
(i.e. ghosts and souled undead) within 5’ per Practitioner Title to 
be instantly judged by their particular deities as either deserving or 
undeserving of moving on to the planes of those deities, whether 
good, neutral, or evil. Whether or not the deity decides to allow the 
affected souls to move on is completely at the GM’s discretion and 
must be based on both the particular values and ideals of the deity 
and the actions committed by the souls. If a deity decides the soul 
is unworthy of moving on and finding peace, that soul remains 
in its current state and may not be judged again by this hymn, no 
matter the practitioner.
Loyalty (Rating 18/+0%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per 
Practitioner Title or become extremely loyal to a particular cause 
or being, resulting in a -5% per Practitioner Title to Will Force 
saves when attempting to go against anything which furthers that 
cause or is requested by that being, and will attempt to defend the 
cause or being at all costs. Furthermore, all affected listeners gain 
+20% to morale whenever within the vicinity of the being or acting 
for the good of that being or cause.
Noontide (Rating 23/-25%): 10 seconds. Creates a sphere of true 
day, even at night, brightened with natural sunlight. All beings 
within the sphere are affected as if it were day. All effects which 
are dependent upon sunlight or daytime apply, regardless of the 
actual time. Thus, within the sphere of the Hymn of Noontide, a 
Lesser Vampire who is normally active at night will be immobilized 
and burn from sunlight as if it were actually exposed to the sun. 
The sphere, which has a radius of 10’ per Practitioner Title, is 
centered on a fixed location (up to 2’ per Practitioner Title from 

===== PAGE 137 =====
131
the hymnist) when created and cannot be moved, and it lasts for 
10 minutes per Practitioner Title. The hymns of Twilight and 
Midnight will override the Hymn of Noontide if the latter hymnist 
makes his Hymn Lore roll by more than the previous hymnist.
Peace (Rating 20/-10%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners to make 
a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or temporarily 
cease all hostile actions against each other, including derogatory 
words and offensive attacks. This hymn does not affect thoughts or 
emotions but rather provides control over each listener’s physical 
portrayal of those thoughts or emotions.  Furthermore, those who 
fall under the hymn’s affect will also attempt to convince those still 
unaffected to cease hostile actions. For every 10 seconds the hymn 
continues, all listeners who have not yet succumbed to peace must 
make a new Control Resistance with a penalty of an additional 
cumulative -5%. The hymn cannot last more than 10 minutes total, 
and once the hymn is over, the temporary peace instantly and 
abruptly ends and all listeners are free to take whichever action 
they wish.
Prudence (Rating 15/+15%): 15 seconds. Raises the Will Force 
saves of all listeners by 5% per 2 Practitioner Titles when being 
tempted to take any action that would be considered evil, resulting 
in possible alignment checks. This effect lasts for 2 hours after the 
hymn ends. 
Purging (Rating 20/-10%): 1 minute. Instantly purges 1 named 
poison, disease, type of insanity, or possession per Practitioner 
Title from all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity, as long as 
they make a Piety save upon hearing the music of the hymn.  This 
hymn has no effect on curses or lycanthropy.
Purification (Rating 23/-25%): 10 minutes. Instantly cures all 
listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity of lycanthropy, as long 
as the listeners make a Piety save upon hearing the music of the 
hymn.
Regeneration (Rating 21/-15%): 10 seconds. Heals any one existing 
body area with less than 1 Endurance to exactly 1 Endurance, 
affecting the hymnist and 1 listener per Practitioner Title who 
follows the hymnist’s deity. All missing limbs of the affected 
listeners are instantaneously regenerated at the cost of 1 Will Force 
per limb restored. The Will Force cost is permanently paid by 
either the target or the hymnist. Vital areas that have been severed 
will not be regenerated. Multiple sub-areas regenerated (such as 
several fingers on the same hand) count as one limb.
Repentance (Rating 16/+10%): 10 seconds. Causes the hymnist 
and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to sincerely repent 
of all previously committed sins since their last act of repentance. 
All affected listeners gain +1 Piety per 2 Practitioner Titles, 2 
Fortune points per Practitioner Title (as per the invocation), and 
+5% Control Resistance per 2 Practitioner Titles against any Evil-
aligned hymn or invocation that affects one’s actions, such as the 
Hymn of Temptation or the invocation Aggression. These effects 
last for 1 hour. Furthermore, upon repenting of any actions that 
resulted in negative Alignment checks, the deity may decide to 
remove those Alignment checks (at the GM’s discretion).
Resurrection (Rating 25/-35%): 10 minutes. Restores life to one 
recently deceased being who, in life, worshiped the hymnist’s deity, 
as long as the deceased target’s ghost makes a Piety save upon 
hearing the music of the hymn. Once the soul is returned to the 
body, one Will Force is permanently drained from the recipient. 
Furthermore, all bodily damage is removed, but any missing 
limbs remain missing. The body is in a weakened state, with all 
attributes drained to one. One attribute point for each attribute 
will be restored for each hour of complete rest. This hymn may be 
attempted on a deceased individual only once, regardless of the 
number of hymnists available to perform the hymn. Each hymnist 
is limited in use of this hymn to a number of times each day equal 
to their Class Title.
Salvation (Rating 28/-50%): 5 seconds. Invokes salvation for the 
hymnist and all listeners who either follow that deity or an allied 
deity from all hostile or potentially fatal beings, places, or events by 
intervening and miraculously removing that danger in whichever 
way that deity chooses. For example, if the hymn is being sung 
while a fatal avalanche is heading down a mountain slope toward 
the hymnist, the deity may choose to either halt the avalanche or 
remove the hymnist from the slope; or, if a band of goblins has 
ambushed the hymnist’s party of adventurers and is injuring them 
with arrows, the deity may choose to strike the goblins dead or 
cause the arrows to reflect off the adventurers and return back 
to the goblins. The means of salvation is completely at the GM’s 
discretion. However, if the GM decides that the hymnist does not 
warrant salvation or that removing the danger does not fit into the 
deity’s predestined plan, nothing happens. This hymn may only be 
sung once per month, and any further attempts or attempts during 
non-desperate situations may invoke the anger and wrath of that 
particular deity, resulting in divine denial.
Sanctification (Rating 22/-20%): 1 minute. Causes all listeners who 
follow an Evil or Neutral-Evil deity to make a Control Resistance or 
become morally sanctified for the duration, resulting in desires to 
serve, help, heal others, and serve the cause of good. The normally 
belligerent and violent being would become friendly and peaceful, 
in all except the most extreme of circumstances. Thirty minutes per 
Practitioner Title after the hymn ends, each affected listener reverts 
back to their previous alignment and loses all memory of events 
that transpired while transformed.
Splendor (Rating 20/-10%): 10 seconds. Creates a divine magical 
sphere of intensely glowing light no further away than 2’ per Will 
Force point. The sphere is centered on a fixed location and will 
not move from the location where it is created. The light is so 
bright that it blinds beings and creatures with night vision (non-
enhanced), even the hymnist, if applicable. All negative life force 
beings within a radius of 10’ per Practitioner Title are temporarily 
drained of 1 Will Force point per 10 seconds if they fail a Control 
Resistance in that 10 second period. The globe lasts 15 minutes per 
Practitioner Title, and only one globe may be active at a time.
Submission (Rating 22/-20%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per 
Practitioner Title or follow all commands given by the hymnist, 
as long as those commands do not go against the morals and 
commands of that deity, for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.
Thanksgiving (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Endows all listeners 
who follow the hymnist’s deity with an overwhelming thankfulness 
toward that particular deity for every fortune bestowed within the 
past 2 months per Practitioner Title, gaining +2 Piety and Wisdom 
and +15% to Morale. The listener must also make a Will Force 
save at -5% per 2 Practitioner Titles before attempting the skills 
Begging, Cheat, Gambling, Harlotry, Lie, Steal, or Torturing.
Tolerance (Rating 16/+10%): 10 seconds. Temporarily removes all 
effects of Xenophobia from the hymnist and all listeners for 1 hour.

Truth (Rating 19/-5%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners to make a 
Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or speak only the 
truth and be completely unable to lie in any way for 1d4 minutes. 
Affected beings can choose to remain silent. 
Virtue (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds. Causes the hymnist and all 
listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner 
Title or be unable to say or do anything that would be considered 
immoral or evil for 1 hour.
Restricted Hymns (Neutral):
Aeromancy (Rating 19/-5%): 1 minute. Grants a +5% per 
Practitioner Title bonus to the hymnist and all listeners to the 
following for 1 hour:
•	 Skills: Call of Air, Electrokinesis, Levitation, Summon 
Supernatural (when targeting an air elemental)
•	 Candle Lore rituals: Death Stench, Endure Electricity, Sense 
Elemental (when sensing air elementals)
•	 Ritual Lore rituals: Enhanced Breath, Guide Wind, Weather
•	 Poems: Springing, Weather
•	 Songs: Cloudwalk, Electricity, Flying
•	 Runes: Cloudblend, Warding vs. Air Elemental

Titles to the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s 
deity when performing the skills Potion Lore, Elixir, Matter Lore, 
and Transmutation for 1 hour.
Ancestry (Rating 18/+0%): 1 minute. Allows either the hymnist 
or 1 listener who follows the hymnist’s deity to summon a spirit 
of one of his deceased ancestors. The summoner can either allow 
the ancestor’s spirit to occupy his body and speak through it 
for a period of 1 minute per Practitioner Title, or he can simply 
mentally converse with the spirit for the same period. There are no 
guarantees that the spirit will speak or give the correct answers, but 
the spirit will not try to forcefully inhabit the body. The spirit can 
remain in the body no longer than 5 minutes per Practitioner Title.
Animalism (Rating 23/-25%): 10 seconds. Allows the hymnist and 
all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to assume the shape 
of any type of animal for up to 1 hour per Practitioner Title and 
return to their natural form when desired.  
Apathy (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Causes the hymnist and 1 
listener per Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance at 
-2% per Practitioner Title or feel indifferent toward one specific 
being, location, object, or idea stated in the hymn, negating all 
negative or positive feelings and canceling any preconceived plans 
to act accordingly. This feeling of indifference, in effect turning the 
listener’s alignment to True Neutral in regards to the target, lasts 
for 30 minutes per Practitioner Title.
Arborism (Rating 20/-10%%): 10 seconds. Allows the hymnist 
and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to communicate 
with up to 1 particular tree per Practitioner Title, which become 
aware of what has happened to and around them, with an intellect 
with mental attributes rating roughly equal to the hymnist. One 
of those trees also temporarily gains independent sapience and 
mobility, gaining the skill Life Sense, a magical voice, and a keen 
sense of hearing through vibrations. This tree has dim and clouded 
memories of its previous life as a non-sapient plant. See the skill 
Awaken Plant for more specific tree characteristics. All of these 
effects last for 5 minutes per Practitioner Title.
Aridity (Rating 16/+10%): 10 seconds. This hymn provides four 
possible effects, depending on the specific verse sung in this hymn. 
Only one effect can be gained from each verse, and the hymnist 
must make a new skill roll for each verse.
•	 Decreases humidity and increases aridity in the air by 10% per 
Practitioner Title in an area around the hymnist with a radius 
of no larger than 10’ per Practitioner Title
•	 Causes up to 1 gallon per Practitioner Title of non-magical 
water or water-based liquid to rapidly evaporate. For water-
based liquids, all water is evaporated, leaving a dry residue 
powder consisting of the ingredients.
•	 Inflicts 1d4 per 2 Practitioner Titles to water elementals to 
a single random location every 10 seconds unless a Magic 
Resistance is made. If the elemental has been summoned from 
another plane, there is a 1% chance per Practitioner Title of 
banishing the creature to its home plane.
•	 Causes all moisture (including sweat) to be removed from a 
single random location on the epidermal layer of all beings 
within a radius of 10’ per Practitioner Title, resulting in dried 
skin
Benevolence (Rating 18/+0%): Causes the hymnist and all listeners 
to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or 
feel a strong sense of generosity (regardless of their alignment), 
resulting in a Will Force save at -5% per 2 Practitioner Titles to 
avoid sharing something of value with someone else that as of yet 
has been solely in possession of the listener’s. For example, this 
hymn would cause a rogue to equally share with her cohorts or 
friends any coins she found while alone or undetected, whereas 
normally she would most likely keep her find a secret and horde it 
for herself. This feeling of benevolence lasts only until the listener 
has performed a single act of generosity, after which all normal 
urges return.
Call Deva (Rating 23/-40%): 10 minutes. Summons or dismisses a 
Neutral-aligned supernatural servant by name (the hymnist must 
know the true name of the servant to summon or dismiss), either 
of which cannot be resisted by the servant. When summoning, 
control is automatically granted to the hymnist if the deity wishes 
it, unless the supernatural servant is immune to control. When 
dismissing, the servant must remain within earshot of the hymnist 
during the entire 10 minutes of the hymn.
Clairvoyance (Rating 20/-10%): 5 seconds. Grants the hymnist 
and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity the ability to 
read images from or project images into the minds of each other, 
whether they are awake, unconscious, or in a meditative state. 
Images can be read or projected for 1 minute per Practitioner Title 
of the hymnist. Those protected by spells or powers like Mind Set 
are immune to the effects of this hymn. This hymn does not allow 
for listeners to initiate mental combat.
Cognition (Rating 20/-10%): 15 seconds. Grants temporary 
sapience to one non-magical plant or slime, or an area of stone, 
sand, earth, or water (no larger than 10 ft2 per Practitioner Title) 
touched by the hymnist, causing it to become temporarily and 
dimly aware and allowing it to remember all that has transpired 
around it in its lifetime as feelings and impressions. Since these 
targets have no sight, they cannot give visual images. The target 
cannot speak but communicates through thoughts and impressions 
to the hymnist. The Game Master is the judge of just how much 
information the target can give.
Conjuration (Rating 23/-25%): 10 seconds. Conjures one neutral-
aligned elemental (fire, water, etc.), which is automatically under 
control of the hymnist. The elemental’s type is determined by the 
hymnist’s deity and must emerge from a source of its composition

(for instance, a fire elemental could appear from a campfire, a

the similar invocation type (Summon Water Elemental, etc.) and is 
considered to be at 2 Piety Control per Practitioner Title.

Decay (Rating 19/-5%): 5 seconds. Causes 1 named body area on all 
listeners who do not follow the hymnist’s deity to slowly decay as if 
the body area were dead, requiring a successful Magic Resistance 
or suffering the loss 1d4 damage per Practitioner Title per 10 
seconds.
Decomposition (Rating 22/-20%): 5 seconds. Causes 1d4 body 
areas (chosen by the deity) on all listeners who do not follow the 
hymnist’s deity to quickly decompose as if the body areas were 
dead, requiring a successful Magic Resistance or suffering 2d6 
damage per Practitioner Title per 10 seconds.
Deterioration (Rating 20/-10%): 5 seconds. Causes 1 non-living 
object touched by the hymnist to deteriorate as if quickly moving 
forward through time, resulting in a loss of 1d6 Object Strength 
per 10 seconds. Magical and divine magical items are afforded a 
Magic Resistance, but artifacts and living beings are immune to the 
effects of this hymn.
Diminishment (Rating 18/+0%): 10 seconds. Causes either one 
being, animal, plant, or object to decrease in size by 5% per 
Practitioner Title, with a minimum size of 1%. Unwilling targets 
are afforded a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title, and 
magical and divine magical items are afforded a Magic Resistance. 
The target’s size remains diminished for 5 minutes per Practitioner 
Title, after which it reverts back.

Earth (Rating 25/-35%): 10 seconds. Causes the earth to tremble 
and shake, damaging buildings and causing fear and uncertainty 
to those unfamiliar with its effects, in an area up to 1 mile away 
per Practitioner Title within sight of the hymnist.  The size of the 
area affected is determined by the hymnist’s deity. The first 40 
seconds of the earthquake has no measurable effect as the power 
of the earthquake builds. After the initial buildup, the effects are as 
follows:
•	 Epicenter: structures suffer 10d8 structural damage per 10 
seconds of the quake. All non-flying individuals will be thrown 
to the ground. A 1% chance per Practitioner Title exists that 
the ground breaks open beneath any enemies who will suffer 
10d6 crushing damage per 10 seconds after falling in. After 
1 minute of falling into an earthquake fissure, beings will 
begin to suffocate. Morale checks are required at -50% or GM 
characters flee in random directions.
•	 ½ mile per Practitioner Title from the epicenter: structures 
take 8d6 structural damage per 10 seconds of the quake.  All 
individuals must make an Agility save once per 10 seconds or 
be thrown to the ground. Morale checks are required or GMCs 
flee in random directions.
•	 1 mile per Practitioner Title from the epicenter: structures take 
4d6 structural damage per 10 seconds of the quake.
•	 10 miles per Practitioner Title from the epicenter: tremors 
from the quake can be felt.
•	 100 miles per Practitioner Title from the epicenter: beings with 
Depth Knowledge can feel the rumblings of the quake and can 
determine the approximate direction to the epicenter.
Buildings constructed to withstand earthquakes, as well as 
reinforced buildings of high-quality manufacture, suffer only ½ 
damage from the earthquake.
Elementalism (Rating 23/-25%): 10 seconds. Allows the hymnist 
or 1 listener who follows the hymnist’s deity to transform into a 
neutral-aligned elemental for 1 minute per Practitioner Title. The 
type of element into which the being transforms is as if they have 
cast the corresponding invocation (Elemental Water Form, etc.) 
at 2 Piety Control per Practitioner Title. The necessary element 
must be within 1’ per Practitioner Title; for instance, if the hymnist 
wishes to transform into a water elemental, he must be within 
range of water (a puddle, filled water skin, lake, etc.). This hymn 
does not allow for transforming into life or death elementals.
Evocation (Rating 25/-35%): 1 minute. Grants the ability to 
evoke the power of an animal to the hymnist and 1 listener per 
Practitioner Title who follows the hymnist’s deity. The deity 
chooses which animal’s characteristic will be evoked for each 
affected listener, unless that listener already has a totem animal. 
This transformation, visible or not, takes place after 1 minute 
and lasts for as long as the hymnist sings. Once the hymn ends, 
all evocation fades. Only one ability may be evoked during each 
singing session. Anyone who does not wish to evoke is afforded a 
Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title.
Fertilization (Rating 21/-15%): 10 minutes. Causes a large area 
(25’ radius per Practitioner Title) to become imbued with positive 
life energy, providing a tranquil feeling which draws all manner 
of living things to it. For each hour within the area affected by 
this hymn, waking beings are healed at their healing rate as if

Immaterialism (Rating 18/+0%): 10 seconds. Causes an area or 
object within a 5’ radius per Practitioner Title and no larger in size 
than 3 ft2 per Practitioner Title to seem to disappear as if it did not 
exist. This is only an illusion, however, and may be countered with 
an Illusion Resistance. This hymn causes objects to remain unseen 
for 1 minute per Practitioner Title. Movement of the affected object 
or area (i.e. leaves of a tree rustling in the breeze) immediately 
breaks this effect.
Lunacy (Rating 19/-5%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners who do 
not follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% 
per Practitioner Title or be inflicted with simple schizophrenia, 
resulting in the inability to separate reality from fantasy and 
experience illusions of sound, sometimes sight and (very rarely) 
touch. This insanity begins the next time the moon is full, whether 
it is that night or several weeks later. Once the full moon sets, the 
effects fade. This lunacy will occur over the next 1 full moon per 
Practitioner Title.
Mediocrity (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners to 
make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or drift 
toward a Passive Neutral alignment, viewing things in “convenient” 
terms and avoiding confrontation and any actions that would be 
considered either purely good or purely evil. If confronted with 
combat, all affected listeners will attempt to flee or otherwise 
secure themselves. No Good- or Evil-aligned spells, invocations, 
or skills may be performed (such as the invocations Aggression 
or Heal, the spell Call Undead, or the skills Bless and Blasphemy). 
These effects last for 1 hour.
Mysticism (Rating 21/-15%): 1 minute. Grants the hymnist and 
all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity the ability to detect all 
supernatural beings and sources of divinity, visible or invisible, 
within 10’ per Practitioner Title, as well as a +2% per Practitioner 
Title to Commune chance for 1 hour.
Naturism (Rating 23/-25%): 1 minute. Allows the hymnist and 
all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to communicate 
through mental images with the nature around them, including 
trees and plants, animals, water, earth, stone, and air, by entering 
a meditative and primal, bestial state. Affected listeners also gain 
the ability to understand nature’s forces, its ecosystems, weather 
patterns, migrations, eruptions, etc. While in effect, all mental and 
social attributes of each listener are reduced to 4, and listeners are 
incapable of reacting to speech and body language of non-animal 
or plant living beings, excluding each other. By entering this primal 
state, each listener can communicate with nature through touch (in 
the case of the physical elements, such as stone and wood), mind 
(in the case of mentally contacting animals), and breathing (in 
the case of air). After 1 minute per Practitioner Title, each listener 
rises from this primal state and attributes are returned to normal, 
but they retain all memory of feelings, actions, and imagery which 
occurred while under the effects of the hymn.
Neutralization (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Permanently 
neutralizes any acid or base substance and removes all beneficial 
or ill effects from intoxicants, non-magical herbs, and alcohol. 
When targeting an acid or base substance, both salt and ionizing 
materials are extracted. All targeted substances must be within

the hymnist’s aura field while the hymn is being sung, meaning

and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity from being 
magically healed or wounded through use of skills, spells, 
invocations, or herbs, as well as any magical regeneration or 
degeneration of limbs, for a total of 1d4 minutes per Practitioner 
Title. Effects that cause damage by introducing a magical energy 
(Finger of Fire, Storm of Daggers, etc.) still work normally.

Recompense (Rating 20/-10%): 5 seconds. Causes any future 
damage inflicted (whether magical, divine magical, or mundane) 
on the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to 
be also inflicted on the being or item which causes that damage, 
no matter where the inflictor is (even if on another plane). The 
targeted being is allowed a Magic Resistance to avoid each effect. 
All reciprocal damage is applied one second after the initial 
damage and must be the exact amount. Each listener is afforded 
recompense in this way for up to 1 act of receiving damage per 
Practitioner Title. For example, if a 1st Practitioner Title hymnist 
takes 13 points of cutting damage to her left arm from a warrior’s 
sword, the warrior receives 13 points of cutting damage to his own 
left arm in the next second if he fails a Magic Resistance. Since 
this reciprocal damage is divine in nature, it occurs directly to the 
object or being, surpassing all hide, physical armor, and spiritual/
force armor. Damage includes any and all physical effects, diseases, 
and insanity. Only ill effects inflicted 5 seconds after this hymn 
begins are recompensed in this way, not any previous damage.
Reincarnation (Rating 21/-15%): 10 minutes. Redirects the soul of 
an individual who followed the hymnist’s deity while alive into the 
body of another being at the time of its birth. The deity chooses the 
vessel in which to place the redirected soul, and the hymnist has no 
say in the matter. The new body will have just been born or have 
animal intelligence and must be within 5 miles per Practitioner 
Title of the hymnist. Also, the incarnate loses one Will Force point 
permanently at the time of its birth.
Rejuvenation (Rating 18/+0%): 2 minutes. Counteracts unnatural 
aging effects of either the hymnist, one listener who follows 
the hymnist’s deity, one animal, or one plant, restoring any lost 
characteristics brought on by the aging effects. While the reverse-
aging effects of Rejuvenation still occur on the body of the 
deceased, this hymn will not restore the life of the deceased. This 
hymn has no effect on natural aging effects and does not restore 
permanently lost Will Force rating points.
Savagery (Rating 17+5%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners to make 
a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or go berserk, as 
the skill Berserk.
Seasons (Rating 24/-30%): 10 minutes. Causes the area around 
the hymnist with a radius of 100 ft2 per Practitioner Title to 
quickly change over to the opposite season, resulting in a change 
of temperature, vegetation, amount of sunlight, and current 
population of wildlife. For example, the Hymn of Seasons would 
transform a forested area in winter to that of summer, therefore 
causing vegetation to sprout its mature foliage, any hibernating 
animals to awaken, flowers to bloom, and the sun to appear 
higher in the sky (if a planetary axial tilt exists in the setting). This 
seasonal change lasts for 1 hour per Practitioner Title, after which 
the area reverts back to its previous state over the next 1 hour 
(flowers die, animals go back to sleep, etc.).
Spirit (Rating 20/-10%): 1 minute. Allows the hymnist and all 
listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity to fall into a meditative 
state and communicate with any bodiless spirits within a radius 
of 50’ per Practitioner Title. Knowledge of the spirits’ true names 
is not required, since this hymn does not allow for the calling of 
specific spirits. The effected listeners remain in this state, able to 
communicate with spirits, for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.
Twilight (Rating 23/-25%): 10 seconds. Creates a sphere with 
a radius of 10’ per Practitioner Title, up to 2’ per Practitioner 
Title away from the hymnist, where both light and darkness are 
suppressed, resulting in a shadowy, gray area devoid of bright 
light or deep darkness. Neither the living nor the dead receive 
any bonuses or penalties within the affected area. The sphere is 
centered on a fixed location when created and cannot be moved, 
and it lasts for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title. The hymns of 
Noontide and Midnight will override the Hymn of Twilight if 
the latter hymnist makes his Hymn Lore roll by more than the 
previous hymnist.
Volcanism (Rating 30/-60%): 10 minutes. Causes one active 
volcano within sight to suddenly erupt, spitting hot gases, smoke, 
and lava into the air and into the vicinity of the volcano. See 
Volcanic Eruptions in Legends of the Unknown. This will only 
occur if the hymnist’s deity wishes for the volcano to erupt (at the 
GM’s discretion). The lethality and duration of the eruption are 
determined by conditions of the existing volcano. 
Winds (Rating 18/+0%): 10 seconds. Creates a steady gust of 
wind moving 5 miles per hour per Practitioner Title which blows 
throughout an area with a 10’ radius per Practitioner Title from 
the hymnist, causing objects to be tossed about. When this wind 
is felt upon bare skin and breathed in deeply, the hymnist and 
all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity are granted the skills 
Balance, Listen, Meditate, and Smell at 10% per Practitioner Title, 
lasting for as long as the listener remains within the wind. The 
wind lasts for 5 minutes per Practitioner Title. Furthermore, all 
affected listeners have a 1% chance per Practitioner Title of being 
soothed and cured of insanity, as per the skills, as soon as they feel 
the wind.
Witchcraft (Rating 20/-10%): 1 minute. Grants the hymnist and 
all listeners who follow the hymnist’s deity a +5% bonus per 
Practitioner Titles to the skills Candle Lore, Curse, Detect Curse, 
Empathy Magic, Herb Lore, Potion Lore, Ritual Lore, Speak to 
Dead, and Sympathy Magic.
Restricted Hymns (Evil):

===== PAGE 142 =====
136
Abomination (Rating 24/-30%): 5 minutes. Creates either 3 lesser 
undead or 1 greater undead per 2 Practitioner Titles from the 
corpses of those who, while living, followed the hymnist’s deity, by 
infusing those corpses the hymnist touches with negative life force. 
The type of undead is based upon the corpse and the conditions of 
its death (see Epitaph of the Fallen).
Animosity (Rating 20/-10%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners 
to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title 
or suddenly take hostile action against each other, including 
derogatory words and offensive attacks. This hymn does not affect 
thoughts or emotions but rather releases control over each listener’s 
innermost evil, immoral desires, and hidden, buried dislikes of 
those around them. Furthermore, those who fall under this hymn’s 
affect will also attempt to convince those who have not yet taken 
hostile action to do so. For every 10 seconds the hymn continues, 
all listeners who have not yet succumbed to animosity must make 
a new Control Resistance with a cumulative 5% penalty. This hymn 
cannot last more than 10 minutes total, and once the hymn is 
over, the temporary aggression instantly and abruptly ends, and all 
listeners are free to take whichever action they wish.
Betrayal (Rating 18/+0%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners who do 
not follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at 
-2% per Practitioner Title or betray a particular cause or being, 
resulting in a -5% per Practitioner Title to Will Force saves when 
attempting to perform anything which furthers that cause or is 
requested by that being, and will avoid defending the cause or 
being at all costs. Furthermore, all affected listeners have -20% to 
morale whenever within the vicinity of the being or acting for the 
good of that being or cause.
Blasphemy (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Bestows a curse upon 
all listeners who do not follow the hymnist’s deity, resulting in a 
penalty of -1 to hit and -5% to all resistance rolls per 3 Practitioner 
Titles, lasting 1 hour. This curse may be lifted with the skill Remove 
Curse.
Blindness (Rating 18/+0%): 5 seconds. Strikes all listeners who do 
not follow the hymnist’s deity blind, unless a Control Resistance at 
-2% per Practitioner Title is made, for 10d6 seconds. Blind beings 
are -8 to hit with melee weapons, -16 to hit with missile weapons, 
-4 to damage, -20% to all combat skills, and have no defensive 
modifier. Furthermore, these listeners are immune to gaze attacks 
(such as Fear, Brilliance, Entrancement, Illusion of Sight, and those 
which transform).
Call Infernal (Rating 23/-40%): 10 minutes. Summons or dismisses 
an Evil-aligned supernatural servant by name (the hymnist must 
know the true name of the servant to summon or dismiss), either 
of which cannot be resisted by the servant. When summoning, 
control is automatically granted to the hymnist if the deity wishes 
it, unless the supernatural servant is immune to control. When 
dismissing, the servant must remain within earshot of the hymnist 
during the entire 10 minutes of the hymn.
Concealment (Rating 18/+0%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
do not follow the hymnist’s deity to temporarily be unable to sense 
a particular being or object, either through sight, sound, touch, 
smell, hearing, or magical and divine magical means, for 1 minute 
per Practitioner Title. This is only an illusion, and an Illusion 
Resistance negates the effect. This does not physically remove or 
displace the target, and the target can still be damaged or affected 
by outside forces. If the being or object moves more than a couple 
of inches, the effect is immediately broken.
Condemnation (Rating 21/-15%): 15 seconds. Causes all listeners 
to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or grow 
hostile toward all personal debts or grudges. This creates desires 
for revenge, resulting in a -20% per Practitioner Title to Will Force 
rolls to immediately attempt to collect debts and or settle old scores 
through hostile action.
Contamination (Rating 15/+15%): 10 seconds. Introduces a named 
disease or poison to all food and water within 5’ per Practitioner 
Title. The poison can be of a type no greater than 2 levels per 
Practitioner Title but takes effect immediately (Potency J) upon 
contact or ingestion, etc. Diseases selected cannot be magical or 
divine in nature. Normal Poison and Disease Resistances apply. 
Covetousness (Rating 18/+0%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
do not follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at 
-2% per Practitioner Title or covet that which belongs to others, 
whether valuable or not, resulting in the need to make a Will Force 
save or attempt to steal 1 item which does not belong to them every 
2 minutes for the following hour.  Items can even include spouses, 
children, prisoners, slaves/servants, or other beings which the 
listeners may view as “owned” by someone else.
Damnation (Rating 28/-50%): 5 seconds. Causes the hymnist’s 
deity to intervene in an otherwise safe situation and divinely, 
miraculously inflict a highly dangerous and potentially fatal event 
in a particular place no larger than 1 mile per Practitioner Title 
or on a group of beings consisting of no more than 10 individuals 
per Practitioner Title, in whichever way that deity chooses. For 
example, if the hymn is being sung while a regiment of soldiers 
are climbing a snow-covered mountain slope toward the hymnist’s 
keep, the deity may choose to cause an avalanche to smother 
the soldiers; or, if the hymnist has had a falling out with others 
in a tavern, the deity may cause a candle within to suddenly fall 
over, catching the clothes of one of the men on fire. The means of 
damnation is completely at the GM’s discretion. However, if the 
GM decides that the hymnist’s enemies do not warrant damnation, 
or that performing this act does not fit into the deity’s predestined 
plan, nothing happens.  This hymn may only be sung once per 
month, and any further attempts may invoke the anger and wrath 
of that particular deity, resulting in divine denial.
Darkness (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds.  Causes a divine magical 
pure black sphere of darkness, with a radius of 1’ per Practitioner 
Title, to appear no further than 5’ away per Will Force point.  The 
sphere can be centered on a moveable object or being, or can be 
fixed in one place.  All light, magical or otherwise, is non-visible 
while the globe is in effect.  The light is a soft, slowly intensifying 
light, and lasts 5 minutes per Will Force of the hymnist.  Only 
one globe per Practitioner Title may be active.  Fire will still be lit 
within the magical sphere and will still be hot, just not visible.  All 
forms of vision that operate within the spectrum of light are non-
functional within the sphere (such as all forms of Night Vision, 
Ultravision and Infravision).  The hymnist’s vision is not affected 
by the darkness.  Beings and magic items targeted get a Piety save 
to avoid the effects.
Deafness (Rating 18/+0%): 5 seconds. Strikes all listeners who do 
not follow the hymnist’s deity deaf, unless a Control Resistance 
at -2% per Practitioner Title is made, for 10d6 seconds. Deafened 
beings are -1 to initiative, +50% to be surprised, and +1 to be 
struck during combat.
Deception (Rating 19/-5%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners to make 
a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or speak only 

===== PAGE 143 =====
137
lies and be completely unable to tell the truth in any way for 1d4 
minutes. The affected beings can choose to remain silent.
Defilement (Rating 22/-20%): 1 minute. Causes 1 listener per 
Practitioner Title who follows a Good-aligned deity to make a 
Control Resistance of become morally corrupt for the duration, 
resulting in cravings for power, money, destruction, and other evil 
desires. A normally calm and peaceful being would become violent 
if provoked or kept from fulfilling her desires. After 30 minutes per 
Practitioner Title after the hymn ends, each affected listener reverts 
back to her previous alignment and loses all memory of events that 
transpired while corrupted. This hymn has no effect on followers of 
Neutral-Good deities.
Degeneration (Rating 21/-15%): 10 seconds. Wounds any one 
existing body area to exactly -1 Endurance, affecting 1 listener 
per Practitioner Title who does not follow the hymnist’s 
deity. Furthermore, up to 1 limb per 4 Practitioner Titles is 
instantaneously removed at the cost of 1 Will Force per limb, 
paid by the hymnist. Vital areas cannot be removed in this way.  
Multiple sub-areas removed (such as several fingers on the same 
hand) count as one limb.
Depravation (Rating 18/+0%): 1 minute. Causes all listeners who 
do not follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance 
at -2% per Practitioner Title or gain a sudden need for food and 
water. Those affected must eat a full meal once per hour or begin 
starving (subtracting 1d4+1 Base Endurance per hour) and drink 8 
oz. of liquid every hour or begin dying of dehydration (subtracting 
1d6+1 Base Endurance per hour). This depravation lasts for 1 full 
day per Practitioner Title. If Base Endurance is reduced to 0 or 
below, the being must make a Vitality save at -5% per point under 
0 or fall unconscious and collapse. Anyone whose Base Endurance 
drops to 0 minus their Vitality rating dies immediately. 
Enmity (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow a Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% 
per Practitioner Title or feel intense hostility and animosity toward 
each other, causing them to attack the nearest living being who 
follows a Good-aligned deity until either dead or not moving. 
Thereafter, a new resistance is allowed, or the listener must attack 
the next nearest target. This hymn will continue to affect listeners 
for as long as the hymnist is singing. Once the hymn ends, affected 
listeners immediately lose this feeling of enmity but retain all 
memory of the deeds they committed while under the hymn’s 
influence.
Estrangement (Rating 19/-5%): 20 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow one particular deity (either that of the hymnist or another) 
to lose all sense of bonding with each other and instead be filled 
with a nervous, uneasy estrangement, losing a total of 2% per 
Practitioner Title when collectively attempting to Commune with 
their deity. The affected listeners are also -30% to morale and -5% 
per 2 Practitioner Titles to all skills performed on each other (such 
as Cure Poison, Bless, etc.). In cases where the affected listeners of 
a single religion are bonded in a way other than through a deity, 
this hymn removes all means of mental and spiritual contact with 
each other, even overriding magical effects such as Mindlink and 
Emotion Sense. These effects last for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.
Exoneration (Rating 20/-10%): 10 seconds. Causes all non-magical 
and non-divine locks and bindings (including rope, cuffs, etc.) to 
open within 1’ per Practitioner Title of the hymnist and all listeners 
who follow the hymnist’s deity who are currently being held or 
imprisoned justly for committing a crime or evil deed.
Frailty (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Lowers the Strength rating 
by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (cannot be lowered below 5) of all 
listeners who do not follow the hymnist’s deity if they fail a Magic 
Resistance. Strength points lost in this manner return at a rate of 1 
per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.
Greed (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners to be filled 
with an overwhelming sense of greed unless a Control Resistance 
at -2% per Practitioner Title is made, resulting in a desire to steal, 
ask for, keep, or otherwise obtain items of any value at all. This 
feeling fades after 1 hour.
Hatred (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds. Causes the hymnist (if 
willing) and all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% 
per Practitioner Title or hate the hymn’s subject (being, location, 
object, or idea) with all their hearts. Affected listeners must go 
berserk whenever in the presence of the subject and will go to any 
length to utterly destroy that subject. These feelings of hatred fade 
after 1 hour.
Idiocy (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Lowers the Intelligence rating 
by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (cannot be lowered below 5) of all 
listeners who do not follow the hymnist’s deity who fail a Magic 
Resistance. Intelligence points lost in this manner return at a rate 
of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.
Infirmity (Rating 22/-20%): 5 minutes. Inflicts a -5% per 
Practitioner Title penalty to Poison and Disease Resistances for 
1 hour and inflicts one particular named terminal disease to all 
listeners who do not follow the hymnist’s deity, unless the target 
makes their normal Disease Resistance at -2% per Practitioner 
Title. This terminal disease may be either mundane, magical, or 
divine magical in nature.
Indulgence (Rating 16/-10%): 15 seconds. Causes 1 listener who 
follows the hymnist’s deity and all listeners who follow a Neutral 
Good- or Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance or 
indulge in all actions, beings, and places considered immoral or 
evil in any way for 1 hour. Indulging in such activities includes 
drinking solely to get drunk, participating in less than seemly 
activities, overeating, etc.
Ineptness (Rating 18/+0%): 15 seconds. Lowers the Wisdom rating 
by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (cannot be lowered below 5) of all 
listeners who do not follow the hymnist’s deity and fail a Magic 
Resistance. Wisdom points lost in this manner return at a rate of 1 
per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.
Infliction (Rating 20/-10%): 1 minute. Inflicts one particular mild 
disease to all listeners who do not follow the hymnist’s deity, unless 
a Disease Resistance is made. This disease may be either mundane, 
magical, or divine magical in nature.
Insolence (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds. Causes all listeners who 
follow a Neutral- or Good-aligned deity to make a Control 
Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or become rude and 
insolent in deed and speech for 1 hour. This would cause affected 
listeners to slander their friends, refuse to help someone in need, 
use foul language, become drunk at an inappropriate time, etc.
Instillation (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds. Instills in all listeners who 
do not follow the hymnist’s deity with Type VI, Potency Q Poison, 
which gradually inflicts 1d4 damage to overall Endurance per hour 
for a total of 2d4 hours, unless a Poison Resistance is made.

Isolation (Rating 21/-15%%): 20 seconds. Inflicts all listeners

Practitioner Title to the skills Divination and Omen for 10 minutes

Jealousy (Rating 17/+5%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners who do 
not follow the hymnist’s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2%

need for a Will Force save to avoid attempting the skill Steal each

This includes every time the listener sees someone wearing nice 
clothes or jewelry, living in a nice house, eating good food, etc., at 
the GM’s discretion. This urge lasts for 1 hour.
Malady (Rating 19/-5%): 10 seconds. Inflicts a -2% per Practitioner

Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made.
Malevolence (Rating 18/+0%): 10 seconds. Causes 1 listener per 
Practitioner Title who does not follow the hymnist’s deity to make 
a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel a sense 
of total selfishness and lack of concern for the welfare of others, 
resulting in a Will Force save at -5% per Practitioner Title to 
perform any action that would in any way be considered selfless or 
generous (at the GM’s discretion). For example, this hymn would 
affect the listener’s attempt at the skills Healing and Exorcism, or 
force someone to claim a newly found magical item or object of 
value whether they needed it or not. Furthermore, the listener 
must make a Will Force save at -5% per Practitioner Title or refuse 
to defend someone, either in conversation or in combat. This 
feeling of malevolence lasts for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.
Midnight (Rating 23/-25%): 10 seconds. Creates a sphere of true 
night, even during the day, covering the area with the darkness 
of midnight. All beings within the sphere are affected as if it were 
night. All effects which are dependent upon darkness or nighttime 
apply, regardless of the actual time. Thus, within the sphere of 
the Hymn of Midnight, a Lesser Vampire, normally debilitated 
during daylight hours, would function as normal while inside 
the sphere. The sphere, which has a radius of 10’ per Practitioner 
Title, is centered on a fixed location (up to 2’ per Practitioner Title 
from the hymnist) when created and cannot be moved, and it lasts 
for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title. The hymns of Twilight and 
Noontide will override the Hymn of Midnight if the latter hymnist 
makes his Hymn Lore roll by more than the previous hymnist.
Murder (Rating 20/-10%): 10 seconds. Causes up to 2 listeners 
per Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance at -2% per 
Practitioner Title or feel an intense urge to immediately attack 
the nearest being, with the intent and focus of murdering them. 
Once the target being dies, a new resistance must be made to avoid 
attacking the next nearest being. This urge continues for as long as 
the hymnist is singing and fades 2d6 seconds after the hymn ends.
Necromancy (Rating 20/-10%): 1 minute. Grants a +5% per 
Practitioner Title bonus to 1 listener who follows a Neutral-Evil or 
Evil-aligned deity to the following for 1 hour:
•	 Skills: Bind Form, Bone Lore, Call Undead, Control Undead, 
Flesh Lore
•	 Candle Lore rituals: Coexist with Undead, Death Stench, 
Protection from Undead, Spirit Bind (when targeted at undead)
•	 Ritual Lore rituals: Bind Form, Conceal Dead, Magnify 
Shadow, Positive Life Vapor
•	 Poems: Darkness, Shadow
•	 Songs: Decay, Death Warrior
•	 Ballads: Deadwalk, Decomposition, Mask of Death
•	 Runes: Binding (when only activated by undead), Corruption, 
Mark of Death, Natural Darkness, Night
Perversion (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds. Causes the hymnist and 
all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner 
Title (if unwilling) or be unable to avoid saying or doing anything 
that would be considered immoral or evil for 1 hour.
Possession (Rating 20/-10%): 10 seconds. Causes 1 listener to make 
a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or become 
possessed by the hymnist for 1 hour per Practitioner Title after 
the hymn is complete. Once the hymn ends after 10 seconds, 
the hymnist is in mental contact with the target (if they remain 
within sight) and may take possession with 5 seconds of simple 
concentration (with no additional Control Resistance afforded). 
While in possession, the hymnist has complete control of the 
target, whose will is totally subverted. The hymnist’s own body 
will stand or sit as it was. If the hymnist’s body takes more than 
10 points of damage, then a concentration roll (Intelligence save) 
is required to avoid having the hymnist’s mind forcibly returned 
to the hymnist’s body. After 1 hour per Practitioner Title, the 
possession target is no longer considered controlled. 
Prejudice (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds. Temporarily instills 
Xenophobia (fear of outsiders and beings who are different) in all 
listeners for 1 hour.
Pride (Rating 17/+5%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners who follow 
a Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per 
Practitioner Title or lose all humility and meekness and instead 
be filled with a false sense of pride and unseemly boastfulness,

(at the GM’s discretion). This would include thanking someone for 
something or allowing someone else to partake first of food, etc. 
These effects last for 1 hour.
Revulsion (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds. Decreases the Appearance

Sacrilege (Rating 17/+5%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners who do

-2% per Practitioner Title or perform 2d4 actions contrary to the 
teachings, beliefs, or standards of his own particular deity. This 
would include cursing in the deity’s name, stealing a divine item 
imbued by that deity, speaking badly of that deity, murdering, 
lying, refusing to perform necessary religious rites, etc.
Temptation (Rating 15/+15%): 15 seconds. Lowers the Will Force 
saves of all listeners by 5% per Practitioner Title when being 
tempted to take any action that would be considered evil, resulting 
in possible alignment checks. This temptation lasts for 2 hours after 
the hymn ends.

Vanity (Rating 16/+10%): 5 seconds. Causes all listeners to make

ILLUSION KNOWLEDGE 
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: Varies
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill provides a basic understanding of how 
illusions affect one’s mind and how to exploit that relationship for 
maximum effectiveness.
General Usage: The following bonuses and abilities are granted 
though Illusion Knowledge:
•	 The practitioner may specialize in 1 of the following skills 
per full 30% of Illusion Knowledge: Apathy, Confusion, 
Deception, Enigma, Lethargy, Mass Delusion, Misconception, 
Somnolence, Stupor, and Torpor. Specialization takes 1 day 
of concentration and an Illusion Knowledge roll. Success 
affords the user a +20% bonus to use the specialized skill. 
The practitioner may only specialize in skills which they have 
already acquired but may wait to specialize until the desired 
skill has been learned.
•	 The practitioner is granted a bonus to her Aura Regeneration in 
relation to her Practitioner Title (see chart below).

•	 This skill can be used to dispel illusions created by other 
beings through a contest of skills (the practitioner’s Illusion 
Knowledge skill chance vs. the skill/effect chance of the being 
or object that created the illusion to be dispelled).
Special Notes: Persons with this skill are prohibited from also 
having the skills Scroll Knowledge, Wild Magic, Elemental 
Knowledge, Kinetics Knowledge, or Hermetics Lore.
Critical Failure: The practitioner is unable to specialize in the skill 
in question until her Illusion Knowledge is raised.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 3, Lie, Mimic, and Detect Magic (Illusion 
Knowledge acts as Scroll Knowledge for skill requirements.)

Attributes: Intelligence, Aura

Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: 10 seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill represents a deep understanding of the 
effects that illusions may have on the mind.
General Usage: The following bonuses and abilities are granted 
when using the skills Apathy, Confusion, Deception, Enigma, 
Lethargy, Mass Delusion, Misconception, Somnolence, Stupor, and 
Torpor:
•	 Treat the practitioner as though both her Class and Practitioner 
Titles are 1 higher than their actual values.
•	 After concentrating for 10 seconds, a successful Illusion Lore 
skill roll allows the user to add her Illusion Lore chance to her 
next skill roll. Doing this also causes the effect of the chosen 
skill to be immune to the revealing aspects of effects like Divine 
Sight.
•	 For every full 20% of Illusion Lore, the practitioner may deduct 
1 second (maximum of 5 seconds deducted) from the usage 
time (not to drop below 2 seconds total).
Special Notes: This skill may not be used non-acquired.
Critical Failure: The practitioner may not use Illusion Lore for 1 
day.

IMPUNITY
Attributes: Will Force	
	
Rating: 15
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: N/A
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill magically protects and can eventually 
enhance the movement ability of one being. 
General Usage: The skill chance is added to any resistances (Magic, 
Control, Poison, etc.) that would impair, impede, or halt movement 
(such as Hold, Paralysis, Slumber, Stasis, etc.). Also, even if the 
resistance fails, the being will not fall to the ground if paralyzed, 
put to sleep, etc. and will always have 1 second of action per full 
10% of the skill. An Impunity skill chance of 20% would give the 
skill user who fails a resistance roll 2 seconds of action (the first 2 
if she didn’t lose seconds due to Initiative) in any 10 second round. 
This means that by having a 100% skill chance, no resistance needs 
to be rolled because all 10 seconds are protected, whether the 
resistance is made or not. 
Special Usage: For each full 10% over a skill chance of 100%, an 
additional second of action is gained. At 200%, the skill user gets 
10 additional speed seconds every round. As always, these 10 
seconds are not stackable with other speed effects. There is no way 
to get more than 10 speed seconds in a given combat round. 
Critical Failure: None
Repeat Failure: None
Requirements: Title 7 and one of the following: Fearless/Steadfast, 
Chi Sense, or Sense Supernatural. 
INESCAPABLE
Attributes: Piety, Will Force	 	
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 1 Second
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to mark and pursue a foe. 
General Usage: The practitioner spends 5 seconds naming a living 
or undead enemy within sight and concentrating. The enemy 
must be part of an opposing faction, be aware of the practitioner, 
or otherwise have done something to become the practitioner’s 
enemy. If a skill roll is successful, the target is marked for 1 hour 
per Class Title. While that target is within 1 mile per Class Title, 
the practitioner can concentrate for 5 seconds, make a second skill 
roll at +20%, and then teleport directly in front (within 10’) of the 
enemy. If the entire area 10’ in front of the opponent is completely 
filled and does not allow for the skill user to appear there, then the 
skill will attempt to place the practitioner to either flank. If both 
flanks are also filled, then it will place them to the rear. If the entire 
area within a 10’ radius of the target is filled and there is no safe 
place to teleport to, then the practitioner will sense this as they 
begin to concentrate and only 1 second will be used, after which 
the skill user will know to stop attempting to use this skill. 
Special Usage: Once marked, the practitioner can make a skill roll 
at +20% to detect the direction of and distance to the enemy.  
Notes: Under no circumstance will the practitioner be teleported 
into another object or being, nor onto a dangerous material such as 
molten lava or into open air to fall, etc. The practitioner is unable 
to mark any target under the effect of Non-Detection, Vanish, or 
Inscrutable. However, if a target who does not have Non-Detection 
is marked and then becomes Non-Detected, their mark does not 
disappear, and the practitioner can still find him.
Critical Success: The duration of marking increases by +2 hours, 
and the distance is increased by +2 miles.
Critical Failure: The practitioner suffers mental fatigue and cannot 
try to mark this foe again that day.
Requirements: Title 7.
INTERDICT
Attributes: Piety, Will Force	 	
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 10 Seconds
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Temporarily prevents a being from receiving any 
beneficial divine magical effects.
General Usage: Upon completion of a brief ritual, a divine mark 
is placed on the target being, preventing that target from receiv-
ing any beneficial divine effects from any deity for 1 minute per 
Practitioner Title. The target is afforded a Piety save at -10% per 
Practitioner Title. Failure indicates that the target will be complete-
ly unaffected by direct divine magical effects.
Notes: The divine mark placed on the target is invisible unless 
viewed with Divine Sight or Detect Divinity. Under normal cir-
cumstances, the target being will have no knowledge of the mark’s 
existence. Only 1 being per Practitioner Title may be affected by 
Interdict at any given time.
Special Notes: The GM may determine that the target of this skill 
is protected or favored by her deity. In such cases, the resolution is 
at the GM’s discretion.
Requirements: Title 7 and 10 divine magical skills. 
INTONE
Attributes: Knowledge, Piety		
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: Varies
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: The ability to sing divine hymns. 
General Usage: The skill user begins a hymn written with the 
skill Hymn Lore and makes a skill roll when the hymn is to take 
effect. If the skill roll is successful, the divine hymn has the desired 
effect (see Hymn Lore). The effects begin shortly after the hymnist 
begins the hymn and lasts either until the hymn ends or some time 
afterwards (see the effects of individual hymns). Listeners may be 
greatly moved while hearing the divine words to the hymn, but 
such feelings are temporary and will eventually fade. The hymnist 
may sing through the entirety of each hymn multiple times in 

===== PAGE 147 =====
141
order to keep its effect going, but every 10 minutes, the hymnist 
must make a Vitality save to continue. There is a cumulative -5% 
chance for every Vitality save after the first. When the Vitality save 
fails, the hymnist is unable to continue singing and is considered 
fatigued one level for every 10 minutes he has been singing.
Notes: Hymns are sung only, with no musical instrument used. The 
user may sing while also performing other physical actions, even 
combat. If the hymnist takes over half damage to a single body area 
(such as taking 11 damage to a 20-point body area), an Intelligence 
save is required to continue singing. If the damaged body area is 
a vital area, the Intelligence save is at -20% and a Piety save is also 
necessary to keep singing.
Critical Failure: The hymnist may not attempt to sing this 
particular hymn again until the skill chance is increased.
Critical Success: -10% to the target being’s saves or resistances.
Repeat Failure: The hymnist may not attempt to sing this 
particular hymn again until the skill chance is increased. Also, 
the hymnist’s vocal cords are strained, resulting in all Hymn Lore, 
Sing, Sing Songs, Recite, and Recite Poetry skills being at 1/2 their 
skill chance for the rest of the day or until that body area (head) is 
healed for at least 1 point.
Requirements: Title 3.
INTREPID COUNTENANCE
Attributes: Piety, Will Force	 	
Rating: 18
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: 5 Seconds
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: The practitioner becomes a vision of holy wrath, 
beautiful and terrible to behold, awing her compatriots and terrify-
ing those who stand against her.
General Usage: The practitioner focuses intently on her divine 
purpose for 5 seconds, after which a skill roll is made. If successful, 
the practitioner is affected in the following manner:
•	 The practitioner appears to grow in size, adding 2” for every 
full foot of actual height.
•	 A halo appropriate in appearance for the practitioner’s deity 
(fire, gold, light, etc.) appears above the practitioner’s head.
•	 Divine wings appropriate in appearance for the practitioner’s 
deity (fire, gold, light, etc.) appear on the practitioner’s back.
•	 The practitioner’s eyes become as hot, burning coals, shining 
from within with holy vengeance and causing wisps of white 
smoke to rise from her eyes. 
•	 The practitioner’s armor gleams with holy radiance; to look at 
her directly is to gaze into the setting sun.
•	 These changes cause the following effects:
•	 Divine Magical flight at 60’ per second.
•	 Evil beings within 100’ of the practitioner (friendly or 
otherwise) of a Title/Level equal to or less than the Class Title 
of the practitioner must make a Control Resistance or fall 
to their knees and cry out for forgiveness. These Evil beings 
must be able to see or otherwise sense the practitioner to be so 
affected.
•	 The practitioner and friendly Good-aligned beings in her 
presence are immune to fear and gain +50% to the skill 
Intimidation.
•	 Enemies suffer a -75% penalty to morale checks.
•	 Followers and friendly non-players only fail morale checks with 
a roll of 100 when in the presence of the practitioner.
•	 Anyone gazing directly upon the practitioner for longer than 3 
seconds is blinded for 1 minute if a Magic Resistance fails.
•	 These effects last for 5 minutes per Practitioner Title.
Critical Failure: The practitioner may not attempt this skill again 
for the rest of the day.
Critical Success: The duration of this skill’s effects is doubled.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title 11 and 15 divine magical skills.
KINETIC BLAST
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 5 Seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to send out a damaging burst 
of kinetic energy in a desired direction.
General Usage: The practitioner chooses a direction and attempts 
a skill roll. Success causes a cylindrical blast of kinetic energy 
emanating from the practitioner with a length of 3’ per Class Title 
and a diameter of 1’ per Class Title to be unleashed in the chosen 
direction with the following effects:
•	 Zone 1 (within a distance of 0’-1’ per Class Title): Small 
items in this area become projectiles and may strike random 
areas on beings caught in the area of effect, doing damage 
as appropriate (GM’s discretion). Beings caught in this area 
also take 1d10 smashing damage per Practitioner Title to 4d4 
randomly selected body areas, are knocked to the ground (no 
Agility save allowed), are thrown away from the practitioner 
1’ per Practitioner Title (-1’ per 100 lb. of weight), and lose 10 
seconds of action while recovering from the blast.
•	 Zone 2 (within a distance of 1’-2’ per Class Title): Beings 
caught in this area take 1d8 smashing damage per Practitioner 
Title to 2d4 randomly selected body areas and must make an 
Agility save at -10% per Practitioner Title or be knocked to 
the ground and lose 1d6+1 seconds of action while regaining a 
standing position.
•	 Zone 3 (within a distance of 2’-3’ per Class Title): Beings 
caught in this area take 1d6 smashing damage per Practitioner 
Title to 1d4 randomly selected body areas and must make 
an Agility save or be knocked to the ground and lose 1d6+1 
seconds of action while regaining a standing position.
Note: A successful Magic Resistance by beings caught in the 
blast reduces their damage by half, but knockdown/knockback 
still occurs (Agility saves as applicable). The following spells and 
invocations provide protection against this skill: Invulnerability, 
Sphere of Power, Spirit Wall, Spirit Sphere, and Wall of Power; 
however, each of these indicated protections has a 5% per 
Practitioner Title chance of shattering. Walls of Protection and 
Spheres of Protection will nullify the magic of Kinetic Blast within 
their affected areas.
Critical Failure: The practitioner must wait 1 hour before 
attempting Kinetic Blast again.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 7, Kinetics Knowledge, and Kinetics Lore.

KINETICS LORE
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 19
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: 10 minutes
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill represents a profound understanding of the 
physical world and its energies.
General Usage: The following bonuses and abilities are granted 
though Kinetics Lore: 
•	 When the following skills are used, treat the practitioner as 
though both her Class and Practitioner Titles are 1 higher than 
their actual values: Apparokinesis, Aurakinesis, Caustokinesis, 
Cryokinesis, Electrokinesis, Gravikinesis, Lumokinesis, 
Magnetokinesis, Pyrokinesis, Sonokinesis, Telekinesis, and 
Temporokinesis.
•	 The practitioner may concentrate for 10 seconds and make 
a Kinetics Lore roll. If successful, she may then add her 
Kinetics Lore chance to her next skill roll for Apparokinesis, 
Aurakinesis, Caustokinesis, Cryokinesis, Electrokinesis, 
Gravikinesis, Lumokinesis, Magnetokinesis, Pyrokinesis, 
Sonokinesis, Telekinesis, and Temporokinesis.
•	 For every full 20% of Kinetics Lore, the practitioner may 
deduct 10% (maximum of 50%) from the usage times of the 
following skills: Apparokinesis, Aurakinesis, Caustokinesis, 
Cryokinesis, Electrokinesis, Gravikinesis, Lumokinesis, 
Magnetokinesis, Pyrokinesis, Sonokinesis, Telekinesis, and 
Temporokinesis. Example: with a 50% Kinetics Lore, the 
practitioner can use Pyrokinesis’ Fire Blast ability in 8 seconds 
(down from 10), or the Gate ability of Apparokinesis in 48 
minutes (down from 1 hour). In this special instance, rounding 
is against the player. Example: a 5 second usage time must be 
modified by 20% (1 second) before the practitioner receives the 
benefit of a faster use time; the half-second modifier that 10% 
provides is insufficient to change the usage time. Skill usages 
that are already at 1 second cannot be modified in this way.
Special Usage: Practitioners of Kinetics Lore so deeply understand 
the relationship between Aura and the physical world that they 
can create new effects for the following skills: Apparokinesis, 
Aurakinesis, Caustokinesis, Cryokinesis, Electrokinesis, 
Gravikinesis, Lumokinesis, Magnetokinesis, Pyrokinesis, 
Sonokinesis, Telekinesis, and Temporokinesis.  The practitioner 
devises the effect and then must make both a roll for the 
appropriate skill and a successful Kinetics Lore roll. If both rolls are 
successful, the practitioner has learned the new effect and can use 
it per the rules of the skill in question. All created effects, including 
their ratings and modifiers, are subject to GM approval.
Special Notes: This skill may not be used non-acquired.
Critical Failure: The practitioner may not use Kinetics Lore for 1 
day.
Requirements: Title 6 and Kinetics Knowledge.

LIGHTFIRE KNOWLEDGE
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 12
Start Bonus: 2d10%	
	
Time: Varies
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: The ability to learn and cast spells tinged with light 
energy from the Phase Plane.
General Usage: Rather than casting spells through the traditional 
Scroll Knowledge method, a practitioner of Lightfire Knowledge 
draws Aura from the Phase Plane, causing her spells to be tinged 
with light. As the user grows in power and gains Aura Control, 
she immediately gains knowledge of certain Lightfire spells 
without having to learn spell notes, scribe spells into a spellbook, 
or memorize anything. Furthermore, the user may also draw 
power from the Phase Plane to cast other spells, as long as she has 
a magical scroll or written description of a spell and memorizes 
them (taking up Memorization Points). Both of these categories of 
spells each have their own requirements and effects: 
1. Casting Lightfire spells:
•	 Knowledge of how to cast the spell is automatically known 
without being taught as the practitioner gains the appropriate 
Aura Control. No spell notes or memorization is necessary.
•	 Spell effects emit bright colors and light, including items 
produced with Produce spells.
•	 Spell effects are cast at full strength.

2. Casting all other spells:
•	 A magical scroll or written description of a spell (spell notes) 
is required and then studied for a set period of time (see 
individual spells in the Magic section of each book).
•	 Spell effects emit bright colors and light, including items

•	 Area affected, distance to focus, and range are cast at full 
strength.
•	 Duration, damage, and modifiers are cast at half strength but 
illusioned to appear as full strength. Because of this, all affected 
targets are afforded an Illusion Resistance (if requested). 
If made, targets suffer only half the duration, damage, and 
modifiers, though the bright colors and light remain.

allow her to cast spells, and she will start with any one of the 
following spells at her choice: Color, Flicker, Produce Light, or 
Warm.

Notes: Since the caster is drawing power from the Phase Plane, her
