impossible or unbalancing effects to take place. See the Scroll 
Knowledge specialization rules in the Magic section.
Requirements: Title 3, Detect Magic or Detect Aura, and 4 magical 
skills. Also, Lightfire Knowledge acts as Scroll Knowledge for all 
skill requirements and allows Phase to be a Core Skill at 6th Title.
LIGHTFIRE LORE
Attributes: Intelligence, Knowledge	
Rating: 18
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: Varies
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: The ability to enhance skills and spells that utilize 
light and fire.
General Usage: The following bonuses and abilities are granted 
though Lightfire Lore: 
When using the skills Lumokinesis and Pyrokinesis:
•	 Treat the practitioner as though both her Class and Practitioner 
Titles are 1 higher than their actual values.
•	 After concentrating for 10 seconds, a successful Lightfire Lore 
skill roll allows the user to add her Lightfire Lore chance to her 
next skill roll.
•	 For every full 20% of Lightfire Lore, the practitioner may 
deduct 10% (maximum of 50%) from the usage times.
•	 The skill user gains the specialization abilities.
When casting special Lightfire Spells:
The skill user gains mastery of one Lightfire spell with a successful 
skill roll, followed by one new spell for every Title gained thereafter 
with another successful Lightfire Lore skill roll (see Lightfire 
Knowledge for the list of spells). Mastered spells gain the following 
benefits: 
•	 The caster gains +2 Aura Control for that spell.
•	 No somatic gestures are needed to cast the spell, only verbal.
•	 The casting time can be halved (rounded up).
•	 The area affected can be changed when cast so long as it 
does not increase the overall volume. No dimension can be 
decreased more than 1/4 distance (this allows for basic spell 
shape changing).
•	 The range and distance to focus can be increased by up to 3x 
the normal distance.
•	 The duration can be doubled.
•	 The spell may be made permanent as per the spell Permanency 
at 1/2 the Will Force cost, regardless of whether the spell caster 
has the spell Permanency or not.
•	 The caster is +20% to all saves/resistances involving this spell if 
used against him.
•	 Targets of the spell are -20% to any saves/resistances required, 
including Illusion Resistance if requested.
•	 Mastered spells can be taught to students at +20% to the 
student’s Scroll/Lightfire Knowledge roll.
•	 The caster cannot be interrupted by loss of concentration 
unless taking a wound that reduces an area to negative 
Endurance.
Special Usage: Practitioners of Lightfire Lore so deeply understand 
the relationship between Aura and the Phase Plane that they can 
create new effects for the skills Lumokinesis and Pyrokinesis. The 
practitioner devises the effect and then makes both a roll for the 
appropriate skill and a successful Lightfire Lore roll. If both rolls 
are successful, the practitioner has learned the new effect and 
can use it per the rules of the skill in question. All created effects, 
including their ratings and modifiers, are subject to GM approval. 
Special Notes: This skill may not be used non-acquired.
Critical Failure: The practitioner may not use Lightfire Lore for 1 
day.
Requirements: Title 7 and Lightfire Knowledge.
LIGHTFIRE MASTERY
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 20
Start Bonus: 1d6%		
	
Time: 1 second
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: A practitioner of this skill is a master of light and fire. 
General Usage: The following bonuses and abilities are granted 
though Lightfire Lore:
When using the skills Lumokinesis and Pyrokinesis:
•	 Skill rolls are +5% per full 20% of Lightfire Mastery.
•	 One skill can be mastered for every full 50% of Lightfire 
Mastery. Mastery requires 1 day of uninterrupted concentration 
and a successful Lightfire Mastery roll. Skill mastery affords the 
practitioner the following bonuses:
•	 Usage time for all its various effects is 2 seconds, unless already 

===== PAGE 151 =====
145
at 1 second.
•	 Effects can be maintained without continued concentration if 
an Intelligence save is made.
•	 The practitioner can add the total chance of her Lightfire 
Mastery skill to the skill roll.
•	 The skill user gains the Mastery Ability.
Special Powers: The user gains 2 powers, each taking 5 seconds to 
activate and fulfilling the requirements for leveling past 10th Title:
•	 The user can activate an area of True Day around her in a 
sphere with a radius of 100’ per Class Title. The affected 
area shines with sunlight, resulting in all effects which are 
dependent upon sunlight or daytime, regardless of the actual 
time (for example, any vampires within range would be 
adversely affected).
•	 The user can surround herself with a Circle of Fire with a 
radius of up to 3’ per Class Title. The circle’s edge is 1” wide, 
floats 6” off the ground, and extends 10’ high. This semi-
transparent column of twisting orange, yellow, and white fire 
causes the following effects:
•	 Anything or anyone touching the circle besides the user must 
make a Magic Resistance once per contact or suffer 1d6 per 2 
Class Titles. Damage is only assessed once per 5 seconds per 
area or object.
•	 All missile weapons fired into or out of the circle are at -4 to hit 
and have damage reduced by half.
•	 All melee attacks into or out of the circle are at -2 to hit and 
lose 1 point per damage die rolled.
•	 View is partially obstructed, causing -2 Initiative rolls for the 
user.
•	 Damage of cold-based spells cast though the column is reduced 
to half due to the heat of the fire.
•	 The fire remains trapped magically within the column and does 
not leave this area of effect, regardless of circumstance.
•	 Large objects (structures) that obstruct the circle merely cause 
a temporary disappearance of that portion of the fire column.
•	 The skill user may not use another circle spell (either through a 
power or scroll) while this Circle of Fire is in effect.
Special Notes: This skill may not be used non-acquired. 
Critical Failure: The practitioner is unable to master the skill in 
question until her Lightfire Mastery skill is raised.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 10, Lightfire Knowledge, and Lightfire Lore.
LIGHT STEP
Attributes: Intelligence, Piety		
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 1 Second
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to move from one lit area to 
another, physically transporting between any two pools of light 
within visual sight of each other.
General Usage: The practitioner stands in one illuminated area 
and mentally connects with another, willing his form to vanish 
from the first and appear in the second. A successful skill roll is 
required to achieve success.
Special Usage: Upon stepping into the targeted pool of light, 
the practitioner can make a second skill roll to cause the light to 
flash with a dazzling radiance, temporarily blinding everyone in 
it. Beings so affected must add 3 seconds to their current combat 
action or wait 3 seconds to begin an action if none is underway. A 
Magic Resistance is allowed to avoid this temporary blindness.
Notes: The two areas of illumination must be separated by a lack 
of illumination. This skill cannot be used to step from one hilltop 
to another on a sunny day, as all areas illuminated by the sun are 
considered to be a single lit area.
Critical Failure: No further attempts to utilize the particular lit 
area may be made for 1 minute. 
Critical Success: Should he wish it to occur, the practitioner need 
not make a second skill roll to cause the dazzling radiance upon his 
arrival at the target area.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title 5 and 5 divine magical skills.
LUMINOUS FORM
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 19
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: 2-7 seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to change his form into pure 
light, causing his flesh and bone to transform into spirit.
General Usage: The practitioner concentrates for 1d6 seconds 
in an attempt to alter his form into pure light. If the skill roll is 
successful, the following occurs:
•	 All but one part of the practitioner’s body is considered phased 
and is affected by phased effects only. The skill user designates 
a vital body area (upper torso, head, etc.) when this skill is first 
acquired to remain in the earthly plane while in Light Form. 
This unphased body area can be struck by physical or magical 
damage (any damage taken is halved).
•	 Gains Immunity to Heat, Hold, and Light (see Endure Light in 
the Magic section).
•	 Can manipulate light within range of 3’ per Will Force point as 
the spell Manipulate Light. Treat the area of effect as if cast at 2 
Aura per Class Title.
•	 Can pass through solid objects at half walking speed.
•	 Moves by thought alone as the spell True Flight.
•	 Gains Magical Sight, Magical Hearing, Magical Smell, and 
Magical Touch.
•	 Cannot imbibe any food or drink, including potions and herbs.
Special Usage: The practitioner can both sense ghosts of all age 
types as well as summon them to himself in 1-2 seconds, as long 
as they are within 10’ per Will Force point. Once a ghost has 
been summoned, the skill user may speak with it via Telepathy. 
Furthermore, ghosts will not attack the practitioner unless 
provoked. 
Special Notes: This skill may not be used non-acquired.
Critical Failure: No further attempts to transform can be made for 
1 minute. A Will Force save is required to avoid 1 level of
mental fatigue.
Critical Success: The practitioner initiates Light Form within a 
shell of light per the spell Produce Light, and this light is centered 
within them as they move in Light Form. 
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 15.

LUMOKINESIS
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 12
Start Bonus: 2d10%	
	
Time: Varies
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill represents the ability to magically 
manipulate light energy.
General Usage: The user concentrates on the desired effect and 
mentally wills it to happen. Unlike casting spells, the amount of 
Aura needed to create an effect is constant. The Aura is drained 
from the practitioner’s Aura Pool and returns at her Aura 
Regeneration Rate. Note: Class Title in these usages always refers 
to the Class Title of the practitioner, even when the verbiage 
seems to indicate otherwise. Unless otherwise specified, effects are 
instantaneous in duration and have a range of 10’ per Class Title.
Alter Color (6 Aura; +30% modifier, 5 seconds): Shifts the 
frequency of light emitted by, reflected from, or passing through an 
object to become a different color. Living things and magic items 
are afforded a Magic Resistance to negate these effects.  If cast on 
an area no larger than 10 ft3 per Class Title, light passing through 
the area is shifted towards the color specified.  Simple patterns may 
be employed, but complex images cannot. This lasts for 1 hour per 
Class Title.
Distract (8 Aura; +20% modifier, 2 seconds): Causes pinpricks 
of light to distract the target. If the target being fails a Magic 
Resistance, he is distracted and loses 1-3 seconds of action.
Alter Ambient Light (10 Aura; +10% modifier, 1 second): Causes 
the ambient light in a 5’ radius per Practitioner Title around the 
practitioner to either increase or decrease (at the practitioner’s 
discretion) by up to 10% per Practitioner Title. This lasts for up to 
5 minutes per Practitioner Title.
Outline (10 Aura; +10% modifier, 5 seconds): Causes 1 being to 
make a Magic Resistance or be outlined by a bright light of the 
practitioner’s chosen color. This being is +2 to be hit with melee 
and +4 to be hit with missile weapons. This lasts for 10 seconds per 
Practitioner Title. Invisible targets or targets who become invisible 
under the effects of this skill remain outlined. 
Enhance Vision (12 Aura; no modifier, 10 seconds): Amplifies 
and shifts the frequency of light which enters the skill user’s eyes 
allowing them to see outside the visible spectrum and in low light 
conditions. This provides the user with Farsight, Ultravision, 
Infravision, Underwater Vision, or Night Vision (Enhanced) as 
desired for 1 hour per Class Title.
Illuminate (12 Aura; no modifier, 10 seconds): Causes an object 
to emit light at a strength of the practitioner’s choosing (up to 
that of natural sunlight) for 1 hour per Class Title. This light is 
not actually sunlight but can be as bright as a sunny day. The light 
extends outward from the object to a distance of 60’, after which it 
gradually diminishes back to the ambient light of the surrounding 
area. This does not count as true sunlight to affect beings such as 
Vampires or Dark Elves. 
Dazzle (14 Aura; -10% modifier, 5 seconds): Causes 1 being per 
Class Title to become briefly dazzled by a colorful display of 
magical light. If the target being fails a Magic Resistance, they are 
distracted and lose 1d4+1 seconds of action.
Blinding Trap (15 Aura; -15% modifier, 10 minutes): Creates a 
trapped area no larger than 5 ft² per Class Title. This area is a set 
trap that, when touched by another Aura field, will be triggered, 
causing a blinding flash. A Magic Resistance is required for all 
within 20’ of the triggered trap or they will be struck blind for 
10 minutes per Practitioner Title. This trap can only be triggered 
once. The Blinding Trap will last for 1 hour per Class Title once set. 
Alternately, 1/10th of a Will Force can be spent to make the trap 
permanent, resetting every 10 seconds once triggered. 
Blind (16 Aura; -20% modifier, 5 seconds): Causes 1 being to be 
blinded by a sensory overload of bright light for 10 seconds per 
Practitioner Title.
Image (16 Aura; -20% modifier, 10 seconds): Creates a three-
dimensional projection of an imagined image. This image may be 
animated, but this requires concentration. Upon a critical success 
with this ability, the user may also use Sonokinesis to use Throw 
Voice to add sound to the image. Alert viewers are afforded an 
Illusion Resistance to notice that it has no substance and is only 
light. Lasts 10 minutes per Practitioner Title or until dismissed by 
the skill user.
Specialization Ability, Refractive Field (Varies, see below, 5 seconds): 
Causes the user to bend light around their person, becoming 
partially invisible. The field starts to take effect immediately and 
fully establishes itself at the completion of the skill. The user is 
partially invisible (-4 to be hit), leaving only a shimmering in 
the air. The Aura required and difficulty of the skill is based on 
the ambient light level where the user is. Whenever the lighting 
conditions change, a new skill roll must be made but no additional 
Aura is consumed. Any loss of concentration, attacking, or other 
offensive action ends the field. Picking up or dropping an object 
creates a momentary shimmer where the object enters or exits 
the field. This effect persists for 1 minute per Class Title. With a 
Critical Success, only half the Aura is required, no shimmering is 
visible, and the user is at a -8 to be hit due to being invisible.

Mastery Ability, Focused Beam (18 Aura; -40% modifier, 1 second): 
Creates an amplified beam of focused light energy capable of 
cutting metal and burning flesh. The beam coalesces from ambient 
light around the practitioner and, with an Intelligence save, strikes 
a being or object at a point of the practitioner’s choosing. The 
beam can be attenuated to do as little as 1 damage per second (for 
etching stone or metal, perhaps) or intensified to cause as much 
as 5 points of damage per second per Class Title. If used against 
a being, the beam first burns through armor or hide on a 1:1 
basis before wounding the being.  Only beings protected by Force 
Armor, Spiritual Armor, or similar effects are allowed a Magic 
Resistance to avoid damage.  Magical armor or other objects are 
allowed their normal Magic Resistance to avoid damage, but the 
being wearing them is not.  The beam may be sustained for as 
long as the practitioner maintains concentration; this usage is not 
subject to the mastery bonus of continuing without concentration. 
Avoiding damage to this beam of light requires magical protection 
or immunity to light to avoid damage. 
Critical Success: Half Aura requirements.

MAGNETOKINESIS
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 19
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: Varies
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill represents the ability to magically 
manipulate magnetic fields.  
General Usage: The user concentrates on the desired effect and 
mentally wills it to happen. Unlike casting spells, the amount of 
Aura needed to create an effect is constant. Aura is drained from 
the practitioner’s Aura Pool and returns at her Aura Regeneration 
Rate. Note: Class Title in these usages always refers to the Class 
Title of the practitioner, even when the verbiage seems to indicate 
otherwise. Unless otherwise specified, effects are instantaneous in 
duration and have a range of 10’ per Class Title.
Deflect (6 Aura; +65%, 1 second): Creates a movable invisible 
shield of magnetic energy that can be used to deflect up to 1 
ferrous metal projectile per Class Title of the practitioner. The 
shield will dissipate when canceled or when the maximum number 
of deflections have occurred. Only one projectile can be affected 
per second, and the practitioner must concentrate to keep this 
effect active.
Move (10 Aura; +45% modifier, 5 seconds): Allows the practitioner 
to push or pull a ferrous metal object up to 10’ per Class Title at a 
speed of 2’ per second. The object can weigh no more than 20 lb. 
per Practitioner Title. The effect lasts until canceled.
Halt (12 Aura; +35% modifier, 1 second): Allows the practitioner 
to halt a moving ferrous metal object or objects weighing a total of 
up to 10 lb. per Class Title, causing the object(s) to stop in midair 
and fall to the ground.
Magnetic Shield (14 Aura; +25% modifier, 1 second): Creates an 
invisible spherical shield with a radius of up to 4’ per Class Title 
that surrounds the practitioner and remains in effect for 5 seconds 
per Practitioner Title. Any ferrous metal projectile entering the 
sphere will be thrown back at full force in a random direction, 
rendering damage to any target struck. Metal objects of any kind, 
including those worn by other beings, are unable to pass into 
the sphere. Projectiles made of magical metals may enter if the 
practitioner fails a Magic Resistance but are repelled if successful. 
Spells, Invocations, and non-metal items pass through the sphere 
unaffected. Metal objects may pass out of the sphere normally. Due 
to the nature of the magnetic field, beings firing metal projectiles 
from within the sphere are at -6 to hit, but these projectiles do 
double damage due to the accelerative nature of the field.
Repair (14 Aura; +25% modifier, 1 minute): Permanently repairs 
damaged metal objects. This skill can repair even rusted metal 
objects. Total volume of metal repaired must be no greater than 1 
ft3 of metal per Practitioner Title.
Throw (15 Aura; +20% modifier, 5 seconds): Causes a stationary 
metal object to accelerate and strike a target as if it had been 
thrown with a Strength equal to 2 per Class Title of the 
practitioner, with a maximum of 30. Attack and damage modifiers 
based on range and strength are applied as though the object had 
been thrown. Should an object used in this manner be affected 
by Reflection, it is propelled back to its origin rather than the 
practitioner.
Magnetic Trap (15 Aura; +20% modifier, 10 minutes): Creates a 
trapped area no larger than 5 ft² per Class Title. This area is a set 
trap that, when touched by another Aura field, will be triggered, 
causing held ferrous metal objects to be pulled from the hand of 
anyone within 10’ of the trap unless a Strength save is made at -5% 
per Practitioner Title. Any being wearing ferrous metal armor must 
also make an Agility save at -5% per Practitioner Title to avoid 
being pulled into the trap and possibly knocked over depending 
on the location of the trap. The trap can only be triggered once. 
This Magnetic Trap will last for 1 hour per Class Title once set. 
Alternately, 1/10th of a Will Force can be spent to make the trap 
permanent, resetting every 10 seconds once triggered. 
Weld (16 Aura; +15% modifier, 10 seconds): Causes 2 metal objects 
to fuse together. The skill user must touch the desired joint and 
concentrate for the duration of the skill. The joint is permanent and 
has 4 points of object strength per Class Title.
Magnetic Aura (20 Aura; -5% modifier, 1 second): Magnetizes the 
skill user’s Aura field, causing ferrous objects which attempt to pass 
through to adhere to it. If the object is wielded by another being, 
that being is afforded a Magic Resistance to ignore this effect. This 
effect lasts 1 minute per Class Title.
Specialization Ability, Magnetic Storm (21 Aura; -10% modifier, 10 
seconds): Causes all loose, ferrous, metal objects weighing 10 lb. 
or less within an area no larger than 10 ft³ per Practitioner Title to 
be caught up in a swirling magnetic vortex that lasts for 10 seconds 
per Class Title. The vortex itself is a cylinder with a 10’ diameter 
that extends 15’ high. The practitioner can will the vortex to move 
at a rate of up to 10’ per second in a direction of his choosing. 
Beings caught in the Magnetic Storm take 1d10 smashing damage 
per Practitioner Title to 2d4 randomly determined body areas from 
the swirling debris, if enough debris is present (up to the GM’s 
discretion). A successful Magic Resistance affords each victim half 
damage.
Mastery Ability, Railgun (22 Aura; -15% modifier, 1 second): 
Causes a metal object weighing no more than 1 lb. to rapidly 
accelerate to extreme velocity. If the practitioner makes an 
Intelligence save, the object will instantaneously strike its intended 
target with extraordinary force; the target must be visible to the 
practitioner in some way and be within 1 mile per Class Title. Due 
to the intense force imparted, this attack will ordinarily completely 
annihilate the target, however, as it is difficult to quantify given so 
many permutations (shape and composition of object, shelter or 
structure of target, etc.), the result is left up to the GM. 
Critical Success: Half Aura requirements.
Critical Failure: The skill user is unable to use Magnetokinesis for 

===== PAGE 154 =====
148
1 minute and must make a Will Force save or suffer mental fatigue.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 6, Kinetics Knowledge, and Kinetics Lore.
MALAISE
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 14
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 10 seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill lowers the Disease Resistance of the target 
being or beings by causing them to believe that they are more 
susceptible to disease.
General Usage: The user concentrates on an individual or group 
within sight and makes a skill roll. Success indicates that the target 
or targets suffer from a penalty to their Disease Resistance of -5% 
per Practitioner Title for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.  Target 
beings are allowed an Illusion Resistance, if requested, to negate 
this effect.  
Notes: This skill can affect a maximum of 1 being per Class Title of 
the practitioner.
Critical Failure: The target being(s) become aware that the 
practitioner was attempting to affect their mind(s).
Critical Success: The target’s Disease Resistance is lowered by an 
additional 10% (flat, not per Practitioner Title).
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title 3 and Illusion Knowledge.
MASS DELUSION
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 18
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: 10 seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill causes a group of targeted beings to 
fleetingly believe whatever the practitioner is saying.
General Usage: The user addresses a group by name (i.e. a tribal 
clan, noble house, guild, goblinoids, giants, those identifying as 
belonging to a particular religion, etc.) within earshot and makes 
a skill roll. If successful, up to 5 targets of that named type per 
Aura expended will believe what the practitioner is saying, even if 
it goes contrary to their personal beliefs. This skill cannot be used 
to directly cause the direct murder of another person, unless the 
targets are the type of beings with whom aggression is common 
(dark elves, a thieves guild, etc.). This skill could be used to incite 
a riot, which might lead to combat. Target beings are allowed an 
Illusion Resistance to negate this effect, if requested. The effect lasts 
while the practitioner is speaking and 1d6+1 minutes after. 
Notes: In the case of a resulting event that subsequently affects 
persons who were not listening to the original speech, such as 
a riot, only the original listeners begin to realize that they were 
duped after the effect expires. Targets must be able to understand 
the language of the speaker. They do not have to see the speaker, 
only hear the words. 
Special Notes: This skill requires Aura to be expended to create its 
effect.
Critical Failure: Each target being becomes aware that the 
practitioner was attempting to affect his mind.
Critical Success: The duration of the effect is doubled.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title10, Illusion Knowledge, and Illusion 
Lore.	
MESMERIZATION
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 20
Start Bonus: 1d6%		
	
Time: 20 seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to dazzle all beings and 
creatures who hear her speak so that they are immediately affected 
in various ways unless they are able to resist. 
General Usage: The practitioner succeeds in a skill roll when 
attempting to mesmerize all around her and is then seen by beings 
close enough to discern her qualities (based on vision but no more 
than a hundred feet even with exceptional sight or two hundred 
with far sight). Each being makes a Control Resistance. Any who 
fail are affected as follows. 
•	 They will listen to whatever the practitioner says and attempt 
to follow any commands, wishes or desires if they understand 
them. They will not do this if it will cause their immediate and 
obvious death. If such a command or request is made everyone 
involved gets a new Control Resistance to break all effects.
•	 They will automatically defend the practitioner to the best of 
their ability from attack.
•	 They will under no circumstances attempt to harm or cause 
perceived injury to the practitioner. 
•	 They are immune to other controlling influences. No contests, 
or overriding effects, such as skills that can usurp this control. 
The effect can be dispelled by effects like null magic that 
removes magic in the area, or skills or effects which grant new 
Control Resistances, etc. 
•	 The skill lasts 1 hour per class title/creature level of the 
practitioner. 
•	 Any beings that lose sight of the practitioner are afforded a new 
Control Resistance each minute they are out of sight. 
•	 There is no limit to the number of beings controlled in this 
manner as long as they see the practitioner well. Specifically 
this is normal vision within 50 feet, exceptional sight within 
100 feet, and farsight within 200 feet. 
Special Notes: No further attempt to mesmerize these creatures 
or target beings can be made until the skill chance is increased. 
The skill can be attempted again in the presence of these beings or 
creatures to mesmerize new ones but they will be unaffected unless 
the skill increased. 
Critical Failure: The target being becomes aware that the 
practitioner was attempting to affect his mind.
Critical Success: The affected creatures and beings will be 
mesmerized for twice the normal duration. 
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title 15

Requirements: Title 6 and Illusion Knowledge.	
MUSICAL PURITY
Attributes: Piety, Will Force	 	
Rating: 18
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: 1 Minutes
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Causes all listeners within a certain distance of the 
skill user to hear a pure, perfect blending of music more exquisite 
than any mortal could ever attempt to create. 
General Usage: The skill user spends 1 minute attuning himself to 
the perfect, sublime music of the Aura in the air around him and 
gradually gains control over that music, releasing it into audible 
sound for all listeners. The heavenly music then radiates audibly at 
a radius of 100’ per Practitioner Title. This other-worldly music can 
last up to 1 minute per Practitioner Title, but he can turn it off at 
any time. This musical purity causes the following effects:
•	 All Evil-aligned living and undead listeners must make a 
Control Resistance or be stunned (held inactive) for the 
duration of the skill.
•	 For every full minute, all Evil-aligned living and undead 
listeners have a 20% chance per Practitioner Title of gaining a 
random Insanity.
•	 All Good-aligned listeners suddenly receive a burst of divinely 
inspired energy and are +5 to hit and +5 to damage.
•	 There is a 10% chance per Practitioner Title that 2d4 Good-
aligned supernatural beings will be drawn to the music and 
appear within the radius of affect.
Special Notes: This skill may be combined with Bellow, causing 
the radius of hearing distance to grow. The bonuses from the social 
skill Music Theory do not apply to the skill Musical Purity.
Critical Failure: The skill user is fatigued and suffers –20% to all 
skills for 2 minutes.
Critical Success: All Evil-aligned supernatural beings must make a 
Control Resistance or be banished to their individual home planes.
Repeat Failure: The skill user becomes unconscious for 1d4 hours 
and suffers -60% to all skills for 24 hours after awakening.
Requirements: Title 10, Harmony, Hymn Lore, Intone, and Psalm 
Lore.
NATURE'S GROUND
Attributes: Piety, Will Force	 	
Rating: 14
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 1 Week
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to provide many divine 
protections and effects to a selected area. 
General Usage: The practitioner selects an area no larger than 
100 yards in diameter per Class Title and then sanctifies it to 
nature over the course of one week. The area must have plants and 
animals (magical or otherwise) living in it, as well as at least 4 large 
plants roughly outlining the edges, to become Nature’s Ground. 
The effects are as follows:
•	 All trees and large plants (over 3’) in the area of effect become 
sapient, gaining a Magical Voice and two Magical Ears per the 
spells. The trees or large plants acquire the skill Life Sense at 
10% per Class Title of the practitioner. These plants are unable 
to uproot themselves but can move branches. These friendly 
plants now can now grow fruit, seeds, spores, or pods that 
equals a day’s meal, and they will offer this and any aid they can 
to passersby.
•	 The 4 plants outlining the edges gain a warning cry that will 
warn if danger threatens the grounds.
•	 All animals on the grounds gain a poisonous bite or sting 
(causing sleep), which they will use to defend themselves, if 
necessary. Poison type is set by the practitioner per animal and 
cannot be higher than twice Class Title of the practitioner. In 
addition, the animals’ attacks do 1 more die of damage, since 
their claws, fangs, maw, etc. become sharper. 
•	 All undead within the grounds suffer 1 point of damage per 
minute from the immense flow of positive life force.
•	 Allies who sleep on the grounds have pleasant dreams and an 
overall calming effect, removing Fear and allowing a new Will 
Force save if they have an Insanity.
•	 Enemies who are sleeping on the grounds have nightmares, and 
a Will Force save is required once per night to avoid gaining an 
Insanity (Insanity types are provided in the Master’s Manual).
•	 Allies’ wounds heal at double the normal rate. 
•	 Enemies’ wounds are worsened by 2 Endurance per day in each 
body area. 
•	 A sense of peace overcomes all allies who are within the 
grounds. Those with less than a 15 Will Force must make a 
Control Resistance to attack or take hostile action.
•	 A sense of dread overcomes all enemies who are on the 
grounds. Those with less than a 15 Will Force must make a 
Control Resistance or flee.
•	 Allies who die on the grounds will be reincarnated per the skill 
Reincarnation, unless they choose not to. 
•	 Enemies who die on the grounds and whose heads are 
not completely destroyed are immediately infected with 
living spores. These spores are constantly floating in the air 
throughout the grounds. These spores detect as divine magical 
dust encompassing the area, and a single Perception Check is 
allowed for beings who specifically look around in search of 
anything in the air. These spores enter the corpse and over the 
next minute completely heal all physical damage to the corpse. 
Once the corpse is fully healed, the spores begin animating the 
corpse, even to the point of standing and walking slowly and 
disjointedly. Even though this would appear to an observer 
that the corpse is now a zombie, it is actually the spores within 
the corpse that make it mobile, and no negative life force is 
present. Beings detecting the corpse with Life Sense will find a 
colony of living spores. These fungal “zombies” will defend the 
grounds against enemies by attacking (at Beginner attack skill) 
either with any weapons lying around or by crafting their own 
makeshift weapons. Lacking these, they will grapple, punch, 
kick, or bite their enemies. However, as soon as the spores have 
healed the damage to the corpse, the corpse slowly rots away 
at -1 Endurance per day to all areas until it falls apart into a 
yellow-green mess of fungus. The fungus will be absorbed into 
the ground over the next 1d4+1 days until there is no sign at 
all that the being was there, except for any non-organic objects 
they carried.
Special Notes: Animals on the grounds will not harm the 
practitioner or her allies unless they are attacked first. Even should 
this occur, the animals’ poison has no effect on the practitioner. 

===== PAGE 156 =====
150
Critical Success: Full illusionary simulacrums of 4 humanoid 
defenders of the skill user’s race will appear on the grounds. These 
defenders will appear to attack enemies, inflicting 1d10 illusory 
damage per Class Title of the practitioner for each attack. Any 
damage that would kill the victim causes him instead to go into a 
deep coma. If he fails a Vitality save, he suffers heart failure (3-30 
points per minute to the upper torso for 1d6 minutes). This coma 
and illusionary damage can only be removed by Dispel Magic, 
Dispel Illusion, Mind Set, Mind Change, Exorcism, Body Control, 
and Healing. Heart failure damage must be removed as normal 
damage. Otherwise, the victim will be in a coma for 30 days minus 
1 day per Wisdom point. An Illusion Resistance can be made to 
avoid the effects of the defenders’ damage, but only if requested (at 
+25% if told that his damage is only illusionary). Doing so takes 
1d4+1 seconds. For more information, see the Magic Section of the 
Player’s Guide under “Illusion Spells”.
Critical Failure: No additional attempts to make that specific 
area Nature’s Ground can be attempted unless the skill chance is 
increased, and no further attempts can be made within 1000’ of the 
failed attempt.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 7 and 5 divine magical skills.
PREDATION
Attributes: Intelligence, Will Force	
Rating: 20
Start Bonus: 1d6%		
	
Time: 1 Second
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to mark and pursue a prey. 
General Usage: The practitioner spends 1 second naming out loud 
a living or undead target of any type. The target does not have 
to be within sight, but the practitioner must have seen the target 
within the last 1 day per Class Title. If a skill roll is successful, 
the target is marked for 1 day per Class Title. While that target is 
within 10 miles per Class Title, the practitioner can concentrate 
for 5 seconds, make a second skill roll at +20%, and then teleport 
within sight of the target. The practitioner will teleport to an area 
at the farthest point-blank missile weapon range of the specific 
missile weapon the practitioner is holding. If holding a melee 
weapon, then the practitioner appears directly in front (within 
10’) of the enemy. If the entire area 10’ in front of the target is 
completely filled and does not allow for the practitioner to appear 
there, then the skill will attempt to place the practitioner to either 
flank. If both flanks are filled, then it will place them to the rear. If 
the entire area within a 10’ radius of the target is filled and there 
is no safe place to teleport to, then the practitioner will sense this 
as they begin to concentrate and only 1 second will be used, after 
which the skill user will know to stop attempting this skill. As 
soon as the target being is marked, he is affected by a terrible and 
all-encompassing fear. Every hour, the marked victim must make 
a Control Resistance or attempt to find a safe place to flee or hide. 
If the marked victim sees the practitioner, then all resistances are 
-20% and he must roll a modified Control Resistance every 10 
seconds or flee. Whether this resistance is made or not, all actions 
against the practitioner are at -20% or -4.
Special Usage: Once marked, the practitioner can make a skill roll 
at +20% to detect the direction of and distance to the target.  
Notes: Under no circumstance will the practitioner be teleported 
into another object or being, nor onto a dangerous material such 
as molten lava or into open air to fall, etc. This skill will still be able 
to find a target who is under the effect of Non-Detection, but not 
targets who are Vanished or Inscrutable.
Critical Success: The duration of marking increases by +2 days, 
and the distance is increased by +100 miles.
Critical Failure: The practitioner suffers mental fatigue and cannot 
try to mark the target again that day.
Requirements: Title 15.
PSALM LORE
Attributes: Charm, Piety	
	
Rating: 17
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: Varies
Type: Divine Magical	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: The ability to write, learn, and perform divine 
psalms dedicated to the skill user’s particular deity with various 
divine effects. Psalms are combinations of two or more hymns, 
producing a combined effect. Psalms work in stages, with effects 
accumulating after the psalmist has spent the appropriate amount 
of time for each. Thus, if a psalmist combined “Forgiveness” with 
“Communion”, the effects of “Forgiveness” would occur first (after 
15 seconds), and then those of “Communion” (10 seconds later).
General Usage: If the psalmist finds a divine psalm, he must roll a 
successful Psalm Lore skill roll to learn it (at the highest rating of 
the hymns included) after 2-7 hours of study ((1d6+1) x1 hour). 
A psalmist must first have memorized a psalm before it can be 
performed. Psalms require 5 minutes per rating point to memorize 
and require a number of memorization points equal to the highest 
rating of the hymns included. If the skill user wants to compose 
a psalm, 3-12 (3d4) days of meditation and concentration are 
required for each hymn effect, during which the psalmist allows 
his deity to create music through him, before a Psalm Lore skill roll 
may be attempted. If successful, the psalmist has combined two or 
more hymns into a single psalm, and whenever she performs the 
psalm by making a successful Psalm Lore skill roll, the effects of 
that psalm take place. The effects begin shortly after the psalmist 
begins the psalm and lasts either until the psalm ends or some time 
afterwards (see the effects of individual hymns). Listeners may be 
greatly moved while hearing the divine words to the psalm, but 
such feelings are temporary and will eventually fade. The psalmist 
may sing through the entirety of each psalm multiple times in 
order to keep its effect going, but every 10 minutes, the psalmist 
must make a Vitality save to continue. There is a cumulative -5% 
chance for every Vitality save after the first. When the Vitality save 
fails, the psalmist is unable to continue singing or playing and is 
considered fatigued one level for every 10 minutes he has been 
playing. 
Notes: Psalms must be sung with instrumental accompaniment, 
for the words are integral to the divine effects and the underlying 
harmony strengthens the idea behind the words. Obviously, the 
instrument to be played must not be a wind instrument, such as a 
flute, but rather one played only by the psalmist’s hands. The user 
may sing and play while performing simple physical actions like 
walking and crouching, but nothing complex that requires his 
hands. If the psalmist takes over half damage to a single body area 
(such as taking 11 damage to a 20-point body area), an Intelligence 
save is required to continue singing. If the damaged body area is 
a vital area, the Intelligence save is at -20% and a Piety save is also 
necessary to keep singing.
Special Notes: Those without the sense of hearing will be 
unaffected by psalms. Listeners must understand the language 

===== PAGE 157 =====
151
of the psalm to be affected. One starting psalm is chosen (or 
assigned by the GM) when the skill is acquired. Psalm effects can 
be self-taught by a week of practice and making a successful half 
skill roll (versus the highest rating of the hymns included). Failure 
indicates that this psalm effect cannot be learned until the skill 
increases. Only one additional self-taught effect can be learned per 
Practitioner Title.
Critical Failure: The psalmist may not attempt to sing this 
particular psalm again until the skill chance is increased.
Critical Success: -10% to the target’s saves or resistances.
Repeat Failure: The psalmist may not attempt to sing this 
particular psalm again until the skill chance is increased. Also, 
the psalmist’s vocal cords are strained, resulting in all Hymn Lore, 
Sing, Sing Songs, Recite, and Recite Poetry skills being at 1/2 their 
skill chance for the rest of the day or until that body area (head) is 
healed for at least 1 point.
Requirements: Title 9, Intone, and Hymn Lore.
READ DREAM
Attributes: Intelligence, Will Force	
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 1 minute
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to enter and read the dreams 
of another being. 
General Usage: The practitioner enters into a relaxed state, falls 
asleep, and slips into a lucid dream state. The practitioner then 
imagines the being or creature whose dreams she is trying to read 
(the target being must also be asleep for the skill to succeed). The 
practitioner must either be able to visualize the target or know the 
target’s True Name. The target can be anywhere, on any plane. If 
the skill roll is made, then the target’s dream is entered and can 
be viewed by the practitioner. The practitioner cannot alter the 
target’s dream in any way and is only an observer. Targets with an 
Intelligence of 20 or higher are allowed a Single Perception Check 
to get a funny feeling upon waking that something was strange 
about their dream, but they don’t know what that was.
Notes: Beings or creatures affected by Mind Set, Mind Change, 
Non-detection, Vanish, or Inscrutable cannot have their dreams 
read. A successful Meditate skill roll before falling asleep will grant 
+10% to Read Dream, and the practitioner is +20% to Read Dream 
when targeting an ally.
Critical Failure: No further attempt may be made to read that 
target’s dream until the following day/night. 
Critical Success: The practitioner may now communicate with 
the target, if desired. When first entering the target’s dream, the 
practitioner induces the target to create an image of how the 
target imagines and feel about the practitioner. The practitioner 
then appears and sounds in the dream as that image. Because of 
this, the practitioner can discover how the target imagines and 
feels about him (with a Double Perception Check), based on how 
the target has create the practitioner’s image within their dream. 
Once the practitioner’s image is present, the practitioner uses it to 
communicate. If the target has never heard of the practitioner, the 
practitioner’s image is up to the GM’s discretion. Targets with an 
Intelligence of 20 or higher are allowed a Double Perception Check 
to get the funny feeling that the person they were talking to in their 
dream seemed awfully real. They have no proof but can’t shake 
the feeling and may attempt to prove this somehow (i.e. Omen, 
Divination, etc.).
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title 3.
RETAIN CONTROL
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
Time: 1 minute
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill allows the practitioner to continue 
controlling a target after the normal expiration of whatever effect 
caused the initial control (such as 1 hour per Practitioner Title 
through the skill Beguile or 1 minute per Piety Control through 
the invocation Control Magical Plant), or to prolong the duration a 
summoned creature must stay with the practitioner (such as 1 day 
per Aura through the spell Summon or 1 minute per Aura through 
spells that summon elementals).
General Usage: The practitioner makes a skill roll any time before 
the initial effect’s control or summon period expires. If successful, 
the control or summon duration will be extended for 1 day past 
the normal expiration. Each new day past that requires a new 
successful skill roll. If the skill roll fails, the duration ends at its 
normal expiration (whether original or extended), and the targeted 
being is released from the effect. 
Special Usage: Beings that have lost mental combat and are made 
into mental slaves usually slowly ebb away, losing one Will Force 
point each day until finally their will is crushed and their spirit is 
released. If the practitioner targets her mental slave with Retain 
Control, however, no Will Force is lost that day.
Special Notes: Instead of just extending the effect’s duration 
by 1 day, a control effect (not a summoning one) can be made 
permanent by spending 1 Will Force point by the practitioner after 
a successful Retain Control skill roll. A Control Resistance against 
this permanency is afforded to the target upon the expiration of 
the current control effect’s duration (whether initial or extended). 
If either the skill roll fails or the Control Resistance is made, then 
the control effect immediately ends and no Will Force is spent. 
Any attempts to remove control under the effect of Retain Control 
(such as the skill Absolve Control, the ritual Protection, or the spell 
Dispel Magic) has a penalty of -20% to the chance (treat spells as 
having a chance of 5% per Aura). Or, if the effect removing control 
is automatic (such as the invocation Balk), it has an 80% chance 
to succeed (any necessary Control Resistances by the target still 
apply). Anyone attempting to break the control of a target affected 
by Retain Control who critically fails cannot try again on that 
target until their power or level is increased (higher Aura Control, 
Piety Control, or skill chance). Any permanent control established 
through use of Retain Control that is broken (through a Wish, 
artifact, etc.) returns the spent Will Force point to the practitioner.
Critical Failure: No further attempts can be made to retain control 
of this target with this skill until the skill chance is increased. 
Critical Success: The target is controlled for 2 additional days 
instead of 1 before a new skill roll is required. 
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failures within a single day as a critical 
failure.
Requirements: Title 4 and 2 skills which can cause control or 
control-like effects, such as Beguile or Charming.

SHADOW FORM
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 19
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: 2-7 seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to change his form into pure 
shadow, causing his flesh and bone to transform into spirit.
General Usage: The practitioner concentrates for 1d6 seconds in 
an attempt to alter his form into pure shadow. If the skill roll is 
successful, the following occurs:
•	 All but one part of the practitioner’s body is considered shadow 
shifted and is affected by shadow shofted effects only. The skill 
user designates a vital body area (upper torso, head, etc.) when 
this skill is first acquired to remain in the earthly plane while 
in Shadow Form. This unshifted body area can be struck by 
physical or magical damage (any damage taken is halved).
•	 Gains Immunity to Cold, Hold, and Darkness effects.
•	 Can manipulate shadow within range of 3’ per Will Force point 
as the spell Manipulate Shadow. Treat the area of effect as if cast 
at 2 Aura per Class Title.
•	 Can pass through solid objects at half walking speed.
•	 Moves by thought alone as the spell True Flight.
•	 Gains Magical Sight, Magical Hearing, Magical Smell, and 
Magical Touch.
•	 Cannot imbibe any food or drink, including potions and herbs.
Special Usage: The practitioner can both sense ghosts of all age 
types as well as summon them to himself in 1-2 seconds, as long 
as they are within 10’ per Will Force point. Once a ghost has 
been summoned, the skill user may speak with it via Telepathy. 
Furthermore, ghosts will not attack the practitioner unless 
provoked. 
Special Notes: This skill may not be used non-acquired.
Critical Failure: No further attempts to transform can be made for 
1 minute. A Will Force save is required to avoid 1 level of
mental fatigue.
Critical Success: The practitioner initiates Shadow Form within 
a shell of darkness per the spell Darkness, and this darkness is 
centered within them as they move in Shadow Form. 
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 15.
SHADOWFROST KNOWLEDGE
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 12
Start Bonus: 2d10%	
	
Time: Varies
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: The ability to learn and cast spells tinged with energy 
from the Shadow Plane.
General Usage: Rather than casting spells through the traditional 
Scroll Knowledge method, a practitioner of Shadowfrost 
Knowledge draws Aura from the Shadow Plane, causing her spells 
to be tinged with light. As the user grows in power and gains Aura 
Control, she immediately gains knowledge of certain Shadowfrost 
spells without having to learn spell notes, scribe spells into a 
spellbook, or memorize anything. Furthermore, the user may also 
draw power from the Phase Plane to cast other spells, as long as she 
has a magical scroll or written description of a spell and memorizes 
them (taking up Memorization Points). Both of these categories of 
spells each have their own requirements and effects:
 
Casting Shadowfrost spells:
•	 Knowledge of how to cast the spell is automatically known 
without being taught as the practitioner gains the appropriate 
Aura Control. No spell notes or memorization is necessary.
•	 Spell effects are only in dim shades of gray, including items 
produced with Produce spells.
•	 Spell effects are cast at full strength.

SHADOWFROST LORE
Attributes: Intelligence, Knowledge	
Rating: 18
Start Bonus: 1d10%	
	
Time: Varies
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: The ability to enhance skills and spells that utilize 
darkness, shadow, and cold.
General Usage: The following bonuses and abilities are granted 
though Shadowfrost Lore: 
When using the skills Umbrakinesis and Cryokinesis:
•	 Treat the practitioner as though both her Class and Practitioner 
Titles are 1 higher than their actual values.
•	 After concentrating for 10 seconds, a successful Shadowfire 
Lore skill roll allows the user to add her Shadowfrost Lore 
chance to her next skill roll.
•	 For every full 20% of Shadowfrost Lore, the practitioner may 
deduct 10% (maximum of 50%) from the usage times.
•	 The skill user gains the specialization abilities.
When casting special Shadowfrost Spells:
The skill user gains immediate spell mastery of one Shadowfrost 
spell, followed by one new spell for every Title gained thereafter 
with a successful Shadowfrost Lore skill roll (see Shadowfrost 
Knowledge for the list of spells). Mastered spells gain the following 
benefits: 
•	 The caster gains +2 Aura Control for that spell.
•	 No somatic gestures are needed to cast the spell, only verbal.
•	 The casting time can be halved (rounded up).
•	 The area affected can be changed when cast so long as it does 
no increase the overall volume. No dimension can be decreased 
more than 1/4 distance (this allows for basic spell shape 
changing).
•	 The range and distance to focus can be increased by up to 3x 
the normal distance.
•	 The duration can be doubled.
•	 The spell may be made permanent as per the spell Permanency 
at 1/2 the Will Force cost, regardless of whether the spell caster 
has the spell Permanency or not.
•	 The caster is +20% to all saves/resistances involving this spell if 
used against him.
•	 Targets of the spell are -20% to any saves/resistances required, 
including Illusion Resistance if requested.
•	 Mastered spells can be taught to students at +20% to the 
student’s Scroll/Shadowfrost Knowledge roll.
•	 The caster cannot be interrupted by loss of concentration 
unless taking a wound that reduces an area to negative 
Endurance.
Special Usage: Practitioners of Shadowfrost Lore so deeply 
understand the relationship between Aura and the Shadow Plane 
that they can create new effects for the skills Umbrakinesis and 
Cryokinesis. The practitioner devises the effect and then makes 
both a roll for the appropriate skill and a successful Shadowfrost 
Lore roll. If both rolls are successful, the practitioner has learned 
the new effect and can use it per the rules of the skill in question. 
All created effects, including their ratings and modifiers, are 
subject to GM approval. 
Special Notes: This skill may not be used non-acquired.
Critical Failure: The practitioner may not use Shadowfrost Lore 
for 1 day.
Requirements: Title 7 and Shadowfrost Knowledge.
SHADOWFROST MASTERY
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 20
Start Bonus: 1d6%		
	
Time: 1 second
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: A practitioner of this skill is the mastery of shadow 
and frost. 
General Usage: The following bonuses and abilities are granted 
though Shadowfrost Lore:
When using the skills Umbrakinesis and Cryokinesis:
•	 Skill rolls are +5% per full 20% of Shadowfrost Mastery.
•	 One skill can be mastered for every full 50% of Shadowfrost 

===== PAGE 160 =====
154
Mastery. Mastery requires 1 day of uninterrupted concentration 
and a successful Shadowfrost Mastery roll. Skill mastery affords 
the practitioner the following bonuses:
•	 Usage times for all its various effects is 2 seconds, unless 
already at 1 second.
•	 Effects can be maintained without continued concentration if 
an Intelligence save is made.
•	 The practitioner can add the total chance of her Shadowfrost 
Mastery skill to the skill roll.
•	 The skill user gains the Mastery Ability.
Special Powers: The user gains 2 powers, each taking 5 seconds to 
activate and fulfilling the requirements for leveling past 10th Title:
•	 The user can activate an area of True Night around her in a 
sphere with a radius of 100’ per Class Title. The affected area 
is filled with the utter darkness of night, resulting in all effects 
which are dependent upon darkness or nighttime, regardless of 
the actual time (for example, any vampires within range would 
be positively affected).
•	 The user can surround herself with a Circle of Cold with a 
radius of up to 3’ per Class Title. The circle’s edge is 1” wide, 
floats 6” off the ground, and extends 10’ high. This semi-
transparent column of swirling frost causes the following 
effects:
•	 Anything or anyone touching the circle besides the user must 
make a Magic Resistance once per contact or suffer 1d4 per 2 
Class Titles. Damage is only assessed once per 5 seconds per 
area or object.
•	 All missile weapons fired into or out of the circle are at -4 to hit 
and have damage reduced by half.
•	 All melee attacks into or out of the circle are at -2 to hit and 
lose 1 point per damage die rolled.
•	 View is partially obstructed, causing -2 Initiative rolls for the 
user.
•	 Damage of cold-based spells cast though the column is reduced 
to half due to the coldness of the frost.
•	 The frost remains trapped magically within the column and 
does not leave this area of effect, regardless of circumstance.
•	 Large objects (structures) that obstruct the circle merely cause 
a temporary disappearance of that portion of the frost column.
•	 The skill user may not use another circle spell (either through a 
power or scroll) while this Circle of Cold is in effect.
Special Notes: This skill may not be used non-acquired. 
Critical Failure: The practitioner is unable to master the skill in 
question until her Shadowfrost Mastery skill is raised.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 10, Shadowfrost Knowledge, and Shadowfrost 
Lore.
SHADOW SHIFT
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 10 Seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Allows the practitioner to become physically 
insubstantial and enter the Shadow Plane. 
General Usage: The user focuses her intent on becoming shadowy 
and insubstantial so that she may slip into the Shadow Plane. A 
skill roll is required at the end of a 10 second period to see if the 
attempt was successful. The practitioner remains shadow shifted 
until a second skill roll is made to become tangible and return to 
the earthly plane. There is a cost, however, for remaining on the 
Shadow Plane:
•	 Each hour of exposure requires a Control Resistance; 
each failure temporarily reduces Will Force by 1 until the 
practitioner returns to the natural universe, at which point her 
Will Force will return at a rate of 1 per hour.
•	 If the practitioner’s Will Force reaches 0 while on the Shadow 
Plane, she dies and rises as an undead. Practitioners whose 
original Will Force rating was under 15 rise as a Shade, and 
those with 15 or higher rise as a Shadowman. 
Special Usage: While on the Shadow Plane, the practitioner may 
temporarily spend 1 Will Force point to move 1’. The practitioner 
may use existing shadow-shifted surfaces for movement at no Will 
Force cost.
Notes: The Shadow Plane can have objects of its own stored there, 
and there are many creatures which exist in shadow form. While 
a being is shifted, she appears slightly grayed and shadowy at 
a glance, but careful observation will note that the being is not 
standing directly on a surface. Beings and objects on the Shadow 
Plane remain motionless unless another skill or a spell of flight or 
propulsion affects them. Sometimes large objects such as a room 
will be shifted; in such cases, a shifted being can walk on such 
surfaces.
Special Notes: Shadow-shifted beings can have no direct 
interaction with the earthly plane (including physical, mental, 
magical, or otherwise), except when using Shadow Adhere, 
Shadow Shackles, Unlimited Wish, or an artifact.
Critical Failure: No further attempts may be made for 1 minute, 
and the practitioner is mentally fatigued. 
Critical Success: The practitioner will be +20% to shadow shift 
within 1000’ of this area from now on, due to familiarity.
Repeat Usage: Each usage in a day’s time has a 1% cumulative 
chance of attracting a nearby creature on the Shadow Plane (Shade, 
Shadowman, etc.).
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failures in a minute’s time as a critical 
failure.
Requirements: Title 9, Body Control, Meditate, and Spirit Travel. 
Alternatively: Title 9, Spirit Travel, and 10 magical skills. 
Game System Notes: Replaces the 12th Title Shadow Stalker 
skill Phase. For the 15th Title Shadow Stalker skill Shadow Form, 
the skill user is not phased, but rather shadow-shifted, and is 
completely immune to the Will Force draining effects of the 
Shadow Plane unless choosing to succumb to it. 
SOMNOLENCE
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 20
Start Bonus: 1d6%		
	
Time: 10 minutes
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes

Description: Places the target being into a deep slumber.

that the target being has fallen into a deep slumber and can be 
awakened only by a method chosen by the practitioner at the time 
of use (true love’s kiss, death of the practitioner, etc.). Target beings 
are allowed an Illusion Resistance to negate this effect, if requested. 
Notes: The practitioner cannot specify a method of awakening 
that would cause physical harm to the target (i.e. being stabbed). 
Should the practitioner do so, or should he fail to specify a method, 
the target being will awaken in 1d10 seconds, and the practitioner 
may not use this skill again on that being.
Critical Failure: The target being becomes aware that the 

===== PAGE 161 =====
155
practitioner was attempting to affect her mind.
Critical Success: The Illusion Resistance needed to avoid the 
effects of this skill suffers a -10% penalty. 
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failed attempts as a critical failure.
Requirements: Title 12, Illusion Knowledge, and Illusion Lore.
SONOKINESIS
Attributes: Intelligence, Aura		
Rating: 14
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: Varies
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill represents the ability to magically 
manipulate air pressure and sonic energy.  
General Usage: The user concentrates on the desired effect and 
mentally wills it to happen. Unlike casting spells, the amount of 
Aura needed to create an effect is constant. The Aura is drained 
from the practitioner’s Aura Pool and returns at her Aura 
Regeneration Rate. Note: Class Title in these usages always refers 
to the Class Title of the practitioner, even when the verbiage 
seems to indicate otherwise. Unless otherwise specified, effects are 
instantaneous in duration and have a range of 10’ per Class Title.
Throw Voice (2 Aura; +60% modifier, 1 second + speaking time): 
Allows the practitioner to throw her own voice or sound she 
is producing to any point within sight, oriented in whatever 
direction desired. Additionally, this skill provides a +50% bonus 
to Ventriloquism when used together. The effect persists until 
canceled.
Message (6 Aura; +40% modifier, 1 second + speaking time): 
Allows the practitioner to send a message to a person he visualizes. 
The message may consist of 5 words per Practitioner Title. As the 
message is spoken aloud by the practitioner, the recipient hears the 
message in his mind with the same level, tone, and emphasis used 
by the practitioner.
Bellow (6 Aura; +40% modifier, 1 second + speaking time): Allows 
the practitioner to cause 1 being’s voice to be amplified, increasing 
range of earshot by +100% per Practitioner Title. For example, 
a person singing in normal conditions can be heard clearly for 
around 200’. At 3rd Practitioner Title, Sonokinesis could increase 
that to 200’ x 300%, which is 800’. The effect persists until canceled.
Silence (8 Aura; +30% modifier, 5 seconds): Causes 1 being to make 
a Magic Resistance or be affected by negated sound for 10 seconds 
per Practitioner Title. The target being is unable to hear or be heard 
for the duration, preventing him from casting spells, invoking, and 
performing skills which rely on speech, hearing someone sneak up 
on them, etc. Combatants so affected are -1 to hit, -1 to damage, 
and suffer a Defense Adjustment penalty of +1. This Silence effect 
also bestows a +20% bonus to Surprise and grants +25% to the skill 
Surprise Attack when used against affected individuals.
Amplify (8 Aura; +30% modifier, 5 seconds): Causes 1 being to 
make a Magic Resistance or be affected by amplified sound for 10 
seconds per Practitioner Title. The target being finds ordinarily 
soft sounds agonizing, causing them to be disoriented when 
hearing any noise above ordinary humanoid speaking volume. The 
disoriented being is -1 to Initiative, +50% to be surprised, and +1 
to be struck with weapons. If exposed to 10 seconds of constant 
disorienting sound, the target being is deafened for 10 minutes per 
Practitioner Title. The target being’s Listen skill is increased by 50% 
in quiet conditions but reduced by -50% in loud ones. 
Alarm Trap (10 Aura; +20% modifier, 10 minutes): Creates an 
area no larger than 5 ft³ per Class Title. This area is a set trap that, 
when touched by another Aura field, will be triggered, causing 
a deafening sound (or simply loud if prefered) selected by the 
practitioner to be heard for a full 10 seconds. All beings and 
creatures within 50’ per Practitioner Title can hear the sound, 
and all within 10’ per Practitioner Title need to make a Magic 
Resistance or be deafened. This trap can only be triggered once. 
The Alarm Trap will last for 1 hour per Class Title once set. 
Alternatively, 1/10th of a Will Force can be spent to make the trap 
permanent, resetting every 10 seconds once triggered. 
Alter Echo (10 Aura; +20% modifier, 5 seconds): Causes listeners of 
sounds emitted from an area no more than 100 ft³ per Practitioner 
Title to incorrectly detect the location from which the sounds were 
made. The user chooses from which direction the sounds will be 
perceived to be heard. This effect lasts 10 minutes per Practitioner 
Title.
Wind Burst (10 Aura; +20% modifier, 5 seconds): Causes a sudden 
localized shift in air pressure that creates a circular wall of wind 
that moves outward from the practitioner at a speed of 2 ft. per 
second, to a maximum distance of 5 ft. per Class Title.  Beings with 
an agility of 14 or less must make an Agility save or be thrown to 
the ground.  Flying beings caught in the wind wall are unable to 
move toward the caster until the Wind Burst has passed them.  
Beings with an agility of 15 or higher are immune to the Wind 
Burst effect. This skill will extinguish fires of moderate or light 
intensity within the area of effect.
Dread (12 Aura; +10% modifier, 1 minute): Allows the practitioner 
to use a sound of extreme low frequency to evoke feelings of dread 
and despair in beings who fail a Control Resistance within an area 
of no more than 10 ft2 per Class Title. At 5th Practitioner Title, 
the practitioner can increase the intensity of this sound, causing 
candles and torches to be extinguished, as well as causing affected 
beings to see shadows in the corners of their eyes and be filled with 
terror. Beings so affected must make a Control Resistance at -20% 
or flee the area with all haste. This low frequency sound lasts for 1 
day per Class Title.
Enhance Hearing (14 Aura; no modifier, 5 seconds): Causes the 
caster to be able to hear low volume sounds more easily and 
become more sensitive to vibrations. This lasts for 10 minutes 
per Class Title and provides the user with a +50% to Listen and 
Vibration Sensing.
Sonic Blast (14 Aura; no modifier, 5 seconds): Creates a circular 
wave of intense sound that rolls outward from the practitioner to 
a maximum distance of 10’ per Practitioner Title. Beings caught 
in the affected area must make a Magic Resistance or be stricken 
deaf for 1 hour per Practitioner Title. There is also a 1% chance per 
Practitioner Title that this deafness will be permanent. Affected 

===== PAGE 162 =====
156
beings also take 1-3 points of magical sonic damage per Class 
Title to 1-3 random areas, if the beings fail a Magic Resistance. 
Beings employing Enhance Hearing at the time of the Sonic Blast 
(including elves) suffer double these effects. Those outside the area 
of effect will hear a loud noise but suffer no ill effects.
Sonic Bolt (14 Aura; no modifier, 5 seconds): Creates a bolt of 
focused sound that travels 10’ per Class Title in a straight line.  Any 
being struck will take 1-3 damage per Class Title to a random body 
area and all areas surrounding it. The target is afforded a Magic 
Resistance to avoid damage.
Soundproofing (16 Aura; -10% modifier, 1 minute): Causes a 
specified room or area of no more than 10 ft3 Practitioner Title 
to dampen all sound which would otherwise escape and/or enter 
the area (as the practitioner chooses). Effect lasts for 1 hour per 
Practitioner Title.
Specialization Ability, Sonic Blades (16 Aura; -10% modifier, 5 
seconds): Creates a flurry of pockets of focused air that slice 
through targets like sharp blades. This produces 1 blade per Class 
Title, and each blade does 1d6+1 per Class Title magical cutting 
damage to its target. The practitioner must make an Intelligence 
save to strike her target in the desired location; all blades must 
strike the same target in the same body area. Targets beings who 
make a successful Magic Resistance suffer only half damage; 
making a half Magic Resistance indicates that no damage is taken.
Mastery Ability, Shock Wave (20 Aura; -30% modifier, 5 seconds): 
Causes a tremendous concussive force to blast outward from the 
practitioner. The effect of the Shock Wave on beings and structures 
depends upon their location within the area affected:
•	 Zone 1 (within a distance of 0’-2’ radius per Practitioner Title): 
Beings take 1d8 smashing damage per Practitioner Title to 
4d4 randomly selected body areas, are thrown away from the 
practitioner at a distance of 2’ per Practitioner Title (minus 1’ 
per 50 pounds of weight), and will lose 10 seconds of action 
while recovering from the blast.
•	 Zone 2 (within a range of 2’-4’ radius per Practitioner Title): 
Beings take 1d4 smashing damage per Practitioner Title to 2d4 
randomly selected body areas, are knocked to the ground, and 
lose 1d6+1 seconds of action regaining a standing position.
•	 Zone 3 (within a range of 4’-6’ radius per Practitioner Title): 
Beings take 1-2 smashing damage per Practitioner Title to 1d4 
randomly selected body areas and must make an Agility save or 
be knocked to the ground, requiring 1d6+1 seconds to regain a 
standing position.
Note: A successful Magic Resistance by beings trapped in the 
shock wave reduces damage by half, but knockdown/knockback 
still occurs (Agility saves as applicable). The following spells and 
invocations provide protection against this skill: Invulnerability, 
Sphere of Power, Spirit Wall, Spirit Sphere, and Wall of Power; 
however, each of these indicated protections has a 2% chance per 
Practitioner Title of shattering. Walls of Protection and Spheres of 
Protection will nullify the Sonic Wave’s magic within their affected 
areas.
Special Use: A practitioner who makes a successful skill roll 
when forced to suffer the effects of a sonic-based attack or effect 
gains +20% to the required Magic Resistance for that attack. 
Furthermore, any damage from the attack is reduced by -1 per die. 
Critical Success: Half Aura requirements.
Critical Failure: The skill user is unable to use Sonokinesis for 1 
minute and must make a Will Force save or suffer mental fatigue.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Title 1 and Kinetics Knowledge.
SOUL KNOWLEDGE
Type: Informational
Attributes: Knowledge	
	
Rating: 20
Start Bonus: 1d6%		
	
Time: 2-7 Seconds
Restricted: Yes	
	
	
Learn Time: N/A
Description: This skill represents the ability tap into the past life or 
lives and recover buried memories of a previous incarnation. 
General Usage: When the skill user wishes to use an informational 
skill whether they possess it or not then this skill may be used 
in its place. The informational skills it can replace are as follows 
Planar Lore, Undead Lore, Ruins Lore, Bestiary Lore, Artifact Lore, 
Legend Lore and Animal Lore. 
Special Usage: When combined with training (especially with the 
skill instruction) a skill roll may be made to teach any skill or lore 
they had or had access to in a past life to another. Although they 
will not know how they knew how to teach the skill or lore. When 
they are done training, they themselves do not retain more than 
fleeting glimpsed of how they knew the skill or lore. 
Special Notes: If the GM determines that none of the past lives 
were exposed to the information desired then this skill cannot be 
used. It can replace any lore or knowledge that makes sense but 
once it is determined that they don’t have an area of knowledge 
new rolls are not allowed in that area as it is something they didn’t 
know. For example, they enter an ancient tomb and fail a soul 
knowledge skill roll to know background information on the tomb 
from previous lives. This means that not only don’t they know 
the general background of the tomb but when they make other 
inquires these will fail automatically as the previous roll indicates 
this was not an area of knowledge they remember form a past life.  
Critical Success: An actual memory is relived giving the 
information although some of the details may be lost.
Critical Failure: The information cannot be retrieved and the 
practitioner cannot use the skill again to retrieve this knowledge 
without increasing the chance. 
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 repeat failures as a Critical Failure.
Requirements: Must have lived one or more past lives or been an 
incarnate.
SPIN STRIKE
Attributes: Agility, Will Force	
Rating: 14
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: Special
Type: Combat	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Grants a combatant the ability to spin while holding 
melee weapons and strike multiple opponents. The practitioner can 
inflict multiple strikes in mere seconds, including re-attacking the 
initial opponent after striking another.
General Usage: The practitioner rolls a skill chance to hit the 
first opponent normally, using normal weapon speed. For each 
additional attack on any opponent within range, the practitioner 
must successfully make another Spin Strike roll at a cumulative 
-5% penalty. Each attack after the first takes 1 second and can be 
made in any order, as long as it is within engagement distance 
(10’) of the practitioner and the same opponent is not struck 

===== PAGE 163 =====
157
twice in succession by the same weapon in the same location. 
The practitioner may attack the same opponent using 2 different 
weapons in the same second, but he must make 2 separate skill 
rolls with their cumulative -5% penalties. 
Notes: Weapons used in this skill must have an adjusted weapon 
speed of 3 seconds or less.
Special Usage: The practitioner may substitute a Feint or False 
Attack roll in place of a regular attack (or attacks if using 2 
weapons in the same second) with no cumulative penalty. Even if 
the Feint or False Attack skill roll is failed, the spin strike maneuver 
may continue with further attacks with a successful Spin Strike skill 
roll. 
Critical Success: There is no -5% penalty for the next spin attack 
roll in that spin attack maneuver.
Critical Failure: An Agility save is required to avoid being off 
balance, resulting in a loss of 1d4+1 seconds of action.
Repeat Failure: None.
Requirements: Title 5, Feint, False Attack, Sweep, and Weapon 
Knowledge.
STUPOR
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 20
Start Bonus: 1d6%		
	
Time: 10 seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Causes the target being to feel less intelligent. 
General Usage: The user concentrates on an individual within 
sight and makes a skill roll. Success indicates that the target 
feels less intelligent, lowering their Intelligence, Wisdom, and 
Knowledge by 2 points per Practitioner Title (-5 maximum).  An 
Illusion Resistance is allowed to negate this effect, if requested. 
Beings so affected act as though their affected attributes are actually 
lower for the duration of the skill by forgetting languages and skills, 
losing memorized spells due to having fewer memorization points, 
lowering Aura and Piety Control, raising Initiative, and potentially 
affecting Illusion and Control Resistances. Actual spells and lore 
are not truly lost, just access to them. 
Notes: The effects of this skill last for 1 minute per Practitioner 
Title.
Critical Failure: No further attempts can be made to stupefy this 
target with this skill until the chance is increased.
Critical Success: The duration of the effects is doubled.
Repeat Failure: Treat 3 failed attempts as a critical failure.

SUSCEPTIBILITY
Attributes: Aura, Will Force	 	
Rating: 16
Start Bonus: 2d6%		
	
Time: 10 seconds
Type: Magical	
	
	
Restricted: Yes
Learn Time: N/A
Description: Lowers all resistances of the target being or beings.
General Usage: The user concentrates on an individual or group 
within sight and makes a skill roll. Success indicates that the target 
or targets suffer from a penalty of -5% per Practitioner Title (-30% 
maximum) to all resistances. Target beings are allowed an Illusion 
Resistance to negate this effect, if requested.
Notes: This skill can affect a maximum of 1 being per Class Title of

Critical Failure: The target being(s) become aware that the 
practitioner was attempting to affect their mind(s).
Critical Success: The target’s resistances are lowered by an
