Order, Repairer (Supernatural, Magical Animal, Level 5)
The Repairer is a form of Crystorinn (crystal animal) that resembles a semi-translucent armadillo save that they have six 
limbs, a maw and no tail. They have curved, overlapping crystal plates which protect them, including shallow cups over 
their four hands and larger ones over their larger, rear feet. They can roll themselves completely into a ball and propel 
themselves by using the cups on their feet to push along and the four cups on their hands to steer. They can subsist on 
crystals and minerals including phosphors from organic flesh though they will not eat anything that was recently alive. 
They prefer crystals plants and non-living crystals like salt and quartz. They pleasure energy from fixing broken objects and 
structures. They can use that energy for healing or growth. They are highly desired for their magical repairing ability. What 
they do is instinctive rather than through understanding of what they are fixing. 
Habits/Life Cycle: Each Repairer is a hermaphrodite. Every few years they will begin to horde broken things instead of 
repairing them. Then they will show this to perspective mates. If the potential mate is impressed by their collection of 
broken objects, the two will mate and a clutch of 1-3 eggs will be laid in the collection of broken objects. The original 
Repairer will leave and the non-egg laying Repairer will remain to protect the eggs. This is one of the rare times these 
creatures are dangerous. It takes about 1 month for the eggs to hatch. Each has about a 2/3rd chance of hatching (66%).

Order, Servitor (Supernatural, Magical Humanoid, Level 5)
Servitors were created by the Planar as servants and assistants in their great tasks. They appear to be floating, translucent 
crystal golems with no lower torso or legs. They have articulated hands that include three fingers and two thumbs. They 
glow slightly but can also emit light as needed from a tight beam to a soft diffuse light. They are known for their ability to 
repair objects, mend wounds and inflictions, and their ability to work tirelessly at any task assigned to them. They have 
magical voices and senses. They have no need of sustenance at all, maintaining themselves nearly indefinitely. Planar will 
sometimes send Servitors into other planes to do their work or to serve new masters. So it is that Servitors are numerous 
in the Plane of Order but found many places outside it. They are Neutral in alignment. They may refuse a task that is too 
fanatical or dangerous for their sensibilities. Those that do not sometimes become different alignments.  
Habits/Life Cycle: Servitors can reproduce by building a copy of themselves over 2 months with access to magical crystal 
once per 10 years. They breathe life into the new Servitor and lose a Will Force point. The new Servitor comes online and is 
instructed by the first until it either is released to seek a new master, instructed to serve the existing master, or the current 
effort of the creator Servitor. They can live indefinitely if not destroyed. 
Climate/Habitat: The Plane of Order and throughout the planes as servants of other beings.

Order, Shimmering Lichen (Supernatural, Magical Plant, Level 4)
This lichen tends to be found either in corpses (both organic and crystalline) or in doorways or windows of abandoned or 
disused structures. It appears to be a carpet of shimmering, mica-like flakes in a mat 2-4 feet long. It gives off no odor or 
other betrayal of its living nature until someone disturbs the corpse or brushes against the mat. When it is disturbed, it gives 
off a cloud of crystal spores that floats for many minutes. These spores are dangerous to touch or inhale. Once it comes into 
contact with living or crystal flesh it can cause both poison and disease in the living thing. The disease only follows if the 
Poison Resistance fails but the Poison Resistance must be made every additional minute of contact. The poison paralyzes 
those it touches, and the disease breaks down minerals and/or crystalline structures, causing 1d4 damage per hour to all 
areas until the being dies or is cured. Alcohol is the only non-magical cure.  It can be used to flush the spores from the flesh 
or even make them inert in the body. The being must first drink enough to fail a Vitality save, and then the disease and 
poisons are considered cured. They are otherwise permanent until death or cured by magical or divine means.
Habits/Life Cycle: Shimmering Lichen grows by consuming crystal dust and minerals, including phosphors found in 
organic life. It takes about a week for the spores to convert enough flesh or crystalline structure matter to form a new mat. 
Climate/Habitat: Plane of Order and places connected to it.
Body Type: Mat (about a 1/8” thick)

Order, Silver Seaweed (Supernatural, Magical Plant, Level 3)
This silvery, fibrous and crystalline plant is native to the Astral Sea. It uses minerals, waste products, and sea salts as food 
and is dangerous when it is hungry. It squeezes and maws down on beings trying to get them to release minerals and 
waste. When well fed, it is docile and can even be handled with no danger. Each nerve bundle has a hard crystal shell with 
soft spots where it senses and a good size area of overlapping flaps that can open, revealing a plant maw that it uses to 
grind up nutrients. It has tendrils that reach outward to the next nerve bundle. Strands have a fibrous crystal hide on the 
outside in overlapping segments. It has central, oversized, core tendrils that remain connected to the next nerve bundle, 
but it also has enough tendrils that can release their grasp on opposite tendrils to swim or crawl if on land.  It can also emit 
bioluminescence from its strands, allowing it to better see through murky waters or darkened areas. The outer ends are 
always loose unless it is mating with another Silver Seaweed. Sometimes these creatures are called living rope because they 
are tamable and (animal-like) when fed waste and crystals, especially salt. Though they prefer salty water, they can climb 
onto land with ease.  
Habits/Life Cycle: Silver Seaweed can live for centuries if it can find minerals and crystals. If unable to eat for more than 
a year, the nerve bundles begin to wither. At the end of 10 years the strands holding them together break and the creature 
dies.  
When a Silver Seaweed encounters others of their kind they can mate, much as animals do. The outer tendrils on both sides 
writhe and join with each other. One side is male and the other female, and so the fully hermaphroditic Silver Seaweed 
mate for about a day and then separate. Hours later each produces a dozen, fertilized pods that will float freely in the Astral 
Sea for a year. When they take in enough salt and nutrients, they begin growing out strands and nerve bundles from the 
central pod. This continues until it reaches maturity in an additional year. Once a Silver Seaweed has produced pods it takes

Phase, Doppelganger (Supernatural, Magical Humanoid, Level 8)
Doppelganger are completely alien. Many claim their origin is from an alternate universe. In their native form they roughly 
appear to be humanoid with two all-black eyes and neither ears nor a nose, but holes where they would be. Their skin 
undulates and appears to have a life of its own. Although they are vertebrates, the only bone-like structures they have are 
semi-rigid and are more cartilage than bone. This structure runs down their middle serving as a spine. Additionally, they 
have an elongated X bone-like structure attached to the spine that provides rigidity for the arms and legs. Their skin is a 
marvel, being able to change color, shape, and even texture. They are something akin to bloblike, except for the cartilage-
supported legs and arms that allow them to be upright. Doppelganger can magically change their size, and use their biology 
to shape their body into many forms. They have the ability to fly magically which allows them to move freely on the Phase 
Plane. They have a natural aptitude for magical items, and can take powers from them with their Empower skill. They are 
natural actors, disguise artists and excellent at escape and many other stealth intrusive skills. 
They are able to mentally attack their prey, and this is their preferred method of defeating their foes. Doppelganger generally 
win mental combat by mental slavery attacks and then walk the victim’s body back to wherever they are hiding. After which, 
they use their abilities to mimic the mind, while their body envelopes the prey and slowly absorbs it, doing 1d10 points of 
magical acid damage per hour until the victim is completely absorbed. It releases the greasy bones of the victim and then 
changes its shape to become the victim. If it can, it will use the knowledge it gained from the mental attacks to find any allies

Rockholm, Ettin (Two-Headed Giant) (Supernatural, Magical Humanoid, Level 10)
These two-headed Giants are the size of a Stone Giant and are fairly fast. Even with two heads, they are barely sentient and 
other giants see them as mentally damaged or deranged. They are hard to kill because even if one head dies the other can 
utilize all but the arm on the dead head’s side. It is said that these Giants are the product of a breeding program among Eyes 
of Terror that went horribly right. Ettins hate Good Giants more than any other foe. They are usually Evil, though some of 
the heads are insane.  In some rare instances, both heads are insane and this makes them unpredictable and dangerous even 
to themselves and would-be allies. 
Habits/Life Cycle: Ettins live approximately 1000 years, and one is considered an adult around age 30-40.  Their society, 
such that it is, is clannish and based on might. They reproduce slowly, as they generally are very suspicious of one another 
and on their guard making mating difficult.

undead conversion. They were Eyes of Terror transformed into Eyes of Decay, either by themselves through a ritual death or

Rockholm, Eye of Fire (Supernatural, Magical, Level 9)
This unusual being appears as a great, floating, scaled eye. The orb hovers in the air due to constant levitation. Its skin is red, 
reptilian scale, and it has six tentacles that extend outward, three on each side. The tentacles are prehensile and elastic. In 
a resting state. They are three feet long but they can stretch up to nine feet. Each tentacle splits at the end into three parts; 
two fingers and a strong thumb each ending in a talon, allowing it to manipulate and use objects as well as any humanoid 
being. Each tentacle has small holes along its length that allow hearing and smell. Its great maw can unhinge, allowing it to 
chew down on prey with row after row of very sharp teeth and with grinding molars deeper in the mouth. The creature has 
a series of three small, generally closed, holes on its orb opposite of the eye, and is one of its few weaknesses. The largest of 
these three holes is for excretion, but the two higher ones are for reproduction. These being’s origin is Rockholm where they 
have long been enemies of the Giants and Dwarves. They hate both of these races with great passion. These creatures do not 
sleep and never fatigue. They are master controllers and manipulators, known for their cruelty and cunning.  They are nearly 
universally evil. 
Habits/Life Cycle: Each of these creatures is a Hermaphrodite and can breed with any other of its kind. They are fertile once 
every 100 years and lay 3 scaled eggs 1 month after mating. The parent does little more than protect the area the eggs are laid 
in for 1-2 months. The eggs must be kept dry and neither too cold or hot (between 55-85 degrees Fahrenheit) for 3 months. 
After which, the strongest of the three will generally hatch first, eat the other two and begin growing. They are juvenile for 
1 year, during which they have only the control ability and cannot levitate or fly. They will seek a protector being to control

Rockholm, Gigantic Cave Spider, (Supernatural, Magical Animal, Level 9)
This gigantic spider hunts the caves and passages of Rockholm, the Plane of Earth, and in deeper subterranean lairs that

Rockholm, Grendel (Supernatural, Magical Humanoid, Level 13)

Shadow, Green Shadow Flayer (Supernatural, Magical Humanoid, Level 8)
These creatures are clearly from an alternate reality. Whatever method they used to cross over has not yet been revealed. 
They have two known varieties; the smaller green-skinned, Midfolk-sized version and the taller, thin, gray-skinned version. 
Both versions have the same almond-shaped, all back eyes with no apparent pupils and large craniums. Their musculature 
is reduced, making them look emaciated. They have no nose, but instead small nostril openings and no ear ridges, but small 
holes that allow hearing. Both varieties have three fingers and a thumb. These beings accost those who bring light into the 
Plane of Shadow, stealing their shadows. These being use them for various magical purposes, including healing, defense, and 
control of the shadow’s original owner. Shadow Flayers are highly magically adept and can both cast spells and use magical 
items. Most of their magic seems control based, and all of it works from stolen shadows, but they have several innate 
magical powers they can use at will. They use shadows in much the same way a mage uses Aura. Some arcanists believe 
that in their home universe, shadows are Aura, and that they have to steal others’ due to the fact they can no longer restore 
their own magical shadows. Wherever they came from, they are intent on studying, experimenting on, and controlling 
humanoids. Unless they are found wandering alone, they are generally in small groups using something called a Shadow 
Beacon to draw humanoids from the Natural Universe to study them. They typically place the beacon inside of ruins, small 
or nearly empty towns and villages. This magical device draws their subjects into the Shadow Plane, where the Green and 
Gray Shadow Flayers steal shadows, control their victims, and conduct their experiments. The green aliens are interested 
in physical aspects of their victims, and the larger gray study the mental aspects of their victims. Most of them appear to be 
Passive Evil, and have been unfriendly in all encounters so far.   
Habits/Life Cycle: Little is known of it. Both varieties seem to be immortal, and none has ever been seen to reproduce. They 
have small frontal cloaca (or reproductive pouches), where their legs join their lower torso. This is very hard to see and has 
never been found open. They may be hermaphroditic or sterile, because only decayed or small, seemingly vestigial genitalia 
have ever been observed. They excrete and release urine through a small hole on the opposite side of the cloaca, in the rear. 
They have never been observed to be asleep, and are assumed to be always active.
Climate/Habitat: The Plane of Shadow, Alternate Universe, sometimes in abandoned places in the Natural Universe.
Body Type: Small Humanoid

Shadow, Shadow Mongrel (Supernatural, Magical Animal, Level 5)
Much like the Ghost Dog, the Shadow Mongrel is a dog whose spirit is tied to a human, who has died and invested soul into 
the mongrel. Unlike the Ghost Dog who is cherished, the Shadow Mongrel is a dog who was so mistreated in life, that when 
the individual or individuals who tortured it died in the same time frame as the dog. The spirit of the dog and the soul of the 
tormentor get bound together enough that a spark is left behind when the tormentor moves on or becomes a ghost itself. 
The Death Dog that comes to harvest the Shadow Mongrel senses the spark of soul within the Shadow Mongrel and leaves it 
alone. The Shadow Mongrel travels the Shadow Plane and Natural Universe, inflicting cruelty in a futile attempt at revenge 
for what was done to it. These mongrels have no chance to move on until they are utterly destroyed. It is said that when they 
move on,  they descend to become Hell Hounds. 
Habits/Life Cycle: Shadow Mongrels are formed from the remnant spirit of tormented dogs who died alongside one of their 
tormentors. When the abusing being moves on, it leaves a minuscule spark of soul comingled with the spirit of the Shadow 
Mongrel. These supernatural, magical animals then spend their time wandering the place where they died, learning their 
powers, and tormenting any humanoids they come across. Once they discover all their powers, they then venture into the 
Natural Universe, where they can torment more easily. They continue this until they are destroyed. 
Climate/Habitat: The Shadow Plane and the Natural Universe when active.

Shadow, Skeetch (Supernatural, Level 10)

Time Elemental, Prime of Primes (Supernatural, Level 18)
The Prime of Prime is the only Time Elemental. All other elementals, even the prime of each plane, answer to this elemental 
at need, luckily for them, its need is rare. The Prime of Primes rarely leaves the Plane of Time, when it does this is to protect 
from distortions in time, though whatever its actions are, they are so seamless that few know what it did or why. The Prime 
of Primes is the master of all energies, including time itself. There is no greater kineticist, save the Creator, than the Prime 
of Primes as it knows all energies. Out of those who know of it, some believe that the Prime of Primes is a god, but most 
believe it is a servant of time itself, making sure that the celestial machinery that keeps time flowing, and the meta-verse 
continues turning unabated and uncorrupted. It is the alpha and omega. It is True Neutral without regard to Evil or Good, 
order or chaos. One wise old sage said that the only ones who have survived the Prime of Primes are those not in its way as 
stopping it is as hard as stopping time itself.

Time, Intemporal (Supernatural, Magical Humanoid, Level 12)
The Intemporal have two purposes. The first and foremost, is to collect the important experiences within the Mountains 
of Many. This they do endlessly, cataloging them, researching them, and storing them for some unknown purpose. Their 
second duty is as time repairers. They are gray or white skin humanoids that appear in sets of three. They are blurs when 
they move, each moving at a full 10 speed seconds faster than normal, with the ability to blink and teleport as needed. All 
three are the same being. One represents the now, the second the past, and the third the future. They speak in three-word 
sentences that are randomly jumbled, and spoken each by one part of the time-split being. For instance, “who are you?” 
might come out as “you,” “who,” “are.” These beings are not generally dangerous, except to those who are disrupting time 
or who are trying to force interactions with them in the Mountains of Many. They try to repair time stream anomalies, 
especially ones that lead to disastrous results. The future part of the being is a random 1-3 seconds ahead of the now part, 
and the past is a random 1-3 seconds behind. They stay this distance apart from each other in a particular encounter. 
Intelligent beings have figure out that the three are connected: half Intelligence save per 10 seconds of such observations. 
They generally go back to the moments before the event was to take place, and try to change it back to the normal flow; 
barring that, they attack the being or beings causing the disruption by sending them forward in time with their time shifting 
ability. These beings are True Neutral in alignment. 
Habits/Life Cycle: Their origins are clouded in the distant past. Some who know of them 
saw Intemporals are beings that helped with the Creation and now serve to protect it. 
Others claim they are the cursed previous time meddlers, who created catastrophic 
events and now find themselves split into three parts. However they came to be, 
there does seem to be one leader called The Consequent, who deals with the 
greatest of experiences and worst of time problems. The Consequent has the 
ability to Wish once per 1 week of their lived experience even if they are time 
shifting.  
Climate/Habitat: The Plane of Time, within the Mountains of Many, and 
where time incidents take place.

Pookah (Supernatural, Magical Humanoid, Level 13)
The Pookah are very misunderstood beings. They appear to be Midfolk-sized rabbit humanoids, or Lagara. They are 
generally confused with these beings, when they are visible at all. They can also appear to be any non-magical animal. Many 
people think of them as tricksters, but there are few instances of them harming humanoid beings without provocation. 
They see life very differently than most, as they have no memory of their past, but they have memory of what their future 
experiences will be. This can change if the future in front of them does because of time magic or other anomalies. They are 
one of the few creatures that can sense that time has shifted. Many Pookah carry an object they use to Item Tell and see 
what has happened in their immediate past to better understand what they are dealing with. Some consider the Pookah 
a Fae creature because they are often seen intervening in Fae dominated areas. This may be because of the Pookah’s real 
purpose to fix anomalies, and correct the lives of beings effected by magical 
misfortunes, especially time related ones. Pookahs sometimes befriend a 
humanoid, especially reclusive ones, but they rarely show themselves to anyone 
but the humanoid they have befriended. Even when they are intervening in 
someone’s life to fix problems their fixes rarely extend further than strictly 
necessary. They often do so without revealing themselves. They are very hard 
to detect and have many gifts to influence events. Pookahs are Neutral Good 
with order tendencies (however they read as chaotic tendencies to magical 
effects and alignment discernment because their motivations do not seem well 
ordered to others).
Habits/Life Cycle: The origins of the first Pookah are unknown. With debates 
ranging from claims they were created in a Fae magical accident, to claims that 
they popped into existence when the first time anomaly occurred. The Plane 
of Time has its own anomalies in the middle of the vast Desert of Time where 
small verdant pockets occasionally arise. In these, a Pookah will sometimes 
snap into existence, full grown and with full memories of what their purpose 
is, and what their future experiences are most likely to be. They Planewalk 
to where they are needed, returning only to wait for their next time they are 
needed. They age in reverse, finally turning into a strange multicolor egg. Then 
the egg begins to soften and sag, slowly hardening into a shape that looks much 
like a polished river stone. Then this disappears…
Climate/Habitat: The Plane of Time, and wherever there are time anomalies or 
humanoids affected by them.
Body Type: Small (Humanoid)

Time, Sphinx (Supernatural, Magical, Level 15)
Sphinxes are magical beings another of the guardians of time. They patrol the outer desert, the Sands of Time, within the 
Plane of Time. They are depicted in the tombs and great places because few can imagine greater guardians. The males 
have the body of a lion, the wings of an eagle, and the head of a man, whereas a female sphinx has the body of a leopard 
or cheetah, the wings of a hawk, and the head of a woman. They are known for their riddles, that are tests for the wisdom 
of mortals. If the riddle is answered correctly, then a sphinx will allow passage if it is guarding, or simply leave of it is in a 
general area. They are eternal creatures and were created to guard time itself before the plane was locked away from mortal 

===== PAGE 378 =====
372
beings. Now they occasionally can be found in the Natural Universe, adding to their knowledge of creation. They are said to 
be able to read any language and speak any tongue. They have great wisdom and are sometimes sought for this, though they 
rarely impart such knowledge without the solving of a riddle, passing of a quest or the giving of a greater knowledge in trade 
or some mixture of all three. Every sphinx is True Neutral in alignment. 
Habits/Life Cycle: Male and female sphinx can reproduce. The females enter estrus only once every 1000 years but most do 
not breed with the males, even then, generally only doing so when one of their number has been killed. This happens very 
infrequently. Once pregnant, a female sphinx carries a single embryo within her for 10 years. During this period, it has a 
telepathic link with her and learns all that she knows. At the end of this ten-year span the sphinx cub is born, growing to full 
size in a second 10-year span. The female sphinx will watch over the cub during its adolescence but then they part company 
forevermore. Each sphinx can eternally live. They require no sustenance save knowledge. 
Climate/Habitat: The Plane of Time, and sources of knowledge and learning outside of time.

flat top and is half as deep in the water as it is wide. Their top is highly comfortable to sleep on and is useful as a safe haven. 
They become very dangerous due to their spores in the second stage of their lifecycle (see below).  
Habits/Life Cycle: It has two life stages. The first is completely harmless. During this stage it is non-flowering and is a soft 
and an inviting place for humanoids and other creatures to rest. The top six inches of the Bluedrop Seapad is a soft spongy 
material that is exquisitely comfortable to sit or sleep on. The first stage of its life is the growing stage. During this time, 
which can last for decades, it drifts along with the current and creatures come, living on it with nary a problem. 
As it enters the second stage of life, in 30 to 40 years, tendrils begin to grow downward around the edges of the plant. It 
takes about a year for the tendrils to reach their full length of about two feet after which spore pods form on the end of 
each tendril. If the tendrils are disturbed or there is warmth in the soft spongy top, the tendrils stiffen and rise out of the 
water. The pods open and release spores in three waves. These spores affect anyone in or around (within 20 feet) of the 
pod. The first wave is a sleep and a paralysis poison. It is virulent: -20% Poison Resistance and instantaneous Potency J. The 
sleep becomes permanent until the poison is cured because it settles into the victim’s brain. This changes sleep hormones 
into ones that produce a deep, dreamless sleep and paralysis. After 30 seconds the second wave of spores is released. These 
spores are protector spores. They are also virulent: -20% Poison Resistance and instantaneous Potency J. These cause the 
brains of active creatures within 10 feet of the pod to fall in love with it and to protect it and the people sleeping on it, 
violently if necessary. Every action of protection is rewarded with huge pleasure sensations. The third and final wave of 
spores is released 10 minutes later. It is known as bliss, and is even more virulent: -40% Poison Resistance and instantaneous 
Potency J. Anyone effected becomes paralyzed and their brain goes into overdrive producing continuously altered pleasure 
hormones. This and the psychedelic effect kicks in as the victims also hallucinate things that are extremely pleasurable 
to them. This last effect causes 1 point of brain damage (1/10th Endurance area) per minute. When the brain reaches 0 
Endurance the victim begins making Vitality saves (-5% per damage point under 0 Endurance) every minute. Failure 
indicates complete brain failure and death. It takes three days for the plants to regrow any released spores. As the victim’s 
bodies decay, the soft spongy top slowly absorbs all organic 
material at 1/4 inch per day depending on the consistency of 
the organic material, with bone and horns taking ten times 
as long. Non-organic materials cause the spongy material to 
slowly part and they fall into the center of the drop, collecting 
in a large sack-like organ near the center and bottom of the 
Bluedrop Seapad. 
The plant cannot empty this sack which eventually fills killing 
the plant. Once full, the plant begins to die and turns gray. 
This can happen over the course of years or mere months 
depending on how much it feeds. When the plant dies, a final 
wave of spores are released from the pods. These are the seeds 
which spread outward into the ocean. If they find any organic 
material, they burrow in and release a virulent toxin: XX -20% 
Poison Resistance and instantaneous Potency J. The victim dies, 
and the new pod grows into its first stage of life depending on 
the size of the organism. If the organic material is less than 50 
lb., then there is not enough to form a proper Bluedrop Seapad,  and it fails to finish growing. Between 51 and 250 lb. of 
organic material is used up over the course of two months to allow an 8-20 foot Bluedrop Seapod to grow. 
Climate/Habitat: The Plane of Water and waters linked to this plane.

spawn once per year, otherwise the Plane of Water would be filled with them. After 1-2 years the Etri die.

Water Whyll, Stranglekelp (Supernatural, Magical Plant, Level 3)
This elemental water plant is found in large living mats of 10 to 100 individual plants. Each one is a dangerous plant that 
can feel any warmth or movement and will wrap around it, constrict it, and steal warmth from it. They feed on light but also 
the warmth and blood of living beings and creatures. Each plant has a lower nerve cluster, that connects with fibrous nerve 
vines to other Stranglekelp in the colony and hangs below the upper reaches at 18-20 feet. The nerve clusters are also the 
heaviest part of the colony and so weigh it down in the water. The Stranglekelp forest floats above the nerve mats and is what 
constricts and freezes victims of the colony. It will also pull them down to the waiting maws below. The ends of the vines 
have light-sensing organs akin to eyes and can also sense heat. 
Habits/Life Cycle: Stranglekelp lives for hundreds of years if it can find both light and food. If starved for more than a 
decade,  the nerve bundles that connect the colony to each other begin to wither. The colony then breaks apart and drifts 
away from each other. This gives them about another decade before the nerve cluster itself dies, and the plant dies with it. 
When a Stranglekelp dies, the nerve clusters break apart. Within it is also a dozen seed pods that will float on until they 
encounter another Stranglekelp colony that reflexively attempts to strangle the pods, but only breaks them open, adding new 
Stranglekelp shoots to the colony.

Water Wyrd, Throlln (Supernatural, Magical Animal, Level 8)
This elemental, transparent water creature hides within waves and more turbulent water where it takes a single perception 
check to see. It is a large, elongated, disk-shaped creature with a slight bulge in the middle. Throlln are known as engulfers 
because they surround their prey, constrict, suffocate, and then slowly absorb the remains. They are solitary and reproduce 
by budding when they have been well fed for 5-6 months. They breathe and absorb all they need through their skin. Many 
wrongly assume they are a kind of slime, but they have organs and a brain, although these are fairly transparent. Their blue 
coloration is often mistaken for seawater. Close inspection reveals their animal nature by visible blood flow. 
Habits/Life Cycle: The Throlln are solitary and reproduce by budding when they have been well fed for 5-6 months. The 
Throlln can live from 8-12 years.

Vorelli (Supernatural, Humanoid, Level 7)
A ray-like intelligent being with about a 5-foot wingspan. Their colorations are grays, greens, blues, and whites. They have 
two magical organs one in either wing that allow them to float in air and adjust buoyancy in water. They are at home in 
water or above it. They have two sets of eyes, one set on the upper head and one below. They also have an undermind in 
the lower parts of the head and an overmind in the roof of the head. They are linked with large nerve ganglia clusters. 
Their undermind is responsible for their physical bodies and their deepest emotions. The overmind is the personality and 
intelligence of the creature. Their ray wings end in small tentacles, less than two feet long that then split into three prehensile 
fingers that are about six inches long. They use these to manipulate objects. They have a small maw in the central underside 
of their body, and they eat by lowering themselves slowly onto food. They can ingest nearly any organic matter to sustain 
themselves. They also have strong magical and mental abilities. They often use magical items and pass these through 
families. Magical items are highly prized by the Vorelli. One in twenty has the ability to create magical sigils in the air as well 
as the gift for casting spells. These are often their leaders, although among some groups it is the priests who lead. They are 
known to be thinking beings because they wear packs across their backs to hold items. While the warriors wear the skins of 
other creatures. They are Neutral as a race and extremely xenophobic. They rarely leave their pods or family groups. When 
they do it is because of times of strife or to start a new community. 
Habits/Life Cycle: The Vorelli have two sexes. A female lays a clutch of eggs once every three years if she is bonded with 
one or more males. The clutch will be from 4-24 eggs. She guards these and only allows the males she selects to fertilize 
them. One month later, tiny Vorelli no bigger than a foot are born. These the males care for and raise over the course of nine 
years, until they reach adulthood. During the first three years of life the undermind is dominate and the offspring tend to be 
unpredictable and difficult to manage. They can live up to 36 years. The last 6 years are marked by the slow failure of their 
overmind and the remerging of the undermind. Sometimes they can be dangerous during this period and have to be driven 
from the pod, or killed, depending on pod custom.

Aura Level 1
PRODUCE SCENT
Type: (Eng, Cre) 	
	
Distance to Focus: 5 feet per Aura
Magic Name: Mi-Frint	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 5 minutes	
Failure: None
Casting Time: 5 seconds	
Range: 5 feet per Aura
Area Affected: 1 scent	
Duration: 10 minutes per Aura
Description: The caster imagines a particular scent, creates 
it, and then chooses either to attach that scent to a specific 
being, place or object, or lets it remain free floating. Beings 
and creatures with a Magic Resistance are afforded one if 
they desire to be free of this attachment. If the scent is free 
floating, it will be carried in the environment based on wind 
conditions and air flow. Wet environments are easier to 
detect scents in than dryer ones, etc. At 20 or higher Aura, 
more than one scent can be produced and those scents may 
be as complex as desired.
Notes: This spell cannot be used to remove a scent but may 
be used to overpower the existing scent with a stronger 
scent of something else. Winds over 20 miles per hour will 
disperse the scent quickly reducing duration by 1 minute 
per mile an hour of wind over 20. This is not an illusion; a 
real magical scent is produced for the duration. Those with 
smell have a +20% to sense the scent in question. 
Special Notes: When cast at 20 or higher Aura the scent is 
permanent unless dispersed by wind. 
PRODUCE TASTE
Type: (Eng, Cre) 	
	
Distance to Focus: 5 feet per Aura
Magic Name: Mi-Rorl	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 5 minutes	
Failure: None
Casting Time: 5 seconds	
Range: 5 feet per Aura
Area Affected: 1 taste		
Duration: 10 minutes per Aura
Description: The caster imagines a particular taste, 
produces the taste, and then it is attached to a specific 
being, place, or object. Beings and creatures with a Magic 
Resistance are afforded one if they desire to be free of this 
attachment. The taste is observed when any tasting organ is 
placed against the object or if the object is consumed. At 20 
or higher Aura, more than one taste can be produced and 
that taste may be as complex as desired. 
Notes: This spell cannot be used to remove a taste but may 
be used to overpower the existing taste with a stronger one. 
Immersion in liquid will remove the taste more quickly by 
washing it off. For every minute of immersion in a liquid, 
the taste’s magical duration will be reduced by 5 minutes. 
This is not an illusion; a real magical taste is produced for 
the duration.
Special Notes: When cast at 20 or higher Aura the 
taste effect is permanent (though still can be diluted to 
uselessness by liquid). 
WATER MESSAGE
Type: (Min, Nat, Tra)		
Distance to Focus: See below
Magic Name: Enlor Reypa	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 5 minutes	
Failure: None
Casting Time: 10 seconds	
Range: Same plane
Area Affected: 1 water source	
Duration: Instantaneous
Description: The spell caster selects a source of water (pond, 
stream, ocean, etc.), then submerges her hand and imagines 
an individual she has met or seen. She then concentrates and 
thinks of a message of up to 2 words per Aura point used in 
the spell.  When the individual she imagined passes within 
20 feet of that same water source, he will hear the message 
in his mind as if she spoke it aloud next to his ear.  No actual 
sound is emitted so this cannot be overheard.  There is a 
25% chance -1% per Intelligence point of the caster that the 
message will be garbled and 1d4+1 words will be lost.
Aura Level 2
ENDURE LIGHT
Type: (War) 	
	
Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name: Lalem Flas	
Save: N/A
Memorization: 10 minutes	
Failure: 2% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 seconds	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 being	
Duration: 1 hour per Aura
Description: Protects the being from the damaging or 
debilitating effects of light. Specifically, this protects from 
skills, spells, invocations, powers, and effects which cause a 
being to be blinded, confused, stunned, or damaged by light. 
E.g., Brilliance is a spell which when cast can blind all who 
see it in the area of effect; Endure Light protects completely 
against this. This spell protects only against magical and 
divine effects; the effects of natural light (sunburn, Dark 
Elven sensitivity, etc.) are unaffected. Similarly, effects that 
function as natural light (True Day, etc.) are unaffected 
by this spell. Positive effects such as being able to see in a 
darkened area are preserved. Thus, the individual could 
carry a light which would be blinding to others but allow 
them to see in darkened places. Damage from laser light is 
not fully removed but is reduced by 1 point per die.

repeating, or a pattern; in all cases it must have a single pitch

PRODUCE TEXTURE
Type: (Eng, Cre) 	
	
Distance to Focus: 5 feet per Aura
Magic Name: Mi-Reftay	
Save: None
Memorization: 10 minutes	
Failure: 2% per Aura
Casting Time: 5 seconds	
Range: 5 feet per Aura
Area Affected: 1 texture	
Duration: 10 minutes per Aura
Description: The caster imagines a particular texture, 
creates it, and chooses an object or surface to which it will 
attach, covering any existing texture. The overall size of 
the texture can be up to 1 square foot per Aura used in the 
spell. The texture depth varies as desired within a range of 
a barely noticeable film to up to 1 inch deep. The texture 
can be anywhere from as smooth as glass to rough enough 
to provide a grip. The texture adds no additional damage, 
weight, or armor value to the object. All attacks and effects, 
both physical and mystical, pass completely through in both 
directions without damaging the texture.  E.g., if a surface 
is covered in a contact poison and a texture is applied to 
that surface, the being touching that surface will contact the 
poison despite the texture’s presence.  Likewise, if a surface 
is electrified and a texture is applied to it, contacting that 
surface will impart the effects of the electricity to the person 
touching it. 
Notes: This is not an illusion; a real magical texture is 
produced for the duration. The texture can be removed with 
sufficient force and is considered adhered at 20 pounds per 
2 Aura used in the spell. The texture can reduce or enhance 
climbing from -50% to +50% depending on the texture, at 
the GM’s discretion. A suitable texture applied to a weapon’s 
grip reduces the chance of being disarmed by 2% per Aura 
used in the spell. 
Special Notes: When cast at 20 or higher Aura the texture 
effect is permanent. In any case, if the object covered by the 
texture is broken, the spell ends.

DEPILATE

Magic Name: Areia	
	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 25 minutes	
Failure: 5% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 seconds

Description: The caster focuses on a being or animal that

Type: (Alt, Tra)

Magic Name:  Mi-ravna Aria 	
Save: None
Memorization: 25 minutes	
Failure: 5% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 minutes	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 object	
Duration: 1 hour per Aura
Description: The caster focuses and envelopes an object in

The magical plus of the item is +1 per 5 Aura used in the

isn’t changed. For instance, the spell does not increase the

Physical immunities, but it does not gain the true properties 
of a magical weapon (lower weight, lower speed, double 
armor protection, etc.).

per plus of the item to make it permanently magical, also 
changing its essence to that of a magical item. Thus, armor 
would then gain additional armor strength and durability, 
and melee weapons would gain additional modifiers to 
weight and speed.

PHASE ADHERE
Type: (Dim, Meta) 	
	
Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name: Kelay Grelip	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 30 minutes	
Failure: 5% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 seconds	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 object	
Duration: 30 seconds per Aura
Description: Allows the spellcaster to touch a single object 
and cause it to adhere to the next phased being or object it 
touches. The object will be adhered at 20 pounds per 2 Aura 
points used in casting the spell. This means that for every 
2 Aura points used, 20 pounds of pressure must be applied 
to pull the object free from whatever it has been adhered 
to. Otherwise, it remains stuck. A character may exert up 
to his load limit to pull himself or the adhered object free. 
A successful Force skill roll will also work. This spell allows 
a phased being to carry an unphased object. The target of 
the spell cannot be an object on the Phase Plane unless the 
caster is on the Phase Plane. 
Notes: If the adhered object touches flesh, the being gets a 
Magic Resistance to avoid the object sticking. If it sticks, the 
outer layer of skin will drop off 8-12 hours later, freeing the 
adhered creature. Characters attempting to pull free may do 
so if they possess enough strength, but will take 2d6 damage 
to adhered areas.
Special Usage: Allows a phased caster to adhere a phased-
object to unphased-object or being. While phased an 
unphased-object cannot be the target of this spell.

Type: (Eng, Cre, Dis)

Notes: The walls must be rooted onto a surface and cannot 
be cast in the air. If the wall cannot fit into the desired 
casting area, or if there is a living being in this area, then

amount it can absorb. Thus, if Absorb Dissonance is cast on

can be absorbed. If she is hit by 25 points of dissonance 20 is 
absorbed, 5 goes over as sonic damage and 10 sonic is stored 
within the caster’s aura field until the next contact with an 
object or being. If she is struck again for 25 points with 10 
points of sonic energy currently stored, only 10 of the 25 
is absorbed, 15 does damage to her as dissonance and the 
amount stored stays unchanged at 10 sonic energy. 
The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the 

===== PAGE 403 =====
397
next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or 
object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus 
if 20 sonic energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 sonic 
damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object 
struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra 
damage caused by the dissonance. The amount of energy 
to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The 
amount used is under the control of the being effected by 
the spell.
Notes: When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated 
and radiates harmlessly from the caster.

•	 Enhanced Resistances (Magic and Control Resistance are now

•	 Message 3 x day
•	 Telepathy (with caster) 
•	 Summon (minor supernatural of the same type) once per day.

•	 2 points of Endurance is gained per level of the familiar.
•	 1 sense is enhanced per 5 Aura used in the spell as if effected by

•	 1 natural or supernatural power, ability or immunity of the

spell.
Notes: A caster can never have more than one familiar at

Will Force permanently. The caster must make a Vitality

the familiar. The caster also makes a Vitality save to avoid a 
heart attack as defined in the Player’s Guide.

familiar. If the Familiar dies, the caster must make a Vitality 
save or lose 1d4+2 Endurance permanently, though they do 
not lose any Will Force as they would with Call Supernatural 
Familiar. The caster also makes a Vitality save to avoid a 
heart attack as defined in the Player’s Guide.
SHADOW WEAPON
Type: (Alt, Dim, Meta, Nat, Tra)	 Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name: Lilth Menmalla	
Save: N/A
Memorization: 45 Minutes	
Failure: 5% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Seconds	
Range: Shadow Plane
Area Affected: 1 Weapon	
Duration: 10 Sec. per Aura
Description: Causes one weapon to be projected into the 
Shadow Dimension. All creatures/beings that are shadow 
shifted can be struck for the weapon’s normal damage. If the

WATER MIND TOUCH
Type: (Nat, Min, Sen)		
Distance to Focus: See below
Magic Name: Enlor Reftay Skrun	 Save: N/A
Memorization: 45 Minutes	
Failure: 5% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Seconds	
Range: 100 miles per Aura
Area Affected: 1 water source	
Duration: 10 Sec. per Aura
Description: The spell caster selects a source of water 
(pond, stream, ocean, etc.), then submerges her hand and 
thinks of an individual she has met or seen.  She then 
concentrates and extends her mind outward, searching for 
that individual.  If that individual is within 10 feet per Aura 
point used in the spell of that water source, she is able to 
make mental contact with the being and converse mentally 
as long as the being stays within range of that water.
Notes: Persons, places, or things that are protected by Mind 
Set, Mind Change, Non-Detection or Glamour cannot be 
contacted.

ABSORB COLD
Type: (War, Eng, Tra)  	
Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name: Ultha Carmor	
Save: N/A
Memorization: 50 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Seconds	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 Being	
Duration: 10 Sec. per Aura
Description: The spell allows the effected being to absorb 
up to 2 points of cold or frost energy damage per Aura point 
used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and 
half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits 
is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type 
as applied by the effect that generated the energy damage. 
Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/
being thereafter will only absorb the difference between 
the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. 
Thus, if Absorb Cold is cast on the caster herself at 10 Aura 
up to 20 points of frost damage can be absorbed. If she is 
hit by 25 points of cold 20 is absorbed, 5 goes over as frost 
damage and 10 frost is stored within the caster’s aura field 
until the next contact with an object or being. If she is struck 
again for 25 points with 10 points of frost energy currently 
stored, only 10 of the 25 is absorbed, 15 does damage to her 
as cold and the amount stored stays unchanged at 10 frost 
energy. 
The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the 
next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent 
or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. 
Thus if 20 frost energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 cold 
damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object 
struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra 
damage caused by the frost. The amount of energy to use in 
each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used 
is under the control of the being effected by the spell.
Notes: When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated 
and radiates harmlessly from the caster.
CHANGE GENDER
Type: (Alt, Lif, Nat)	
	
Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name: Ki-Haresha	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 50 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 1 Minute	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 being/animal	
Duration: 1 Hour per Aura
Description: Causes one humanoid, magical humanoid, 
animal or magical animal to change sex for the duration 
of the spell. If the target is male they take on female 
characteristics and vice versa. This includes any gender 
dimorphism.  For most humanoids this is a means females 
lose 1 Strength but gain 1 Agility. Thus, becoming male will 
give a female +1 Strength and -1 Agility. Becoming female 
will grant +1 Agility and -1 Strength. 
Notes:  Fertility is affected as follows, if fertilization occurs 
in a male changed into a female that fertilization and any in 
process gestation vanish at the end of the duration of this 
spell. 
DISRUPT COORDINATION
Type: (Alt, Min, Nat)	 	
Distance to Focus: 2 feet per Aura
Magic Name: Detay-Plintam-Invise	Save: Control Resistance
Memorization: 50 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Seconds	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 being	
Duration: 10 Sec per Aura
Description: This spell creates a magical mental block 
between a being and his or her Proprioception (sense of 
their body belonging to them). This has a profound impact 
on how they direct their limbs and movement. If the target 

===== PAGE 406 =====
400
fails a Control Resistance, then the following effects are 
applied. 
•	 Movement is reduced to walking or jogging, the being cannot 
run or use other faster forms of physical movement. This 
includes flying if having non-magical wings. Although gliding 
can be achieved by making an Intelligence Save once per 10 
seconds in tense (combat) situations or once per minute in 
normal ones. 
•	 Initiative modifier is now +4
•	 Agility saves are reduced by 50%
•	 Damage produced by weapons or physically striking an 
opponent is reduced by 1 point per die rolled. Overall damage 
modifier is reduced by 4, even if this produces a negative 
modifier. Negative damage is treated as zero damage. 
•	 All skills that use either Strength or Agility are reduced by 20% 
for the duration. 
Special Notes: This affected being can add an additional 2 
seconds to any action to remove one of the above penalties 
if they make an Intelligence save to overcome this impaired 
sense. Thus, to forego the initiative penalty, the first two 
seconds of a combat round must be spent getting control 
of the body, then an Intelligence save must be made or the 
affected being loses the two seconds spent and still suffers 
the penalty. Likewise taking an extra two seconds to swing 
a weapon and making an Intelligence save will remove all 
penalties related to striking with the weapon (both the 
damage reduction penalty and the skill modifier if a skill 
was being used with this weapon strike). In some cases, 
there is no opportunity to add seconds, such as when an 
Agility save occurs to avoid falling in a pit. Under those 
circumstances an Intelligence Save can be made to reduce 
the penalty by half (Agility save modifier becomes -25%.) 
EARTHBOUND
Type: (Alt, Tra, Nat)	 	
Distance to Focus: See below
Magic Name: Gar Fretay	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 50 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Seconds	
Range: 10 feet per Aura
Area Affected: See below	
Duration: 1 Hour per Aura
Description: This spell allows the caster to target one 
distinct area (up to 100 cubic feet per aura), object (up to 20 
lb. per Aura), or being (up to 25 lb. per Aura.)  That being, 
place or object gets a Magic Resistance. If the resistance is 
made by half, then no effect occurs. If the resistance is made 
but by more than half then all magical movement effects 
(flight, propel, levitate, etc.) are converted into float which 
will last until the being touches a surface considered ground 
or floor or up to 1 hour per Aura. If the Magic Resistance 
fails, then all magical movement effects are immediately 
canceled and they fall if in the air. Beings, creatures and 
objects that fail or make resistance by less than half and 
touch the ground after floating find that they cannot have 
any magical air movement effects cast upon them for the 
duration of the spell. Nor can they leave the surface of the 
ground/floor even by natural means other than to fall to a 
lower floor/or ground. 
EAVESDROP
Type: (Ill, Min, Sen, Tra)	
Distance to Focus: See below
Magic Name: Raypa-Semph	
Save: See below
Memorization: 50 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Minutes	
Range: 25 Miles per Aura
Area Affected: See below	
Duration: 1 Minute per Aura
Description: This spell allows the caster to listen in on 
one person, place or thing named allowed by the caster as 
if their sense of hearing was within hearing of the person, 
place or thing. The maximum distance equals 25 miles per 
Aura point. However, if the spell is cast at higher than 15 
Aura, there is no limit to the distance. If the spell is cast at 
20 Aura, it will have a 3% chance per Will Force point of the 
caster extending the eavesdrop spell into other dimensions. 
If that which is eavesdropped upon is protected by any of 
the following, they will not be able to be detected: Non-
Detection, Sphere of Protection (Wall of Protection if 
between eavesdroppee & eavesdropper), Mind Set, Mind 
Change, Silence, or the skill Thought Projection block this 
effect. Beings with Life Sense or Sense Projection are given 
an Intelligence save to feel the eavesdrop.
Notes: Beings who are around the caster will hear nothing 
as the caster eavesdrops, unless they can make an Illusion 
Resistance, in which case they hear fainter sounds of what 
the caster hears. 
Special Usage: When used with an existing Scrying spell 
or skill, the casting time becomes 1 second and the need to 
name the person, place or thing is no longer required. The 
eavesdrop spells duration will end if the Scrying skill or spell 
does first. Otherwise, duration is as normal.

Distance to Focus:  2 feet per Aura

experience dramatically improved physical coordination due 
to an improved spatial awareness. This augmentation affords 
the target being the following bonuses:

•	 Skills that require physical action receive a +20% bonus and 
cannot be critically failed. Treat critical failures as simple 
failures. Repeat failures, however, can still produce a critical 
failure if applicable; see the rule for the skill in question. The 
GM’s discretion is absolute in determining whether or not this 
benefit applies to a given skill.

FULCRUM
Type: (Alt, Nat, Tra)	 	
Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name: Forsolm Menmalla	
Save: N/A
Memorization: 50 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 1 Minute	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 Weapon	
Duration: 10 Min. per Aura
Description: Causes a magical adjustment of weight within 
the weapon as it is swung. So that it is both easier to swing 
and weight distributes to the end of the weapon as it reaches 
the apex of its swing or thrust. This spell only works on 
melee weapons and cannot be cast on missile weapons. The 
effects are as follows: weapon speed and minimum weapon 
speed are reduced by 1, +1 additional die of damage is 
added to die type the weapon uses. Small weapons are not 
large enough to have the fulcrum effect operate on them 
to any effect. Thus, any weapon which has an unadjusted 
minimum weapon speed of less than 3 seconds cannot be 
the spell target. 
KINETIC BARRIER
Type: (Cre, Dis, Nat)	 	
Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name: Mali Yan-Lar	
Save: N/A
Memorization: 50 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 1 Minute	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 Being	
Duration: 30 Min. per Aura
Description: This spell has two forms of casting. The first is 
under-armor. It allows the wearing of rigid and semi-flexible 
armor in places that would normally require padding to 
reduce chafing and allow armor to move properly with the 
body without pinching or inhibiting normal movement. 
The under-armor target also allows furry or scaled beings 
to wear armor that might pinch, catch or otherwise chafe 
without this occurring. The second form of casting is 
outside the armor. When cast outside armor it acts as a 
reduction of the incoming damage by 1 point per 5 Aura, 
reducing both the damage done to the being protected by 
the armor and any damage points that would be applied 
to the armor itself by the same amount. Specifically, if a 
22-point blow is done the being who has this spell affecting 
them at 10 Aura (2 points of kinetic protection) and is 
wearing plate where they were struck. The effect would be 
only 20 physical damage would be applied to determine 
what damage the being wearing the armor would take (22-
2=20) and the normal 1 damage point to plate for a blow of 
22 points instead does 0 damage (1-2=-1 or 0). 
Notes: The first form of this spell reduces rigid armor 
penalties by 1 level. So, a +2 initiative penalty would become 
+1, a -10% to Skills would become a -5%, etc. Both under 
armor and over armor targets of this spell cannot be cast 
on the same being at once. This spell does not count toward 
stacking armor rules. It also can be combined with Force 
Armor or Spiritual Armor (or both.)
STASIS SHIELD
Type: (Dim, Alt)	
	
Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name: Mali Messonada	
Save: N/A
Memorization: 50 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 30 Seconds	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 Being	
Duration: 10 Min. per Aura
Description: This spell surrounds a being’s Aura creating 
a nearly invisible stasis shield. When a fast, physical attack 
(melee or missile, under 5 seconds unadjusted) strikes 
the being’s Aura, The shield reacts, showing a translucent 
crystalline effect during the second it is struck, at the 
place of impact, removing 1 point of physical damage per 
Aura point used in the spell. The remainder of damage 
passes through. This works against normal and magical 
physical attacks but has no effect on energy attacks (save 
for Repulsion energy which is removed completely). Thus, 
spells like Repulsion or Finger of Repulsion have no effect 
on the protected being while the shield is in effect. 
Special Notes: Any weapon that has an unadjusted attack 
speed of 5 seconds or more strikes as normal, doing 
standard damage. Those under this speed can be increased 
to a 5 second (or more) attack times. For all attacks this 
reduces the damage by 1 dice for each second it is increased 
over the normal, unadjusted attack speed. Thus a 3 second 
attack from a weapon speed which has an unadjusted attack 
speed of 4 seconds and does 4d6 weapon loses 1d6 when 
slowed to 5 seconds to avoid the shield. This represents a 
loss in kinetic force necessary to bypass the shield. Effects 
which add time to the weapon speed such as Critical or 
Focused attack do not affect the unadjusted weapon speed 
and thus are affected by the shield,

is taken or not an Agility save must be made at -20% if the

DUPLICATE MIND
Type: (Alt, Men, Sen, Tra)  	
Distance to Focus: Sight
Magic Name: Ki-Skrun Rimppelion	Save: N/A
Memorization: 60 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 1 Minute	
Range: Sight
Area Affected: Target/Focus	
Duration: 1 Hour per Aura
Description: The spell causes a temporary and deep mind 
reading of a primary target during the casting. When 
complete, a near complete mental copy of the target’s mind 
is duplicated and placed on the caster or a focus target. 
Whenever mental contact is made with the secondary target 
of this spell, they sense the duplicated mind and not the 
secondary target’s actual mind. If the target engages or is 
engaged in mental combat with another being then the spell 
immediately fails. The secondary target is allowed a double 
perception check to get thoughts, emotions and details from 
the mental copy that the target was thinking and feeling at 
the time of the original spell casting.
Notes: Spells, magical mental effects and the ability to use or 
even understand magical or divine skills is not transferred to 
the copy. This is not an illusion as the mimic mind spell and 
cannot be seen through with an Illusion Resistance.

DAMPEN
Type: (Meta)  	
	
Distance to Focus: 1’ /Aura
Magic Name: Milfab Entermola	 Save: N/A
Memorization: 65 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 20 Seconds	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 Spell/Item	
Duration: 1 Hour per Aura
Description: This spell reduces the original amount of Aura 
directed into an active spell (or power in a magic item). 
Spells will
lose 1 additional Aura point in power for every 2 Aura 
points used in the Dampen spell. Magic item powers will 
lose 1 additional Aura point per 4 Aura points used in the 
Dampen spell, temporarily. Thus, if a spell was originally 
cast at 10 Aura and Dampen was cast at 10 Aura, the spell 
would be treated as though 5 Aura had been put into it. The 
number of Aura points subtracted by Dampen cannot be 
more than the original number put into the spell. 
Special Usage: This spell can be cast on a being with no 
effects. The next spell that would affect them is then reduced 
by the Dampen.

STORM OF REPULSION
Type: (Cre, Dis, Eng)	 	
Distance to Focus: 3 feet per Aura
Magic Name: Yan-Lar Mengalla	 Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 65 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Seconds	
Range: See below
Area Affected: 2’ Rad./Aura	
Duration: 5 Seconds per Aura
Description: Creates a buffeting of bolts of force at a fixed 
height of 10 feet and radius as noted above, that causes all 
within its radius to be affected as follows:
•	 Make a Magic Resistance or take 1d4+1 damage per 4 Aura 
points per 10 seconds to 2d4 exposed areas (any body area 
protected by less than five points of armor is considered 
exposed).
•	 Make a Magic Resistance or be deafened.
•	 Make an Agility save every 10 seconds. A failure indicates the 
being has lost his footing and has fallen to the ground.
•	 Make a Strength save to combat normally. Any unsuccessful 
save results in a penalty of -4 to hit and half damage to attacks, 
and -20% to all combat skills.
•	 Missile weapons fired within a storm of repulsion always miss 
their target.
•	 Missile weapons fired into the storm have an equal chance of 
striking any being within the area of effect.
Notes: This spell must be concentrated upon to keep it 
maintained. The caster can move the storm with him at 
walking speed. Effects 1 and 2 are dependent on one Magic 
Resistance only. Beings immune to repulsion or magical 
kinetic effects are unaffected by this.
WALL OF REPULSION
Type: (Cre, Dis, Eng)	 	
Distance to Focus: 3 feet per Aura
Magic Name: Yan-Lar Fes	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 30 Minutes	
Failure: 10% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Seconds	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 Wall / 2 Aura	
Duration: 10 Min. per Aura
Description: Each wall created by this spell is 10’ high, 
10’ wide and 6” thick of shimmering air. The walls may be 
produced anywhere there is room for them, but each wall 
must touch another. Touching the wall with exposed flesh 
does 1d4+1 per 2 Aura points and requires an Agility save 
at -20% to avoid being thrown back 1 foot per Aura from 
the wall. If this fails a second Agility save is required to 
avoid being knocked prone. Trying to enter the field takes 
a Strength save at -20% and even then, if a being becomes 
immersed in the field, it will take the above listed damage 
to 2d4 random areas and suffer the Agility save effects from 
touching the wall (Save at -20% or knock back and then save 
to avoid being knocked prone). The being affected is allowed 
a Magic Resistance. If he makes the roll by less than or equal 
to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was 
made, but was greater than 1/2 the chance, then half damage 
is taken. Failure indicates full damage. Magical armor 
will absorb the repulsion damage if a successful Magic 
Resistance is rolled for the armor.
Notes: The walls must be rooted onto a surface and cannot 
be cast in the air. If the wall cannot fit into the desired 
casting area, or if there is a living being in this area, then 
that particular section of the wall will fail.

SIMULACRUM
Type: (Ill, Meta)	
	
Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name:  Yemix Ravna	
Save: N/A
Memorization: 70 Minutes

Casting Time: 1 Minute

Area Affected: 1+ Illusions	
Duration: 1 Hour per Aura
Description: This spell by itself creates an Illusion of 
Sight as the spell Illusion of Sight but without the required 
concentration to control. The illusion will appear to perform 
a set of planned actions or movements (within the range) 
and then will reset and perform them again. The total 
amount of time available for the planned actions is 1 minute 
per Aura used in the spell after which the simulacrum can 
repeat its programmed actions immediately, or reappear 
after a specific delay which can be 1 second later or up to 
10 minutes later per Aura used in the spell, or vanish never 
to reappear (spells duration then ends). Other illusions 
spells; feeling, sound, smell, taste, and sensing can be 
added to the Simulacrum by casting of those spells into the 
existing Simulacrum. As always, a requested and successful 
Illusion Resistance or other effects that see through illusions 
will reveal the illusionary nature of the simulacrum. The 
simulacrum can cause illusionary damage as appropriate 
(see Player’s Guide).
Special Uses: The Set spell, when cast on this spell, allows a 
specific action or actions to trigger the simulacrum. Once 
triggered the set spell does not expire on the Simulacrum 
until the Simulacrum spell itself ends. This allows for an 
action to trigger the simulacrum multiple times within the 
Simulacrum spell’s duration. Permanency can be cast on an 
existing simulacrum or a set enhanced simulacrum at a cost 
of 1/4 Will Force.

ILLUSION OF MEMORY
Type: (Min, Ill)  	
	
Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name: Ravna Skrun	
Save: See below
Memorization: 90 Minutes	
Failure: 20% per Aura
Casting Time: Varies	 	
Range: Sight
Area Affected: 1 being’s mind.	
Duration: instantaneous
Description: This spell has two castings. 
False memory: Casting time 10 seconds, initial Control 
Resistance, followed by Illusion Resistance if requested. 
The first casting type is to plant a false memory. This can be 
elaborate or simple but the caster has to have a clear idea of 
the memory before casting. The casting takes 30 seconds. 
The effected being is then afforded a Control Resistance and 
if this fails the illusionary memory is instantly implanted. 
If it is them doing something Good if Evil or being friends 
with someone they would not be friends with, then all 
resistances are made at +20%. Beings immune to magic, 
control or illusions are unaffected by this form of casting. 
Illusionary experience: Casting time up to 1 hour per Aura. 
10 seconds, initial Magic Resistance, followed by Illusion 
Resistance if requested. 
The first casting type is to offer an illusionary experience. 
The experience can be something the caster actually 
experienced or something they vividly imagine, requiring an 
Intelligence save every hour of the casting or the experience 
ends at that point. The experience is then stored by the 
caster for up to one day per Aura, until they choose a target 
or targets to instantly give illusionary experience to. In that 
split second when the caster releases the experience, the 
receiver can choose to make a Magic Resistance or let it 
happen. Those that fail the Magic Resistance or opt to allow 
it to happen, experience the entire illusionary experience 
even if it is hours long in that split second. For them no time 
has passed. An observer might notice a momentary look 
of concentration or wonder but otherwise the targets have 
no ill effects other than the illusionary experience. During 
the experience they can also make an Illusion Resistance to 
break the effect. Some experiences can be mind-warping 
enough to cause Will Force saves to avoid insanity at the 
discretion of the GM. These experiences cause the being 
to sense that they will possibly be negatively affected at 
the time of the Magic Resistance, thus allowing them to 
choose to take the Magic Resistance as they might be 
mentally harmed. Beings immune to magic, or illusions are 
unaffected by this form of casting.
Notes:  Neither casting will not work if the target being’s 
mind is protected by effects such as Mind Set, Non-
detection, etc. 
INTERCONNECTED
Type: (Min, Nat, Sen)

Each member maintains their individual self-identity. 
Each being interconnected knows the health, distance and 
direction of every other being in the interconnection simply 
by concentrating on any one of them. Also, each being can 
concentrate make an Intelligence save and mentally contact 
another being who is interconnected. As well as hearing 
and projecting thoughts she can close a sense and take in 
the sense of another interconnected being, seeing, hearing, 
smelling, tasting, feeling, etc. what the interconnected being 
does. In addition, any member of the interconnected circle 
can invite another being within sight into the circle up to 
the maximum of 1 total interconnected being per Aura 
used in the original spell. Interconnected beings can also 
block all connections for up to 1 minute per Will Force 
point. Each minute after this they must make a Will Force 
save and subtract -5% to the chance for each minute longer 
than their Will Force. Alternately, they can simply leave the 
interconnection and get another interconnected to reunite 
them at a later time. 
Notes: beings that are magically protected by Mind Change, 
Mind Set, or Non-detection cannot be interconnected.
Special Usage: Other interconnected casters cannot recast 
this spell to add more members. However Combined
