SPARK SPLASH
Type: (Eng, Cre, Dis)	 	
Distance to Focus: Emanates
Magic Name:  Statar Elanch	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 90 Minutes	
Failure: 20% per Aura
Casting Time: 5 Seconds	
Range: 3 feet per Aura
Area Affected: Area Struck	
Duration: Instantaneous
Description: Creates a glob of magical, electrified acid that 
flies at an opponent. If the caster makes an intelligence save 
the spark splash strikes a single area on the target. The target 
then makes 2 Magic Resistances. The first is for the acid, 
the second for electricity. The Magic Resistance roll is made 
first for acid, and if the target makes this roll by under their 
half resistance chance, then no damage was taken. If the roll 
is made but by more than half then half damage is taken. If 
any acid damage is taken then the target rolls another Magic 
Resistance for the electrical damage. If the roll is made by 
half or under then no electrical damage is taken, if the roll 
is made but by more than half then half electrical damage 
is taken. If the resistance fails then full electrical damage is 
taken. If any electrical damage that does physical damage 
to the target after taking physical acid damage is doubled 
because of the sensitive acid burned skin. Base damage for 
acid is 1d10+1 per 2 Aura and Electricity is 1d8+1 per 2 
Aura. 
Examples: 
1)	 Caster casts Spark Splash at 18 Aura, makes an Intelligence save 
and strikes the target in the chest. The victim fails the first Magic 
Resistance and takes 9d10+9 magical acid damage (the caster 
rolls 56 damage.) The being has 44 armor in the chest and so the 
armor in the chest is destroyed and 12 gets through to damage the 
victim. The victim makes the second Magic Resistance by half and 
takes no additional damage from the electricity. 
2)	 Caster casts Spark Splash at 20 Aura, makes an Intelligence 
save and strikes the target in the head. The victim makes the first 
Magic Resistance under the half chance. No damage is taken from 
either the magic acid or the electricity. 
3)	 Caster casts Spark Splash at 19 Aura, makes Intelligence save 
and strikes the target in the sword arm. The victim makes the 
first Magic Resistance by just over half the resistance chance and 
so takes half damage. 9d10+9 is rolled and 52 damage is rolled, 
26 damage is done to the sword arm. The target has 29 points of 
arm armor. 26 of the armor is burned away by the magical acid 
with 3 armor points left (29-26=3). Then the victim makes a 
Magic Resistance against the magical electricity and fails. 9d8+9 
damage is done and 43 is rolled. The remaining 3 points of armor 
(which happens to be padding) is destroyed and the other 40 
passes through. The victim takes 40 to the arm. The victim had 22 
endurance and this is at 22 – 40 or -18. The victim only had a 17 
Vitality and cannot go to -18 in the arm. The arm is blown off by 
the electrical bolt. 
4)	 Caster casts Spark Splash at 20 Aura, makes Intelligence 
save and strikes target in the chest. The victim fails the Magic 
Resistance and so takes full damage. 10d10+10 is done and 64 
damage is rolled. This being is heavily armored with magical 
armor but the magical armor fails its own magical resistance. 
The armor protected 50 points in the chest. It is destroyed and 14 
passes through the victim. The victim makes the second Magic 
Resistance by more than half chance and thus takes half damage. 
But because the victim has taken physical damage from the acid 
the electrical damage is doubled. Double half = full damage. 
10d8+10 is rolled 48 is rolled and done as damage. The victim 
only had 30 Endurance and a 17 Vitality, 30 -48=-18. This -18 is 
over the victim’s 17 Vitality and so the victim is killed outright. 
5)	 Caster casts Spark Splash at 20 Aura, makes Intelligence 
save and strikes target in the chest. The victim fails the Magic 
Resistance and so takes full damage. 10d10+10 is done and 62 
damage is rolled. This being is heavily armored with magical 
armor and the magic armor makes its Magic Resistance and no 
damage is taken because the armor stopped the effect. No second 
resistance roll is required by either the victim or the victim’s 
armor. 
Notes: Magical items are allowed a single Magic Resistance 
to avoid both the effects of this spell.
AURA LEVEL 20
FINGER OF CHAOS
Type: (Cre, Dis, Eng)	 	
Distance to Focus: Emanates
Magic Name: Flanta Aria	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 2 Hours	
Failure: 20% per Aura
Casting Time: 5 Seconds	
Range: None
Area Affected: Area struck	
Duration: Instantaneous
Description: Causes a bolt of pure Aura to shoot from the 
caster’s finger and strike a target if an Intelligence save is 
successful. The Finger of Chaos does 1d12 damage per 2 
Aura points used in the spell to the area stuck. The being 
struck is allowed a Magic Resistance. If he makes the 
roll by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is 
taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than a 
1/2 save, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full 
damage. Magical armor will absorb the Finger of Chaos if a 
successful Magic Resistance is rolled for the armor.
Notes: Beings immune to chaos/pure aura effects are 
unaffected by this spell.
ABSORB CHAOS
Type: (Eng, Tra, War)  	
Distance to Focus: Touch
Magic Name: Ultha Aria	
Save: N/A
Memorization: 2 Hours	
Failure: 20% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Seconds	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 Being	
Duration: 10 Sec. per Aura
Description: The spell allows the effected being to absorb 
up to 2 points of pure Aura energy damage per Aura point 
used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and 
half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits 
is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type 

===== PAGE 417 =====
411
as applied by the effect that generated the energy damage. 
Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/
being thereafter will only absorb the difference between 
the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. 
Thus, if Absorb Chaos is cast on the caster herself at 10 Aura 
up to 20 points of Aura damage can be absorbed. If she is 
hit by 25 points of Aura 20 is absorbed, 5 goes over as Aura 
damage and 10 Aura energy is stored within the caster’s 
Aura field until the next contact with an object or being. 
If she is struck again for 25 points with 10 points of Aura 
energy currently stored, only 10 of the 25 is absorbed, 15 
does damage to her as Aura damage and the amount stored 
stays unchanged at 10 Aura energy. 
The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the 
next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or 
object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus 
if 20 Aura energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 Aura 
damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object 
struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra 
damage caused by the Aura energy. The amount of energy 
to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The 
amount used is under the control of the being effected by 
the spell.
Notes: When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated 
and radiates harmlessly from the caster.
AURA OF DETERIORATION
Type: (Cre, Dis, Dth, Eng, Meta, Tra)	 Distance to Focus: Self
Magic Name:  Teldar Aria	
Save: N/A
Memorization: 2 Hours	
Failure: 20% per Aura 
Casting Time: 1 Minute	
Range: None
Area Affected: Caster’s body	
Duration: 1 Hour per Aura
Description: Causes the caster’s Aura to become charged 
with a withering force that harms all things it comes into 
contact with. In this form the caster is immune to effects of 
withering, magical aging or deterioration as the spell Endure 
Deterioration. Anything entering the caster’s Aura while 
this spell is in effect is affected as shown below if a Magic 
Resistance is failed. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 
point per 3 Aura.
Target
Effect if Magic Resistance Fails
Plant
Instant death to small plants, medium plants wilt 
and large plants lose foliage. Magical plants take 1d4 
per 2 Aura points.
Animal
Kills small rodents and mammals under 10 
endurance. All others take 1d4 points per 2 Aura 
points. Magical animals lose 1d4 years per 2 Aura. 
Elf
Ages 10-60 years per 4 Aura points.
Dwarf
Ages 2-12 years per 4 Aura points.
Avian
Ages 1-10 years per 4 Aura points.
Midfolk
Ages 1-8 years per 4 Aura points.
Human
Ages 1-6 years per 4 Aura points.
Wild one/Goblin 
Ages 1-4 years per 4 Aura points.
Stone/Crystal
Removes 1 point from object strength per Aura 
point.
Metal
Removes 1-4 points from object strength per 4 Aura 
points.
Wood
Removes 1-6 points from object strength per 4 Aura 
points.
Leather
Removes 1-10 points from object strength per 4 
Aura points.
Special Notes: This spell applies force in only one direction 
away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass 
outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot 
be used with the spell Force Armor.

STORM OF CHAOS
Type: (Cre, Dis, Eng)	 	
Distance to Focus: 3 feet per Aura
Magic Name: Aria Mengalla	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 125 Minutes	
Failure: 30% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Seconds	
Range: See below
Area Affected: 2’ Rad./Aura	
Duration: 5 Seconds per Aura
Description: Creates a buffeting a miasma chromatic pure 
Aura fire at a fixed height of 10 feet and radius as noted 
above, that causes all within its radius to be affected as 
follows:
•	 Make a Magic Resistance or take 1d12 damage per 4 Aura 
points per 10 seconds to 2d4 exposed areas (any body area 
protected by less than five points of armor is considered 
exposed.)
•	 Make a Magic Resistance once per 10 seconds or be blinded 
and deafened by the chaotic lights and roar. 
•	 Make an Agility save every 10 seconds. A failure indicates the 
being has lost his footing and has fallen to the ground.
•	 Make a Strength save to combat normally. Any unsuccessful 
save results in a penalty of -4 to hit and half damage to attacks, 
and -20% to all combat skills.
•	 Missile weapons fired within a Storm of Chaos always miss 
their target.
•	 Missile weapons fired into the storm have an equal chance of 
striking any being within the area of effect.
Notes: This spell must be concentrated upon to keep it 
maintained. The caster can move the storm with him at 
walking speed. Effects 1 and 2 are dependent on one Magic 
Resistance only. Beings immune to Aura energy effects are 
unaffected by this spell.
WALL OF CHAOS
Type: (Cre, Dis, Eng)	 	
Distance to Focus: 3 feet per Aura
Magic Name: Aria Fes	
Save: Magic Resistance
Memorization: 125 Minutes	
Failure: 30% per Aura
Casting Time: 10 Seconds	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 Wall / 2 Aura	
Duration: 10 Min. per Aura
Description: Each wall created by this spell is 10’ high, 10’ 
wide and 6” thick of scintillating, passable translucence. 
The walls may be produced anywhere there is room for 
them, but each wall must touch another. Touching the wall 
with exposed flesh does 1d12 per 2 Aura points. If a being 
becomes immersed in the field, it will take the above listed 
damage to 2d4 random areas. The being affected is allowed 
a Magic Resistance. If he makes the roll by less than or equal 
to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was 
made, but was greater than 1/2 the chance, then half damage 
is taken. Failure indicates full damage. 
Notes: The walls must be rooted onto a surface and cannot 
be cast in the air. If the wall cannot fit into the desired 
casting area, or if there is a living being in this area, then 
that particular section of the wall will fail.

Piety Level 2
DISCERN WOUNDS
Alignment Restriction: Non-Evil	
Save: None 
Prayer Time: 10 minutes	
	
Uses: 3 per PC
Invoking Time: 5 seconds	
	
Range: Touch
Area Affected: Invoker plus one being	
Duration: 5 seconds.
Distance to Focus: Touch
Description: The user concentrates for 5 seconds and 
then makes physical contact with another living being 
or creature. If the being has any form of lost Endurance 
(damage) then the invoker is required to make a Will Force 
to maintain contact as the pain of those wounds is felt by 
the invoker. If the Will Force save is made, then the invoker 
maintains contact for an additional 5 seconds. At the end 
of this period the invoker will have a catalog of wounds 
sustained by the being contacted. At higher than 10 PC 
the exact nature of the wounds will be understood, broken 
bones, loss of function, etc. Below 10 PC only the general 
level of the wounds will be understood. Thus, a chest wound 
of 12 points will be rated as more severe than a small 2 point 
cut on the hand. 
Notes: Only the damage itself will be known but not the 
source of the damage. Thus, poison, disease, or ongoing 
magical effects will not reveal themselves to the invoker. 
Any healing done following the Discern Wounds may be 
ultimately ineffective if the target continues to take damage 
from these effects after the healing.

Alignment Restriction: None	
	
Save: None 
Prayer Time: 10 minutes	
	
Uses: 3 per PC
Invoking Time: 5 seconds	
	
Range: 100’ per PC
Area Affected: One being	
	
Duration: 1 Min. per PC. 
Distance to Focus: 3’ per PC
Description: The target being’s voice is amplified several 
fold. All beings within 100’ per Piety Control can clearly 
hear the speaker, even above the din of battle. 
Notes: The tone of voice is not changed, but the volume re-
mains very loud, even if the speaker is whispering. The skills 
Battle Cry and Intimidation are increased by 20% when the 
speaker is affected by Thunderous Voice.

Piety Level 5
BLESSED DRINK
Alignment Restriction: Good	
	
Save: None 
Prayer Time: 25 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per PC
Invoking Time: 10 minutes	
	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 container	
	
Duration: See below
Distance to Focus: 3’ per PC
Description: the invoker focuses on a single container and 
then calls for the invocation, filling it with blessed drink of 
up to 6 oz. per PC. The blessed drink when consumed can 
have the following effects:
•	 Can be alcoholic and of a type like beer, wine, brandy, 
whiskey, etc. The strength of the alcohol can be no more 
than 3 proof per PC. The type of alcohol produced must 
be within the invoker’s proof range. Beer is 2 to 9 proof 
for instance. 
•	 Removes 1 level of fatigue.
•	 Removed 1 point of damage per 4 ounces consumed to 
all wounds. 
•	 +10% bonus to poison and diseases resistance. Duration 
is 1 hour per 4 ounces consumed. 
•	 +10% to resist control and fear from an evil being. 
Duration is 1 hour per 4 ounces consumed. 
•	 Acts as holy water but only against undead (not the other 
properties).
Notes: Each of these properties is separate and may not 
be provided by a particular deity. For instance, if the deity 
frowns on drink then the blessed drink will not be alcoholic.

FATE TOKEN
Alignment Restriction: None	
	
Save: None 
Prayer Time: 25 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per PC
Invoking Time: 10 minutes	
	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 object and 1 being	
Duration: 1 day per PC
Distance to Focus: Touch 
Description: The invoker takes any non-magical, non-
divine object they can hold in their hand and touches it to 
one being. Then one fate is named per PC of the invoker, 
and an action for the token is described if that fate should 
happen to befall the target. The fates may include things 
like, control, death, wounding, banishment, immobile, etc. 
Then a condition of the token is named for each fate, such as 
tarnish appearing on a silver disk, spinning of a top, blood 
appearing on a knife, or beads sticking on a string, etc. 
These conditions occur on the token when and if the fate 
happens to the individual. The fate token does not have to be 
on either the invoker or the being, and it can be anywhere 
in the same multiverse so long as neither the token nor the 
being is in an anti-divinity area, or surrounded by some 
form of divine blockage. A being can never be the target of 
more than one fate token, and no more than 1 fate token 
per 5 PC can be in existence from this invoker at one time. 
When reaching 20 PC the fate token remains in existence a 
year and a day instead of the normal duration.
HUNGER
Alignment Restriction: Non-Good	
Save: Magic Resistance 
Prayer Time: 25 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per PC
Invoking Time: 10 seconds	
	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 being/creature	 	
Duration: Instantaneous
Distance to Focus: 3’ per PC
Description: The invoker targets a being or creature and 
then concentrates for 1 minute. The target then makes a 
successful Magic Resistance or is sapped of energy and

SHADOW ADHERENCE
Alignment Restriction: None	
	
Save: None
Prayer Time: 30 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per PC
Invoking Time: 10 seconds	
	
Range: Touch
Area Affected: 1 object	
	
Duration: 30 Sec. per PC
Distance to Focus: None
Description: By means of this invocation the invoker can 
adhere one physical object to the next shadow-shifted being 
or object it touches. The object will be adhered at 10 pounds 
per PC. This means that for every PC of the invoker, 10 
pounds of pressure must be applied to pull the object free 

===== PAGE 434 =====
428
from whatever it has been adhered to, otherwise, it remains 
stuck. A character may exert up to his load limit to pull 
himself or the adhered object free. A successful Force skill 
roll will also work. This spell allows a shadow-shifted being 
to carry a non-shadow shifted object. The target of the spell 
cannot be an object on the Shadow Plane, unless the invoker 
is on the Shadow Plane.
Notes: If the adhered object touches flesh, the being gets a 
Magic Resistance to avoid the object sticking. If it sticks, the 
outer layer of skin will drop off 8-12 hours later, freeing the 
adhered creature. Characters attempting to pull free may do 
so if they possess enough strength but will take 2d6 damage 
to adhered areas.
Special Usage: Allows a shadow shifted invoker to adhere 
a shadow shifted object to non-shadow shifted object or 
being. While shadow shifted a non-shadow shifted object 
cannot be the target of this spell.

MATERIAL MESSENGER
Alignment Restriction: None	
	
Save: None
Prayer Time: 30 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per PC
Invoking Time: 5 seconds	
	
Range: None
Area Affected: 1 item		
	
Duration: 1 Day per PC
Distance to Focus: Touch
Description: Grants the invoker the ability to touch one 
small material statue or figurine (above 3 inches and below 
3 feet in average dimensions) while thinking or speaking a 
message. When the message is finished, the statue comes 
alive and then attempts to deliver the message to the 
recipient anywhere on the same plane. The location or 
the recipient must be described in detail. If a true name 
is known, then the stone messenger does not need any 
instructions to seek the recipient. The characteristics of the 
material messenger depend partially on the material it was 
created with as noted below with general characteristics at 
the end. 
Clay/Hardened Earth: 
1)	 10 in all physical attributes
2)	 Endurance 10+1 per PC
3)	 5 armor value (hide)
Wood: 
1)	 11 in all physical attributes
2)	 Endurance 15+1 per PC
3)	 8 armor value (hide)
Stone: 
1)	 12 in all physical attributes
2)	 Endurance 20+2 per PC
3)	 12 armor value (hide)
Crystal: 
1)	 13 in all physical attributes
2)	 Endurance 25+2 per PC
3)	 15 armor value (hide)
Metal: 
4)	 14 in all physical attributes
5)	 Endurance 25+3 per PC
6)	 20 armor value (hide)
General Material Messenger characteristics
•	 Never fatigues, rests, or tires.  
•	 It avoids any form of confrontation as it has no offensive 
ability. It merely tries to escape to deliver the message, 
or alternately hides by not moving if it has not been 
seen in motion until the threat leaves. If destroyed the 
invocation immediately fails. 
•	 The messenger has the ability to reason and is granted 
limited sapience (mental attributes of 10) allowing it 
to follow the instructions of the invoker to deliver the 
message. 
•	 The messenger has a magical voice, eyes, and hearing. 
It does not speak except to deliver the message to the 
recipient, but it can listen and see, aiding it in delivering 
the message. 
•	 It has locomotion equal to the type of object it was. If it 
was an animal or small humanoid then it moves as that 
animal or humanoid, flying if winged, running if not, etc. 
If the object is something else then apply the appropriate 
locomotion; a boat will sail (or row), a balloon will float, 
a wagon or a ball will roll, etc. It must have some kind of 
applicable locomotion, however. For example: attempting 
to use a stone cube as a stone messenger simply fails. The 
speed of the motion is dependent on the surface moving 
over. 60’ per second in the air (40 miles per hour), 30’ 
per second in on the ground (20 miles per hour) and 15’ 
per second in water (10 miles per hour).  Loss of limbs 
slows speed accordingly. So, if wings are lost, it can only 
move along the ground. If it had 4 legs and loses one, it 
moves at 3/4 speed, etc. 
•	 When the message is delivered, or the duration ends, 
the messenger reverts to its original form wherever it 
was. It attempts to be upright when this happens if this is 
possible. 
Notes: If the messenger takes damage and then returns to 
statue form, one half of the damage is still present. Multiple 
invocations will reduce damage by half each time it is used 
on the same damaged statue or figurine. When it finally 
reaches 1 damage in an area, the next invocation will remove 
the last point of damage.

SWARM SHAPE
Alignment Restriction: Non-good

minimum damage is 1. Thus, if a single swarm creature is 
killed even if the percentage drops below 1 actual damage, 1 
damage is assessed anyway. Returning to natural form takes 
5 seconds as the swarm, or what remains of it tries to gather 
in the form of the being, even the remaining dead bodies

members become scabby wounds (sealed) as noted below.

Tiny flying insects: treat as insects (Aspects of the Wild) except that these insects are 1/10th Endurance, are unable to cause damage with 
flying 12/110/11 movement.
Biting flying insects: treat as insects (Aspects of the Wild) each has a 2 second attack that does 1 point of damage with flying 12/110/11 
movement. 
Disease-bearing flying insects: treat as insects (Aspects of the Wild) each has 1 Endurance, and a 2 second attack that does 1 point of 
damage and bears a non-magical disease chosen by the invoker with flying 12/110/11 movement. 
Venomous spiders: treat as spiders (Aspects of the Wild) each has each has 1 Endurance, and a 3 second attack that does 1 point of damage 
and can inject a poison of up to Type XII, potency M. Movement is Crawl 1/10/1 or they can Jump 5/50/5
Rats: treat as rat (Aspects of the Wild) each has 2 Endurance, 2 second bite for 1d4 or 2 second claws (2) for 1 damage. Movement is Slink 
2/20/2, Crawl 4/40/4, Scurry 6/60/6. 
Disease-bearing Rats: treat as rat (Aspects of the Wild) each has 2 Endurance, 2 second bite for 1d4 or 2 second claws (2) for 1 damage and 
bears a non-magical disease chosen by the invoker. Movement is slink 2/20/2, crawl 4/40/4, scurry 6/60/6. 
Bat: treat as bat (Aspects of the Wild) each has 2 Endurance, 4 second bite for 1-2 cutting damage or 3 second claws (2) for 1 damage and 
flies 15/150/15.  
Disease-bearing Bats: treat as rat (Aspects of the Wild) each has 2 Endurance, 4 second bite for 1-2 cutting damage or 3 second claws (2) 
for 1 damage and flies 15/150/15 and bears a non-magical disease chosen by the invoker.
Snakes: treat as snake (Aspects of the Wild) each has 2 Endurance, 4 second bite for 1-2 cutting damage. Slither at 6/60/6 or Swim at 
2/20/2
Venomous Snakes: treat as snake (Aspects of the Wild) each has 2 Endurance, 4 second bite for 1-2 cutting damage and can inject a poison 
of up to Type XV, potency M. Slither at 6/60/6 or Swim at 2/20/2

Notes: While there are significant advantages to being able to 
change one’s form into small creatures such as being able to fit 
into very small spaces, there are extreme disadvantages as well. 
The swarm is extremely vulnerable to area effect spells, and while 
the swarm gets to make Magic Resistances as the higher invoker’s 
resistance, a single flask of oil hurled into a pile of crawling insects 
could easily kill the invoker. Also all of the invoker’s possessions 
and carried equipment simply drop to the ground when the invok-
er assumes swarm shape.  When the last member of the swarm is 
killed so is the invoker. 
TRANSFER SOMA
Alignment Restriction: None	
	
Save: Magic Resistance
Prayer Time: 50 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per 4 PC
Invoking Time: 10 seconds	
	
Range: 5’ per PC
Area Affected: Focus and beneficiary	
Duration: Instantaneous
Distance to Focus:  5’ Radius per PC. 
Description: Allows the invoker to pick any two targets and 
transfer body area health between them, damaging the focus 
for 1d4+1 per 2 PC, and then adding whatever amount 
was done as healing to the body area on the beneficiary. 
Both the focus and the beneficiary must be within 5’ per 
PC. The invoker cannot transfer more health than the body 
area has, so if the damage goes over the total amount of 
endurance in the area then only that is transferred. The 
amount of Endurance between 0 and negative Vitality 
cannot be damaged by this spell, nor transferred. No single 
area may be retargeted as the focus by additional castings 
of this invocation even if there are other casters, until it is 
completely healed.
Piety Level 12
SHARE SORROW
Alignment Restriction: None	
	
Save: None
Prayer Time: 60 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per 5 PC
Invoking Time: 10 seconds	
	
Range: 5’ per PC
Area Affected: Self and 1 target	 	
Duration: Instantaneous
Distance to Focus:  Self
Description: Allows the invoker to share and possibly ease 
the sorrows of the soul of one target. For every effect which 
aged, withered, or stole life from them as well as any that 
drained or altered Aura, Piety, or Will Force involuntarily 
they are afforded a new Magic or Control Resistance at 
+20%, whether one was afforded for the initial effect or not. 
Any resistances made remove the effect. The invoker must 
also make a Magic or Control Resistance at +20% for each 
effect or suffer it themselves.
MATERIAL WARRIOR DEFENDER
Alignment Restriction: None	
	
Save: None
Prayer Time: 60 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per 5 PC
Invoking Time: 1 minute	
	
Range: Touch
Area Affected: 1 humanoid depiction	
Duration: 30 Min. per PC
Distance to Focus:  None
Description: Allows the invoker to touch one statue or 
carving of a humanoid that then animates and becomes a 
defender for the invoker. The stature or carving affected 
can be no larger than 9’ in any one dimension. The 
characteristics of the material warrior defender depend 
partially on the material it was created with, as noted below 
with general characteristics at the end.
Clay/Hardened Earth: 
1)	 16 in all physical attributes
2)	 Endurance 15+1 per PC
3)	 5 armor value (hide)
4)	 +3 weight bonus to damage
Wood: 
1)	 17 in all physical attributes
2)	 Endurance 20+1 per PC
3)	 8 armor value (hide)
4)	 +2 weight bonus to damage
Stone: 
1)	 18 in all physical attributes
2)	 Endurance 25+2 per PC
3)	 12 armor value (hide)
4)	 +4 weight bonus to damage
Crystal: 
1)	 19 in all physical attributes
2)	 Endurance 30+2 per PC
3)	 15 armor value (hide)
4)	 +3 weight bonus to damage
Metal: 
1)	 20 in all physical attributes
2)	 Endurance 30+3 per PC
3)	 20 armor value (hide)
4)	 +5 weight bonus to damage
The warrior will have the following properties:
•	 The warrior is ambidextrous. 
•	 It can wield any weapon or use its hands, but the damage 
is the same at 1d6+2 per 3 PC, +Strength modifiers 
and any additional weight modifiers.  The attacks take 
5 seconds each but it gets 2 per round with each hand 
whether it wields a weapon or not. 
•	 Attack skill is two levels higher than the invoker’s, with a 
maximum of Master. 
•	 The warrior defender never fatigues, rests, or tires.  
•	 The defender has the able to reason and is granted 
full sapience (15 Mental), allowing it to follow the 
commands of the invoker. If the invoker is injured, it 
will ignore all current commands not pertaining to the 

===== PAGE 441 =====
435
protection of the invoker and come to the direct aid of 
the invoker.
•	 It has a magical sense of touch, sight, hearing, and life 
sensing. It understands the invoker’s spoken commands 
in any language the invoker speaks. It can understand 
others if they speak in one of the invoker’s languages.
•	 It moves at up to 30’ per second, or 20 miles per hour. 
Destruction of a leg will slow this to 5’ per second, or 4 
miles per hour, both legs will only allow it to crawl (if it 
still has arms) at 1’ per second, or 8 tenths of a mile per 
hour. 
•	 When the duration ends the defender reverts to its 
original form wherever it is. It attempts to set down any 
weapons it carries 10 seconds before the duration ends, 
and then tries to be upright when this happens if at all 
possible. 
Notes: If the defender takes damage and then returns to 
statue form, one half of the damage is still present. So 
multiple invocations will reduce damage by half each time 
it is used on the same damaged statue or carving. When it 
finally reaches 1 damage in an area the next invocation will 
remove the last point of damage.

Prayer Time: 65 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per 6 PC
Invoking Time: 10 minutes	
	
Range: Touch
Area Affected: 1 being	
	
Duration: Instantaneous
Distance to Focus:  Touch
Description: This invocation permanently removes the 
effects of insanity, control, fear, confusion, and any effects 
which caused or causes mind changes in one other being. 
The invoker cannot target themselves with this invocation. 
Permanent effects require 1/10th of 1 Will Force to be 
spent by either the target or the invoker. The decision can 
be made at the end of the invocation when mental health is 
restored, and this makes the effect permanent, otherwise any 
permanent mental disabilities or changes returns in 1 hour 
per Will Force of the target.

SHADOW SHIFT
Alignment Restriction: Non-Good	
Save: Magic Resistance
Prayer Time: 75 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per 8 PC
Invoking Time: 10 seconds	
	
Range: Touch
Area Affected: 1 being/object	
	
Duration: 30 Min. per PC
Distance to Focus:  Touch
Description: By means of this invocation the target being 
and all the possessions being carried become shadowy, 
and then enter the Shadow Plane. The being appears as a 
shadowy, faded version of themselves. All physical actions 
against the caster will have no effect whatsoever, but the 
reverse also holds true. Entering an Anti-Magic zone will 
cause the being to return from the Shadow Plane.
Notes: Should the character drop an object, it will remain 
shadow shifted and can only be retrieved by another shadow 
shifted being. Alternately, the spell can simply be cast on 
an object causing it to shadow shifted out until retrieved by 
another shadow shifted being. All mental powers held by the 
caster or enemies thereof will freely pass onto the Shadow 
Plane, so that mental combat is possible. If a living being 
is killed on the Shadow Plane, its body will stay shadow 
shifted and may become a ghost trapped forever between 
dimensions. However, if the being is merely unconscious, 
they will return at the end of the invocation’s duration.
Piety Level 16
DAY KEN
Alignment Restriction: None	
	
Save: Magic Resistance
Prayer Time: 80 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per 8 PC
Invoking Time: 1 minute	
	
Range: Sight
Area Affected: 1 being	
	
Duration: 1 Minute/PC
Distance to Focus: 3 ft. per PC
Description: Allows a being to see as if it were day. If used 
during at night the moon will still be visible in the sky (if 
applicable), but to the affected being it will be very difficult 
to see. The sky appears filled with the brightness of daylight, 
and the land appears exactly as if it were day. Beings with 
night-sensitive vision, as well as those with an appropriate 
magically or divinely enhanced vision, may treat their vision 
as though it were actually day.
Note: This does not actually make it day; the affected being 
simply perceives the world as though it were.
NIGHT KEN
Alignment Restriction: None	
	
Save: Magic Resistance
Prayer Time: 80 minutes	
	
Uses: 1 per 8 PC
Invoking Time: 1 minute	
	
Range: Sight
Area Affected: 1 being	
	
Duration: 1 Minute/PC
Distance to Focus: 3 ft. per PC
Description: Allows a being to see as if it were night. If used 
during the day the sun will still be visible in the sky, but to 
the affected being will appear very muted and dim. Stars 
become visible as if the sun were not present, and the land 
appears blanketed in darkness exactly as if it were night. 
Beings with day-sensitive vision, as well as those with an 
appropriate magically or divinely enhanced vision, may treat 
their vision as though it were actually night. 
Note: This does not actually make it night; the affected being 
simply perceives the world as though it were.

it speak, and/or tell the truth can be used. The bust lasts for 
1 minute per practitioner title. Candles: B, W, GR, OR

Lostmark (Rating 20/-20%): Allows the wearer to have a 
5% chance per practitioner title of entering the Plane of 
the Lost/Junk once per day when no other being can see or 
hear them. Also allows unlimited automatic return after 10 
seconds of concentration (returning to wherever the wearer 
last left.) Emanating.
Lostward (Rating 20/-20%): Keeps the wearer from entering 
the Plane of the Lost/Junk. Also grants +10% to the 
following skills: Distance Knowledge, Direction Knowledge, 
Depth Knowledge, Navigate and Cartography. Emanating. 
Planarbind (Rating 22/-30%): Keeps persons, places and 
objects within rune’s sight in the current plane. Radiating.
Planarmark (Rating 16/+0%): Allows the wearer to return to 
their plane of origin in a place the wearer identifies as home 
once per day. Emanating.
Planarward (Rating 19/-15%): Keeps the wearer in their 
current plane. Emanating.
Phasemark (Rating 18/-10%): Allows the wearer to have a 
5% chance per practitioner title of entering or returning 
from the Phase Plane. Requires 10 seconds of concentration 
for each use and only allows 1 user per practitioner title per 
day. Emanating.
Phaseward (Rating 16/+0%): Keeps the wearer from entering 
the Phase Plane. Emanating. 
Shadowmark (Rating 18/-10%): Allows the wearer to 
have a 5% chance per practitioner title of entering or 
returning from the Shadow Plane. Requires 10 seconds 
of concentration for each use and only allows 1 user per 
practitioner title per day. Emanating.
Shadowward (Rating 16/+0%): Keeps the wearer from 
entering the shadow plane. Emanating. 
Soulmark (Rating 28/-60%): Protects against any effect 
which takes or separates the soul from the body, mind or 
spirit except death. Emanating.

New Songs
Calm Mind (Rating 19/-5%): 10 seconds.  Listeners are 
placed in a calm, reflective state, possibly gain relief from 
controlling effects (a new Control Resistance) and for the 
duration of the song, are granted +5% to informational 
skills, +15% to Meditate, Body Control and Tranquil 
Mind (from an upcoming volume.) +10% to Will Force and 
concentration saves. Any hostile actions taken negate these 
effects, except for any control that was broken.
Dimensional Repair (Rating 20/-10%): 1d4 minutes.  Repairs 
one broken item held by the singer by replacing it with one 
from an alternate dimension. The item is now supernatural 
and may be subtly or greatly different than the original 
at the GM’s discretion. If the item (or its dimensional 
replacement) is magical or divine in nature then this effect 
only has a 5% chance per practitioner title of succeeding. 
Dream Item (Rating 19/-5%): 10 seconds.  While on the 
plane of dreams the singer can sing into existence one 
normal dream item of no more than 5 lb. per practitioner 
title. The item will last 1 hour per practitioner title and 
has a 2% chance per practitioner title of returning with 
the dreamer to their plane of origin when they awaken (or 
leave) the dream plane. 
Elemental Transit (Rating 18/+0%): 1 minute.  Grants the 
singer and 1 listener per practitioner title the ability to 
walk on any liquid as well as immunity to pressure and one 
other elemental immunity (cold, heat, electricity, acid, life, 
death, or aura.) If on the Plane of Air, the ability to fly at 
up to 3 feet per Intelligence rating is granted. These effects 
only operate on the elemental planes and last 1 hour per 
practitioner title.
Resist Supernatural Influence (Rating 19/-5%): 5 seconds.  
Grants one new resistance to any current negative effects 
caused by a supernatural being. If more than one negative 
effect is in place then one new resistance is granted for each 
until the total number of negative effects exceeds the singer’s 
practitioner title. 
Return (Rating 17/+5%): 10 seconds.  One supernatural 
being per practitioner title is afforded the opportunity to 
return to their plane of origin, to their home or other known 
safe place.
Return of the Lost (Rating 20/-10%): 1-3 minutes.  While 
on the Plane of the Lost/Junk one lost item sung about is 
returned to the singer, at their feet, at song’s end. 
Reveal Origin (Rating 16/+10%): 10 seconds.  A symbol 
appears above the head of one being per practitioner title. 
The symbol reveals the plane of origin of the being. The 
symbol can either be seen only by the practitioner or is 
revealed to all depending on the singer’s desire. Non-
detection is proof against this effect. Lasts 1 minute per 
practitioner title. 
Sustaining (Rating 18/+0%): 1 minute.  Grants the singer 
and 1 listener per practitioner title freedom from hunger, 
thirst and the need to breath as well as granting immunity to 
pressure and fatigue for 1 hour per practitioner title. 
Weave Plants (Rating 18/+0%): 1 minute.  Allows the singer 
to weave plants into 10 feet of usable rope or 1 square foot of 
usable cloth per practitioner title. The quality of the material 
is normal unless craftsperson skills are used. 
Planar Traveling (Rating 19/-5%): 1 minute.  Allows the 
practitioner to create a gateway to an alternate plane. It 
will remain open for 1 minute per practitioner title. It is a 
two-way gateway while open. Also, anyone passing through 
gateway gains 1 appropriate protection effect for the plane 
they are traveling too that lasts 1 hour per practitioner title 
and can be renewed by the practitioner with a 10 second 
refrain of the original song. Example: Plane of Fire gateway 
would provide Endure Heat. If the plane traveled to has 
no plane-wide dangers, no protections are given. If there 
is more than one dangerous effect the singer chooses one 
protection. 
New Poems
Dreaming Slumber (Rating 20/-20%): 1d4 minutes.  Causes 1 
listener per Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance 
or fall into a deep slumber after which they make a Magic 
Resistance or they are sent to the plane of dreams (without 
their bodies.)
Enrichment (Rating 14/+10%): 2d6 seconds.  Causes the 
reciter and up to 1 listener per Practitioner Title to be 
hydrated, nourished and have all fatigue removed. 
Ethereal Movement (Rating 17/-5%): 1 minute.  Grants the 
power of flight 3’ per Intelligent point and levitate to the 
reciter and 1 being per practitioner title. The effect lasts 
1d4+1 hours per practitioner title. Only works on the 

===== PAGE 447 =====
441
ethereal plane.
Origin (Rating 16/+0%): 10 seconds.  Makes a symbol that 
only the practitioner can see appear above the head of 
one being per practitioner title. The symbol indicates to 
the practitioner what the being’s plane of origin is. Non-
detection is proof against this effect. This effect lasts 1 
minute per practitioner title.
Phase Door (Rating 19/-15%): 10 seconds. Turns an ordinary 
door into a doorway to the Phase Plane for 1 minute per 
practitioner title. Does not work on planes not connected 
to the phase plane. If used on the Phase Plane it creates a 
doorway to the natural universe. 
Reuse Portal (Rating 18/-10%): 20 seconds.  Opens one 
portal within sight that has been used within one day per 
practitioner title. The portal stays open for 10 minutes per 
practitioner title. 
Return (Rating 16/+0%): 10 seconds.  One supernatural 
being per practitioner title is afforded the opportunity to 
return to their plane of origin to their home or other known 
safe place.
Reveal Portal (Rating 14/+10%): 1 minute.  Reveals one 
portal per practitioner title within sight. Above the portal 
a symbol(s) appears that only the practitioner can see, that 
reveals where the plane the portal is connected to. This 
effect lasts 1 minute per practitioner title.
Shadow Door (Rating 19/-15%): 10 seconds. Turns an 
ordinary door into a doorway to the Plane of Shadow for 
1 minute per practitioner title. Does not work on planes 
not connected to the Shadow Plane. If used on the Shadow 
Plane it creates a doorway to the natural universe.
New Ballads
Dreamweave (Rating 18/-5%): 10 minutes.  Creates up to 
one dream object per current title/level of the balladeer. 
Each item can be no more than 10 lb. per title/level of 
the balladeer. There is a 5% chance that the items will be 
temporarily magical at up to +1 per 3 full titles/levels of the 
balladeer. This ballad only works on the plane of dreams. 
One designated item has a 2% chance per title/level of the 
balladeer of returning with the dreamer when leaving the 
dream plane. 
Gateway (Rating 19/-10%): 10 minutes.  Creates a gateway 
up to 20 feet high and 10 feet wide that can open to one 
plane connected to this plane per 3 titles/levels of the 
balladeer. The place the portal is connected to may also 
be elsewhere on the same plane. Each connecting point is 
described by the practitioner based on a place they have 
seen or had described to them (Knowledge save required 
for each.) The gateway appears in whatever form the 
practitioner desires, a door, a mirror, an archway, etc. Some 
form of attunement device has to be present on (or near) the 
gateway to allow it to be set to the particular point if there 
is more than one. Also, anyone passing through gateway 
gains 1 appropriate protection effect for the plane they are 
travelling too that lasts as long as they stay on that plane. 
The gateway itself lasts 1 day per title/level of the balladeer 
and is permanent if 1 Will Force is expended. Example: 
Plane of Death gateway would provide Endure Death. If the 
plane traveled to has no plane-wide dangers, no protections 
are given. If there is more than one dangerous effect the 
singer chooses one protection.
Place of Safety (Rating 17/+0%): 10 minutes.  Creates 
a place of safety that is up to 10 cubic feet or 10 feet in 
diameter (practitioner’s choice.) The place of safety provides 
the following effects: contains a pocket of breathable 
(replenishing air), temperature is kept to 72 degrees 
Fahrenheit, pressure is kept to sea level of earth, there is a 
replenishing source of water (pool, pond or fountain), the 
pH balance of all liquids within the area becomes neutral. 
The area is also surrounded by a thin barrier which keeps 
out all negative magical effects. A form of desired food 
appears on one of the surfaces that will feed up to 10 beings 
per practitioner title and reappears three times per day. 
There is also a walkable surface created as needed out of 
whatever normal material desired with a lip at the edge high 
enough to prevent unintended falls. This place of safety lasts 
1 day per title/level of the balladeer and is permanent if 1 
Will Force is expended
Remove Supernatural Influence (Rating 19/-10%): 10 
seconds.  Removes up to one negative effect caused by a 
supernatural being per title/level of the balladeer on any 
number of beings within sight.

ROPE OF TRICKS
Description: This rope is a very useful tool and appears as a 
thin brown rope of +3 magical plant fiber 200 feet long and 
yet weightless. This can be used as a whip by holding all but 
the last few feet of the rope as a coil and using the rest as a 
+3 whip.
Base Aura Level 20
Abilities
Levitate: The rope is weightless as is anyone who is climbing 
it. 
Powers
Animate Object: (Aura Level 13) at will, by thought (5 
seconds): 
The rope can be commanded to animate and coil, uncoil, 
tie, loosen, make itself into a rope ladder (loses half length), 
lasso or noose, etc. 
Entwine: (Aura Level 4) 3 x day, by thought (5 seconds): 
The rope will attempt to entwine up to four individuals 
within 20’ feet of each other. Each round it has a 70% chance 
of entwining each individual designated in range. Once 
entwined the rope can be designated as holding them and 
then a contest of 90% for the rope against either the Strength 
or Agility of the held being to escape each 5 Seconds. 
Furthermore, constriction damage can be applied (if desired 
by the rope user) and each held individual will take 3d6 
constriction per 10 second round in areas entwined (if 
constriction is desired.).
Throw: (Aura Level 5) 5 x day, by thought (5 seconds): The 
rope will throw itself in any desired direction and will travel 
up to visual range before landing. The rope as a whole does 
no damage if it strikes something as it is weightless (but can 
do damage as a whip if used in that fashion by holding on to 
most of it.)

SCAVENGER'S EYEPIECE
Description: This eyepiece has a single glass lens set into a 
+1 steel cup that fits snugly against the wearer’s skin (like 
one side of a pair of goggles). This fits onto the wearer’s 
head with an adjustable +1 leather strap with a buckle. The 
eyepiece is enchanted with several powers, available as long 
as the user has the necessary amount of aura in her Aura 
Pool:
•	 Anyone looking through this eyepiece gains the 
Scavenging skill at 80%, granting the ability to find 
needed items and shelter that are present within 
urban environments. The user gains another +20% to 
Scavenging when searching recent ruins (within the last 
100 years).
•	 Around the lens sits a steel circle that clicks at certain 
intervals when it is turned. Three times per day, by 
turning this circular edge clockwise 3 clicks while 
focusing on a particular item, the user can imbue magic, 
causing it to temporarily become a magical +3 item. It is 
considered magical for bonuses to hit, damage, and to be 
hit. If the user spends 1/4 Will Force, however, the item 
becomes permanently magical, even its essence, affecting 
armor strength and durability, weapon weight and speed, 
etc.
•	 The user may look through the lens 5 times per day at 
any dirty item (even the eyepiece’s strap, and thus the 
entire eyepiece itself) and clean it of all dust, grime, 
scum, and bacteria, making it clean and polished. Earth-
based beings and slimes are allowed a Magic Resistance 
to avoid taking 7d4 magical damage to a single random 
location. If the creature has been summoned from 
another plane, then there is a 15% chance it will be 
banished to its home plane.
•	 Three times per day, the user may touch the leather strap 
to any damaged object and repair it. All missing parts 
will be re-formed, as long as they are within 15 ft³ of 
the user and the object has not lost more than half of its 
original composition.
Base Aura Level 15
Powers
Clean (Aura Level 1): 5x day, by deed (looking at target 
through lens)
Imbue Magical Aura (Aura Level 5): 3x day, by deed (turning 
eyepiece’s edge clockwise 3 clicks while wearing eyepiece 
and focusing on targeted item)
Repair (Aura Level 11): 3x day, by deed (touching leather 
strap to targeted item)
Skill Abilities
Scavenging: 80%

SHADOW BEACON
Description: This item just appears as a normal object and 
has non-detection so it gives off neither magic nor any other 
clues as to its powerful ability. This item is placed within 
a single shadow structure on the Shadow Plane that has 
a Natural Universe counterpart. It then creates a gateway 
between the natural universe structure and the Shadow 
Plane one. Any doorway, window or even hole in the natural 
universe structure becomes a one-way portal to the Shadow 
Plane. It hides this transition with illusions of sight, sound, 
feeling, taste, touch and sensing. The person who entered 
the structure in the Natural Universe is now in the Shadow 
Plane without knowing it, unless they request and make an 
Illusion Resistance. These items were said to be made and 
still utilized by Gray and Green Shadow Flayers. The beacon 
has one other property. The Shadow Beacon uses the same 
illusions within 1 mile to make the Shadow Plane reflections 
appear, feel, sound, taste, smell and even sense like the 
Natural Universe and it bestows Shadow Adhere on all those 
who transitioned over allowing them to walk normally as 
long as they stay within 1 mile of the Beacon, it also uses the 
illusions to mask this effect being active. 
Base Aura Level 20
Abilities
Non-Detection. Gate (skill): acts as a one-way portal within 
a Natural Universe structure (all entrances) when placed in a 
shadow reflection of that same structure on the Shadow Plane. 
All Illusions Combined: (Natural Universe: Hides the portal 
transfer to the Plane of Shadows)
All Illusions Combined: (Shadow Plane: Makes the Shadow 
Plane appear to be the Natural Universe in every way)
Shadow Adhere (Shadow Plane only: Allows all those who 
enter the portal to walk normally on the Shadow Plane.)
Anomaly
All Powers and effects on the Plane of Shadow extend outward 
1 mile from the beacon and effect all of those who were 
portaled in by the beacon indefinitely so long as they stay 
within 1 mile.
Total PP Spent: 400     	
Classification: Arch    	
Time to Enchant: 10 mos.
Will Force Cost: 2   	
Exp. Value: 2,550

BLANKET OF CONTENTMENT
Description: This incredibly soft, white blanket made of 
+2 Mithreel weave offers several magical powers intending 
to envelop the user in absolute comfort. These powers are 
useable twice per day. Unwilling beings are afforded a Magic 
Resistance for each effect. If worn as a cloak, this blanket 
offers 8 points of Armor Value.
•	 Anyone who touches this blanket feels calm and 
gains an immunity to fear, loses any current fear effects, 
gains +10% Control Resistance, +10% to morale checks, 
+50% to the skill Meditate, a -50% penalty to Berserking, 
and must make a Control Resistance or lose the effects of 
Berserking. These effects last for 6 minutes.
•	 Anyone wrapped in the blanket feels fatigued and gains 6 
levels of physical and mental fatigue.
•	 The blanket and anyone touching it is cleaned of all dust, 
grime, scum, and bacteria.
•	 Anyone who wraps the blanket around their shoulders 
like a cloak is surrounded with a sphere (with a radius of 
the target’s height) of constant temperature comfortable 
to the affected being. Cold and fire-based effects, both 
magical and mundane, are nullified by the sphere. This 
effect lasts for 3 hours.
•	 Injured body areas are healed 6d4+6 damage when the 
blanket touches them. A single area may not be healed 
again with this power. Magical protections like the spell 
Force Armor or the invocation Spiritual Armor will 
prevent Heal from being discharged.
•	 The user is infused with life-giving water or sustaining 
energy and has no need for addition water or food, 
regardless of the environment they are in, for the next 6 
hours.
•	 Once per day, the user gains the skill Flowing Thought 
after folding the blanket, holding it in his lap, and 
making a successful Meditate skill roll.
Base Piety Level 12
Powers
Calm (Piety Level 7): 2x day, by deed (target touches 
blanket.)
Cause Fatigue (Piety Level 10): 2x day, by deed (target 
wrapped in blanket.)
Clean (Piety Level 1): 2x day, by thought, affinity for the 
blanket and user.
Constrain Temperature (Piety Level 12): 2x day, by deed 
(target wears blanket like a cloak.)
Heal (Piety Level 4): 2x day, by deed (blanket covers injured 
body area.)
Hydrate (Piety Level 5): 2x day, by thought.
Nourish (Piety Level 5): 2x day, by thought.

1 Endurance per 10 miles an hour per day. Water of equal 
or greater mass than the calcified form will cause the entire 
form to dissolve immediately. Destroying the calcified form 
will release the spirit and soul.

following characteristics:

•	 29 END
•	 5 armor value (Hide)
•	 Ambidextrous
•	 Attack skill is 2 levels higher than user (maximum of

•	 Each attack takes 5 seconds and inflicts 4d6+11 damage
•	 Never fatigues
•	 Has the ability to reason and is granted full sapience 
though not free will, allowing it to follow the user’s 
commands. If the user is injured, the soldier will ignore 
all current commands and come to the user’s aid.
•	 Gains magical senses of touch, sight, hearing, and life 
sensing, and understands the user’s spoken commands in 
any language the user speaks. It can understand others as 
they speak, in one of the user’s languages.
•	 Moves up to 30’ per second or 20 miles per hour.  
Destruction of a leg will slow this to 5’ per second or 4 
miles per hour. Destruction of both legs will allow it to 
crawl (if it still has arms) at 1’ per second or 8/10ths of a 
mile per hour.
•	 After 10 minutes or when the user turns off this power, 
the calcified defender sets down any weapons it carries 
and reverts back to a motionless, upright statue. If the 
statue was damaged while in its animated state, half of

MAP OF MYSTERIES
Description: This is a +4 sheet of parchment created with 
the spell “Produce All”. When folded closed, it is 6”x3”. 
When unfolded, it is 2’x2’ and fills with a rough layout of 
both natural land features (water, hills, foliage, etc.) and

that are seen) within 100’ of the user. Each square inch 
on the parchment is equal to 5 square feet. These drawn 
lines are inscribed onto the parchment in black magical 
ink, spreading out from the user’s location at the very 
center. This mystical mapping works on any plane (earth, 
air, dream, etc.). As the user moves, more landscape and 
building features are magically added onto the parchment. 
The drawn lines remain stationary on the parchment until 
someone re-activates the power, at which point all writing 
disappears and a new map begins to draw itself according to 
the user’s current location. Any script written on or carved 
into structures drawn on the map are automatically written 
out in the corresponding location in the user’s primary 
language.
Besides drawing surrounding features and script, this map 
also marks certain beings and objects within sight several

and their colors are based on type of being or object 
(corpse: white, divinity: gold, evil: purple, good: pale blue, 
supernatural: red). This map marks corpses up to 100’ from 
the user, but all other types of beings or objects must be

Furthermore, the user may touch the parchment with a

activation of Clean), the user may blow on the parchment (4

day, the user may also cause the parchment to appear look 
old and dirty by touching it to any soil or grime.

•	 Beings that are the same alignment category (good,

(+5% per fate point) or combat modifiers (+1 per fate 
point).
•	 Beings not in the same alignment category will feel as 
though fate is against them. The user will get 2-5 fate

in the wind.
•	 All enemies of the user (including hostile animals) must 
make an Agility save once per 10 seconds or be blown to 
the ground. All missile weapons fired by enemies of the

•	 All missile weapons fired by companions of the user are 
at +4 to hit.

SWATHE OF VISION
Description: This is a sheer square of shimmering +5 
Crysteel weave measuring 4’x4’, appearing white on one side 
and black on the other. It offers 12 points of Armor Value. 
When worn in various ways, it offers several types of vision.
•	 When rolled into a blindfold (white side out) and 
worn over the eyes of a blind being, that being’s sight is 
restored, even if the effect was natural, disease, poison, 
magical, or divine magical in nature. The being’s eyes (or 
the part of the brain that sees) are physically regenerated. 
This power cannot cure blindness that is caused due to 
some forms of insanity. This power is useable once per 
week.
•	 Once per day, for a total of 16 minutes, the user may 
wear this swathe as a cape with the black side out and 
gain the ability to see as if it were day. If used at night, 
the moon will still be visible in the sky (if applicable), 
but to the user will be very difficult to see. The sky 
appears filled with the brightness of daylight, and the 
land appears exactly as if it were day. Beings with night-
sensitive vision, as well as those with an appropriate 
magically or divinely enhanced vision, may treat their 
vision as though it were actually day. Likewise, the user 
may reverse the swathe and wear it with the white side 
out as see as if it were night. The sun will be muted and 
dim. Stars become visible as if the sun were not present. 
Beings with day-sensitive vision, as well as those with an 
appropriate magically or divinely enhanced vision, may 
treat their vision as though it were actually night.
•	 Twice per day, when the user wraps the swathe around 
his head and lower face, resulting in a head wrap with 
veil, with the black side out, he gains night vision for 8 
hours. He can now see in near and complete darkness 
at a range of 120’ with full clarity. If exposed to intense 
heat or bright light, the user is temporarily blinded for 
3d4 minutes. Likewise, if the user reverses the swathe 
and wears the white side out, he gains the ability to see 
through all illusions, glamours, and magical concealment 
(including invisibility), showing the true visible nature of 
whatever is to be seen, as long as it does not have Non-
Detection. This ability also lasts for 8 hours.
•	 Three times per day, when the user wears the swathe 
over their head like a hood with the black side out, he 
gains Infravision for the next 4 hours. Likewise, if the 
user reverses the swathe and wears the white side out, he 
gains Far Sight for 4 hours.
•	 Once per day, when the user rolls up the swathe and 
ties it around his waist like a sash, he gains the ability 
to see through mundane, magical, and divine magical 
darkness. The user’s overall Endurance is reduced by 1 
per 10 seconds when this power is active. Nevertheless, it 
can last for 4 hours (if the user can.)
Base Piety Level 16

but it will vanish after 10 seconds if dropped, lost, or stolen. 
This flaming whip sword can only be activated once per day. 
While activated, it grants the user several powers:
•	 Once per day, the user may make crack the whip while

activating a magic item, or using a magical skill, the user 
makes her Steal Magic roll. If made, the spell, power, 
or skill is no longer useable by the enemy and is now 
useable only by the user. The spell, power, or skill works 
as if it was used by the user. This skill’s effect lasts 1 hour. 
Only 1 power may be stolen at a time by the user, and 
she may return the stolen ability at any time. The user 
must apply her own Aura for activation of magic items 
that drain Aura, for the casting of spells or for draining 
effects of some skills. It is not obvious to the victim what 
has happened, only that he does not have access to that 
skill, spell, or power.

ARMLET OF THE COBRA
Description: This armlet, shaped as a circling cobra is 
masterfully crafted from magically produced +4 gold, offers 
its bearer several powers:
Although the armlet’s true size is 18’ long (the length of 
a king cobra), it is usually found in its smaller size of 6’ 
diameter. If anyone inserts their hand in first, then slides the 
armlet up their arm, the armlet will magically adjust to fit. 
Once per day, the user may tap the armlet’s cobra head 3 
times and speak to 1 non-magical snake for 20 minutes. This 
snake becomes sapient for the duration and speaks with a 
magical voice in the user’s primary language. The snake will 
be able to recall events occurring in the vicinity of its life 
from the moment it was born.
Once per day, the user may tap the armlet’s cobra body 
3 times, causing no more than 10 snakes from within 20 
miles to be drawn to the user. They will be wary of, but not 
initially hostile to, the user. This power will not affect snakes 
with a Will Force of 15 or greater. Sapient and/or magical 
snakes are immune to this summons but will feel the call 
and may investigate.
Once per day, the user may tell up to 20 snakes (including 
any that have been summoned by the user) “You will do as I 
say”, causing them to obey the user’s mental commands for 
the next 10 minutes unless they make a Control Resistance. 
Any command given to goes against the snake’s nature 

===== PAGE 473 =====
467
deactivates this power.

this doll is not sapient, it cannot reason or purposefully 
answer questions truthfully.
Furthermore, this doll is the cause of nightmares, both 
waking and while asleep. Twice a day, when anyone touches 
this doll, they must make a Magic Resistance or be plagued 
by menacing, waking visions of the doll. If the being sees

Control Resistance or flee until out of sight. Will Force

of the doll or to try to damage the doll (the target is +1 
to hit and damage for any melee or missile attack). Also, 
any unfortunate being who falls asleep within 20’ of this 
doll must make a Magic Resistance or have fitful sleep and 
dreams filled with dark and despairing nightmare images. 
Upon awakening, the being must make a Wisdom save or 
finds he did not get any rest, healing, or removal of fatigue 
from sleeping. If the Wisdom save is made, then healing can 
be no more than 1 point, and only 1 fatigue level is restored.
And finally, to make matters worse, this doll moves and even 
walks around at random times, whether someone is looking 
at it or not.

•	 The utter chaos of this yarn’s vibrant disarray is so strong

•	 Beings with the alignment tendency Order must make

of this yarn, must make a Control Resistance once per 
full day of carrying this yarn or gain the Chaos tendency.

JUNKMAN'S BOX OF PARTS
Description: This is a +2 Adamantium curved-top chest 
measuring 2’ x 1’ with a height of 1’. Created by a master Dwarven 
seer who also had an avid love for inventing gadgets, this box 
holds various contraptions such as switches, coils, and gears which 
create magical effects when manipulated. Built into the outside of 
the box is a complex lock whose key handle is shaped like a gear. 
This lock is -50% to pick. As soon as the box is opened, individual 
compartments swivel upward and outward, revealing more 
beneath. Some of these compartments are for storing tools, etc., 
while others hold various mechanisms used for activating powers. 
There are four layers of these individual compartments ranging 
in size from a few inches to the entire space at the bottom. When 
the box is opened, it takes up 4’ x 4’ with a height of 3’. The box’s 
components, including compartments and attached gadgets, weigh 
10% less than they normally would.
•	 Every time the box is opened, any items already inside 
automatically become +3 magic items as far as bonuses, 
damage, and to hit (yet retain weight and weapon speed) 
for the next 15 hours.
•	 In one compartment lies an assortment of gears 
connected to each other. When one is turned, it grants 
the skill Summon Supernatural at 50%, specifically 
summoning the being from the Plane of Junk which 
corresponds to that gear. Once a particular gear is 
turned, it turns all the others but continues on its own, 
even when the user lets go. The gears continue turning, 
slowly at first and then increasing in speed as time goes 
on (using the Animate Object ability) for the entire 
30 minutes during the summons. At the summons’ 
culmination, when the gears are going incredibly fast, 
they suddenly stop as the being appears. This skill is 
useable once per day. The following beings may be 
summoned with the corresponding gears:
	» Automaton, Clockwork: silver gear bearing numbers 
around the edge
	» Automaton, Combustion: small red gear
	» Automaton, Steam: small gray gear
	» Clockwork Rat: tiny black gear
	» Golem, Brass: large brass gear
	» Golem, Clay: large clay gear
	» Golem, Crystal: large clear quartz gear
	» Golem, Iron: large iron gear
	» Golem, Steel: large steel gear
	» Golem, Stone: large stone gear
	» Golem, Wood: large wood gear
	» Homunculus: medium multi-material gear
	» Junk Skitter: medium copper gear
	» Junkman: large multi-material gear
	» Monitor: small copper gear
•	 One compartment holds a breathing apparatus which is 
large enough to cover the mouth and nose for an average 
humanoid. It has an adjustable leather strap that fastens 
to the back of the user’s head, and the whole thing is 
attached to the compartment with a strip of leather. 
When worn, this apparatus grants the power Breath 
of the Turtle, tripling the time the user can hold his 
breath for the next 5 hours. The user does not have to 
keep wearing the apparatus; he may place it back into its 
container and retain this power. This power is useable 3 
times per day.
•	 Once per day, while outside under partial cloud cover, 
the user may clip the 1’ long copper wire sticking out 
of one compartment to the white metal knob attached 
to another compartment and cause a thunderhead to 
form. A bolt of lightning hits either one target chosen by 
the user for 10d8+24 electrical damage to one random 
area, or forks to hit two targets, each taking 10d8 
electrical damage to one random area. There is no Magic 
Resistance to avoid these effects, but creatures immune 
to electricity are immune to this power.
•	 One compartment contains a 3”x2”x1” copper ingot 
attached to the compartment wall by a copper wire. 
Three times per day, when the user holds this ingot and 
speaks into it, his voice is carried to all beings within 
2,000’. Everyone within range can hear him as if he were 
standing right next to them. The skills Battle Cry and 
Intimidation are increased 20%, and any magical or 
divine magical songs, poems, ballads, or hymns have 
their area of effect (but not number affected) increased to 
this range. Each use of this copper amplifier lasts for 20 
minutes.
•	 Besides compartments, the chest also contains two round 
discs 1’ in height. These swing outward and upward 
upon opening the box, so that items may be placed 
upon them. Five times per day, each disc heats (red) or 
cools (blue) any object or being that touches it up to a 
total of 100 degrees (the user decides the amount). Each 

===== PAGE 479 =====
473
activation of heating or cooling can last for 5 hours.
•	 Protruding from one compartment is a 1’ long

is polished brass. When a non-magical metal object is

•	 One of the compartments holds a brass and glass gage

•	 One compartment holds two glass tubes, each 6” long

This includes any drinks (like fruit juice and alcohol). 
The resulting water will be suitable for any divine ritual 
requiring washing with or drinking water. Likewise,

viruses, and toxins. The liquid becomes noticeably 
cloudy and acquires an acidic or basic pH balance (user’s

The toxic severity is minimal, but enough to cause 
dysentery in animals and wilting in plants if a Poison 
Resistance at +20% is failed. Poison Resistance attempts 
may be made every 6 hours. Each failure indicates the 
being has suffered one level of fatigue. Beings inhabiting 
or submersed in Contaminated Water automatically fail 
their Poison Resistance.
•	 One of the compartments holds a silver-framed,

•	 In one compartment lies a brass articulated swivel arm

this arm swings upward and outward, holding the glass 
bulb above the entire contraption. There is a switch at 
the base of the bulb which can be slid up or down. When

light that can reach up to 60’ (the user chooses the

night vision. If the box is moved, the light emitted by the 
bulb stays in place and will not move with the bulb. This 
light fades in 10 minutes but can be reactivated at any 
time at the bulb’s present location.
•	 Once per week, someone may stand within 3 of the box, 
take a step toward it without touching any part of it, and 
be shifted to the Plane of Junk. The user must make a 
Will Force save for each object he wishes to transport 
with him. There is no guarantee that a magical item will 
function correctly when removed from its native plane. If 
the user dies while plane shifted, he is shifted back to his 
home plane where all injuries are removed and one Will 
Force rating point is permanently lost.
•	 In one compartment lies a 6’ long coiled red leather 
cord that is connected to the compartment wall. When 
this cord is wrapped around a being’s wounded body 
area at least one complete time, all wounded body areas 
(including bruises) are healed for 1d4+1. This acts as 
a bind wounds effect and cannot be combined with 
physically binding wounds.

•	 Once per day, the user may quickly touch the Wildling 
finger to both shoulders (within 2 seconds) and activate

ARTIFACTS
These items were created either by a deity, semi-deity, or by 
a mortal who gave up their life to create it, dying as the item 
was completed. Each is special in that it should be unique to 
the game world and have specific reasons for being utilized. 
A rare few are intelligent, most often they are not. Each has 
a purpose and are indestructible except through a specific 
means or triggering event. Their powers are not revealed by 
the skill Identify and are generally mastered through long 
tinkering, trial and error (sometimes with disastrous results) 
and often over many lifetimes as their powers are slowly 
revealed. Artifacts can have anomalies and they can 'break 
the rules' meaning they sometimes have abilities, special 
conditions or usages that allow for things not normally 
permitted. The use of artifacts can break a game more easily 
than making one so they should be used sparingly and 
with great caution. It is not recommended that experience 
be given for Artifacts as the power they wield is their own 
reward but experience value is provided should mastery 
(knowledge of the item and its powers) be obtained and the 
GM decide to reward that with experience anyway. Item 

===== PAGE 484 =====
478
powers not in the wielder's control (even situationally) are 
not worth experience and are thus not included in the total 
value.
Blade of Doors
Description: this is a +7 Chromantium, frictionless blade 
that scintillates in every color of the rainbow as any light 
shines off of it. It will merge with any surface, sinking in

to the current one, remaining open for up to 2 hours and 5 
minutes. 
Possible Origins:  A divine rogue created it to make doors 
where none are possible or a mortal rogue made it as his last

Suggested Purpose: To create doors anywhere to go

Ethereal Blade
Description: this +6/+7 blade has a translucent Crysteel 
hilt only the hint of a blade’s edge in twin beams of light one 
blue, one purple, extending from the hilt. The hilt changes 
shape and size to fit the hand and desires of the attuned 
wielder. The beam blade can mimic any blade style desired. 
The light beams have three modes. In the first mode, the two 
light beams widen, joining and hardening into force to make 
a complete visible blade of light that cuts like a magical force 
blade of sharpness. This is the standard mode. The second 
mode is the two separate light beams. This mode allows it 
cut into or through non-living material. Either parting it 
(mold) or finding its failure points (sundering.) The last 
mode is reserved for masters, in this mode the two beams 
of light move inward and converge becoming a single, tight, 
indigo beam that cuts through living material severing 
control of it by a living host. In this final form it can pass 
through even magical armor or protection. 
Possible Origins:  Created by a planar blademaster of great 
skill and courage destined to face great challenges. 
Suggested Purpose: To breach a magical fortresses and 
defeat a magical armored dark or death knight of the planar 
realms.

Mirror of Portals
Description: This oval mirror is made of silver with the 
mirror faced polished to a high sheen. It has an ornate 
border of a floral design. The Mirror of Portals is a foot tall, 
six inches in width and a half inch thick and appears to be 
weightless. The mirror can be pulled into larger shapes up 
to 10 feet tall and 5 feet wide. It can view and listen in on 
any person, place or thing the wielder has previous beheld 
regardless of distance, even across planes. If the wielder 
has a truename then she does not need to have previously 
seen them to be viewed. Deities and the portions of their 
planes designated home, non-magical areas, as well as other 
artifacts cannot be spied on, unless the deity’s truename 
is known or the artifact has been previously mastered by 
the wielder. The mirror can open a portal twice a day to 
any location that is being viewed. The wielder determines 
when first viewing the mirrored location, whether the 
mirror is also viewable at the location, allowing two-way 
communication, and if opened as a portal becomes a two-
way portal. If the wielder steps through the portal then 
the portal always becomes two-way at that moment. If the 
mirror is viewing or has been made into a portal it will 
levitate, fixed in space and continue to operate as long as 
the wielder that set the viewed location is within sight of the 
mirror, indefinitely. When the Mirror is mastered, once per 
month, it can view (or ghost portal) to a person, place or 
thing in the past. Alternately, it can view a person, place or 
thing that may be in the future, now possibly influenced by 
the mirror. If the mirror is used as a future portal the trip is 
one-way, only allowing return as a time ghost. 
Possible Origins:  An immortal seeress created the mirror 
to facilitate her rise to power but no longer needed it once 
achieving full divinity as her powers surpassed those of the 
mirror.
Suggested Purpose: To develop a vast planar faction that 
operates in many locations. 
Suggested Destruction Method:  The mirror is opened 
to see the moment of its creation and then the mastered 
wielder pulls the mirror through itself, thus creating a 
paradox and shattering the mirror at the moment the 
mastered wielder reached into the mirror. 
Anomalies: The wielder can reach into the mirror, if it 
wasn’t set as a portal it now becomes one while the wielder 
is reaching through, and this portal is always two way. If the 
portal was across planar boundaries and the mirror has not 
been mastered then a Magic Resistance must be made or the 
wielder is disintegrated and the portal closes. If the portal 
is across time then a Magic Resistance must be made or the 
wielder is Obliterated and the mirror disappears, returning 
to where it was first found by the wielder who no longer 
even existed, and possible paradoxes ensue.  
Base Aura Level 25

Sword of Deeds
Description: This sword initially appears as any +1 blade of 
Mithreel in a plain but well-maintained scabbard. The only 
thing remarkable about it is how magically weak it is. It has 
Sharpness but the sword operates at only 5 Aura. Normally 
this would create a failure chance every time it was used but 
this does not happen. The first time the wielder of the blade 
does a remarkable deed, something that the GM agrees was 
difficult and worthy then the scabbard disappears and a 
man in kilt and billowing shirt appears with the very same 
scabbard across his back. He introduces himself as Mr. 
Deeds. He tells the owner that the sword has now selected 
him and he will speak for it. The sword will grow from the 
deeds performed by the wielder. Each time gaining +1 more 
to hit and damage, and +5 to base Aura and being coated in 
one magical metal grade higher; +1 Mithreel to +2, then +3 
Adamantium, then +4, etc.  A symbol of the deed performed 
now appears near the hilt on the blade and Mr. Deeds will 
point to this. It doesn’t otherwise change for this first deed. 
Also, each deed (after the first) adds one power to the sword 
that most closely matches the deed performed. See the 
powers table. Mr. Deeds cannot be killed. If he is harmed, 
he just turns into a scabbard. If the scabbard is destroyed 
it repairs itself. Mr. Deeds will appear every time a deed is 
either undertaken or successful or if one was accidentally 
achieved. He explains the new powers of the sword and 
compliments the wielder on their action. If the wielder fails 
in a sworn task then Mr. Deeds appears and tells them that 
they have failed and after two more such failures the sword 
(and Mr. Deeds) will no longer serve the wielder, returning 
to its nascent state somewhere else. If the wielder dies or 
the sword is sold or given away the sword vanishes and will 
return to its nascent state elsewhere. A GM is not limited to 
the sample table and may choose other powers that make 
sense for the Deed accomplished. 
Possible Origins:  Created by a deity to promote valor or by 
a Knight as a final act. 
Suggested Purpose: To promote valor and heroism in the 

===== PAGE 489 =====
483
world. 
Suggested Destruction Method:  The weapon is turned on 
Mr. Deeds while he is held in a Planar Blockade, killing him 
and then the sword is broken by a great blow from a metal 
weapon of higher grade. 
Anomalies: The weapon disappears (teleports away) and 
returns to its nascent state if the wielder dies, tries to sell 
it or give it away or fails in three deeds, intentional or 
otherwise.
